english: Greetings, [Ari].
french: Je te salue, [Ari].
russian: Приветствую, [Ari].
bulgarian: Greetings, [Ari].

english: Yes? Did you need something, [Ari]?
french: Oui ? As-tu besoin de quelque chose, [Ari] ?
russian: Да? Тебе что-то нужно, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Yes? Did you need something, [Ari]?

english: Juniper sets the ambiance well.
french: Juniper sait créer une ambiance.
russian: Джунипер умеет создать правильную атмосферу.
bulgarian: Juniper sets the ambiance well.

english: The aromas that fill this bathhouse... they are invigorating.
french: Les arômes qui emplissent ces bains... Ils sont revigorants.
russian: Ароматы в этой купальне... помогают взбодриться.
bulgarian: The aromas that fill this bathhouse... they are invigorating.

english: What? It is a figure of speech.
french: Qu'y a-t-il ? C'est juste une façon de parler.
russian: Что? Это просто фигура речи.
bulgarian: What? It is a figure of speech.

english: Oh, this bathhouse is a luxury worth killing for.
french: Oh ! Je pourrais tuer pour savourer le luxe de ces bains.
russian: О, за такую роскошь, как эта купальня, я готова убить.
bulgarian: Oh, this bathhouse is a luxury worth killing for.

english: I will have a word with Dozy about it.
french: Il faudra que j'en parle à Dozy.
russian: Надо будет обсудить это с Дрёмой.
bulgarian: I will have a word with Dozy about it.

english: Try as I might, the bins in the changing room are not big enough to hold my armor...
french: J'ai beau essayer, les paniers à disposition dans les vestiaires ne sont pas assez grands pour contenir mon armure.
russian: Мои доспехи не вмещаются в корзины в раздевалке, как бы я ни старалась...
bulgarian: Try as I might, the bins in the changing room are not big enough to hold my armor...

english: I never did find a hot spring large enough to accommodate my draconic form.
french: Je ne suis jamais parvenue à trouver une source chaude assez vaste pour accueillir ma forme de dragon.
russian: В драконьем обличье мне так и не удалось отыскать горячий источник подходящего размера.
bulgarian: I never did find a hot spring large enough to accommodate my draconic form.

english: It is a pleasure to enjoy a hot bath in a mortal body.
french: C'est un plaisir de savourer un bain chaud dans un corps mortel.
russian: В теле смертного очень приятно принимать горячую ванну.
bulgarian: It is a pleasure to enjoy a hot bath in a mortal body.

english: I will make accommodations for her feelings. For now.
french: Je vais prendre en compte son ressenti. Pour l'instant.
russian: Пожалуй, я проявлю уважение к её чувствам. На сей раз.
bulgarian: I will make accommodations for her feelings. For now.

english: But perhaps, once she is distracted...
french: Mais peut-être qu'un jour où elle sera distraite...
russian: Но, возможно, когда она отвлечётся...
bulgarian: But perhaps, once she is distracted...

english: I came here to wash my armor in the magic-infused water of this bathhouse... but it seems Juniper is against such things.
french: Je suis venue ici pour laver mon armure dans les eaux imprégnées de magie de ces bains... mais Juniper y semble opposée.
russian: Я хотела омыть свои доспехи в богатых магией водах этой купальни... Но оказалось, что Джунипер это не по нраву.
bulgarian: I came here to wash my armor in the magic-infused water of this bathhouse... but it seems Juniper is against such things.

english: But as a dragon, I wouldn't mind if the water was a few hundred degrees hotter.
french: Mais en tant que dragon, il ne me déplairait pas que cette eau ait quelques centaines de degrés de plus.
russian: Но, будучи драконом, я была бы не прочь сделать на сто-двести градусов погорячее.
bulgarian: But as a dragon, I wouldn't mind if the water was a few hundred degrees hotter.

english: The temperature of the baths is pleasant enough...
french: La température de ces bains est assez plaisante...
russian: Температура воды в купальне достаточно приятна...
bulgarian: The temperature of the baths is pleasant enough...

english: Long ago, I wished to test my mettle against the strongest foes I could find. And so, I followed the peculiar tale of a terrifying sea beast to the source.
french: Il y a fort longtemps, j'ai voulu me mesurer aux ennemis les plus redoutables. J'ai donc tenté de retrouver une créature marine légendaire et terrifiante.
russian: Когда-то давно я решила померяться силами с самыми грозными противниками. Тогда я отыскала источник занимательных рассказов про ужасное морское чудище.
bulgarian: Long ago, I wished to test my mettle against the strongest foes I could find. And so, I followed the peculiar tale of a terrifying sea beast to the source.

english: What I found was a shark, of a bloodthirsty ferocity that impressed even me. It sensed in me a fellow predator, and charged without hesitation.
french: J'ai découvert un requin d'une férocité sanguinaire, impressionnante même pour moi. Il a senti en moi un prédateur rival et m'a chargée sans hésiter.
russian: И нашла акулу, которая привела меня в восторг своей свирепостью и кровожадностью. Она сразу учуяла во мне собрата-хищника и бесстрашно понеслесь мне навстречу.
bulgarian: What I found was a shark, of a bloodthirsty ferocity that impressed even me. It sensed in me a fellow predator, and charged without hesitation.

english: We fought for three days and nights, and in the end, I emerged victorious. I took its mighty cartilaginous jaw and preserved it as my trophy...
french: Nous avons combattu trois jours et trois nuits et j'ai fini par l'emporter. J'ai conservé en trophée sa puissante mâchoire cartilagineuse...
russian: Мы сражались три дня и три ночи, и наконец я одержала победу. Я вырезала её могучий челюстной хрящ и забрала в качестве трофея...
bulgarian: We fought for three days and nights, and in the end, I emerged victorious. I took its mighty cartilaginous jaw and preserved it as my trophy...

english: And that is the story of how I came to possess my swim attire.
french: Et c'est ainsi que j'ai obtenu ce qui me sert aujourd'hui de maillot de bain.
russian: Вот так у меня и появился купальник.
bulgarian: And that is the story of how I came to possess my swim attire.

english: I have a story to tell you, [Ari].
french: J'ai une histoire à te raconter, [Ari].
russian: Расскажу тебе одну историю, [Ari].
bulgarian: I have a story to tell you, [Ari].

english: If you explore deep enough, it becomes quiet and dark as night. The fish glow like little stars.
french: Lorsqu'on plonge assez profondément, tout devient noir et silencieux comme la nuit. Les poissons brillent, telles de petites étoiles.
russian: Если зайти вдаль от берега, он становится тихий и тёмный, словно сама ночь. А рыбы мерцают, как звёздочки.
bulgarian: If you explore deep enough, it becomes quiet and dark as night. The fish glow like little stars.

english: Night above, and below... the thought pleases me.
french: La nuit, au-dessus et en dessous... Cette idée me plaît.
russian: Ночь наверху и ночь подо мной... Это приятное чувство.
bulgarian: Night above, and below... the thought pleases me.

english: I am partial to the ocean.
french: J'ai un faible pour l'océan.
russian: Я питаю слабость к океану.
bulgarian: I am partial to the ocean.

english: And then, as though to bolster its defiance, it pinched me again.
french: Et puis, comme pour appuyer son attitude de défi, il m'a pincée à nouveau.
russian: А затем ущипнул ещё раз, с удвоенной дерзостью.
bulgarian: And then, as though to bolster its defiance, it pinched me again.

english: I admire such pluck. Yes... that little crab will go far.
french: J'admire une telle audace. Oui... Ce petit crabe ira loin.
russian: Я поощряю такую отвагу. Да... У маленького краба большое будущее.
bulgarian: I admire such pluck. Yes... that little crab will go far.

english: I was walking along the shore when a little crab pinched me.
french: Je marchais le long du rivage quand un petit crabe m'a pincée.
russian: Я прогуливалась вдоль берега, как вдруг меня ущипнул краб.
bulgarian: I was walking along the shore when a little crab pinched me.

english: It pleases me to view this idyllic scene...
french: Il me plaît de contempler ce paysage idyllique...
russian: Мне нравится наблюдать за этим безмятежным пейзажем...
bulgarian: It pleases me to view this idyllic scene...

english: Waiting for the illusion to shatter when a mighty sea monster rears its head to challenge me.
french: Et d'attendre que l'illusion se brise quand un puissant monstre marin se dressera pour me défier.
russian: И ждать, когда эта иллюзия рухнет и могучее морское чудовище поднимет голову из глубин, бросая мне вызов.
bulgarian: Waiting for the illusion to shatter when a mighty sea monster rears its head to challenge me.

english: But do not worry. I will fell any foe that dares to approach.
french: Mais ne t'inquiète pas. Je vaincrai n'importe quel ennemi qui aura l'audace d'approcher.
russian: Только не переживай. Я сражу любого, кто пойдёт мне навстречу.
bulgarian: But do not worry. I will fell any foe that dares to approach.

english: Like now! Look there!
french: Comme là ! Regarde !
russian: Вон, смотри! Вот там!
bulgarian: Like now! Look there!

english: Ah. It is just more driftwood. What a shame.
french: Ah. Ce n'est que du bois flotté. Quel dommage !
russian: А, опять коряга. Какая жалость.
bulgarian: Ah. It is just more driftwood. What a shame.

english: Would you like to watch the waves with me, [Ari]?
french: Aimerais-tu regarder les vagues avec moi, [Ari] ?
russian: Ты желаешь понаблюдать за волнами со мной, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Would you like to watch the waves with me, [Ari]?

english: Such a gesture is unnecessary... I prefer to use my claws when hunting.
french: Ce genre de geste n'est pas nécessaire... Je préfère utiliser mes griffes pour la chasse.
russian: Напрасная щедрость... Я предпочитаю охотиться с помощью когтей.
bulgarian: Such a gesture is unnecessary... I prefer to use my claws when hunting.

english: Terithia saw me stalking along the water's edge and offered me one of her fishing rods.
french: Terithia m'a vue rôder au bord de l'eau et m'a proposé l'une de ses cannes à pêche.
russian: Теризия увидела, как я брожу возле воды, и предложила мне свою удочку.
bulgarian: Terithia saw me stalking along the water's edge and offered me one of her fishing rods.

english: A place with an embrace beyond all limits, where a mortal body would surely shatter.
french: Un endroit dont l'étreinte ne connaît aucune limite, où un corps mortel serait sûrement brisé.
russian: Океан там сжимает со всех сторон, будто в крепких объятиях, от которых бы раздробилось тело любого смертного.
bulgarian: A place with an embrace beyond all limits, where a mortal body would surely shatter.

english: To a dragon, it is like a sanctuary. Deathly...
french: Pour un dragon, ce serait là un sanctuaire. Fatal...
russian: Для дракона это заповедное место. Смертельно опасное...
bulgarian: To a dragon, it is like a sanctuary. Deathly...

english: And thus, peaceful.
french: Et par conséquent, paisible.
russian: И потому спокойное.
bulgarian: And thus, peaceful.

english: Deep in the ocean, there is a place that no light can reach.
french: Au plus profond de l'océan se trouve un lieu que la lumière ne peut atteindre.
russian: В глубине океана есть место, куда не достигает свет.
bulgarian: Deep in the ocean, there is a place that no light can reach.

english: But it has been countless ages since that time.
french: Mais bien des lustres se sont écoulés depuis lors.
russian: Но с тех пор прошли несчётные столетия.
bulgarian: But it has been countless ages since that time.

english: I wonder... What remains from that era?
french: Que reste-t-il de cette époque ? Je me le demande.
russian: Интересно... Что сохранилось с той эпохи?
bulgarian: I wonder... What remains from that era?

english: And what must I teach mortals anew?
french: Et que dois-je à nouveau enseigner aux mortels ?
russian: И чему мне следует учить смертных вновь?
bulgarian: And what must I teach mortals anew?

english: I was once worshipped as a goddess in this land.
french: J'étais jadis vénérée comme une déesse sur ces terres.
russian: Когда-то в этих землях меня почитали как богиню.
bulgarian: I was once worshipped as a goddess in this land.

english: Look! The myriad colors of fruit rival that of my glittering hoard.
french: Regarde ! La myriade de couleurs de ces fruits rivalise avec mes richesses scintillantes.
russian: Взгляни! Плоды переливаются мириадами красок, словно лучшие из моих сокровищ.
bulgarian: Look! The myriad colors of fruit rival that of my glittering hoard.

english: The variety of foods this little store is able to stock is impressive.
french: La diversité d'aliments que cette petite boutique a en réserve est impressionnante.
russian: Этот маленький магазинчик обеспечивает поистине впечатляющее разнообразие пищи.
bulgarian: The variety of foods this little store is able to stock is impressive.

english: It is like watching an anthill inside of a jar.
french: C'est comme contempler une fourmilière dans un bocal.
russian: Это как наблюдать за муравьиной кучей в банке.
bulgarian: It is like watching an anthill inside of a jar.

english: It delights me, the bustle of mortals going about their daily lives.
french: L'agitation des mortels vaquant à leurs occupations me réjouit.
russian: Мне нравится наблюдать, как смертные суетятся изо дня в день.
bulgarian: It delights me, the bustle of mortals going about their daily lives.

english: Perhaps I should practice my new spells in the village square.
french: Je devrais peut-être m'entraîner à mes nouveaux sorts sur la place du village.
russian: Может, мне стоит испытать мои новые заклинания на главной площади.
bulgarian: Perhaps I should practice my new spells in the village square.

english: It would certainly liven things up.
french: Cela mettrait sans aucun doute de l'animation.
russian: Это точно их взбодрит.
bulgarian: It would certainly liven things up.

english: Sometimes I look around and think these townsfolk have become too complacent.
french: Parfois, je regarde autour de moi et je me dis que ces villageois sont devenus bien trop insouciants.
russian: Иногда я смотрю вокруг и думаю, что местные жители слишком расслабились.
bulgarian: Sometimes I look around and think these townsfolk have become too complacent.

english: Time is cyclical, and our reign of fire will surely burn again.
french: Le temps s'écoule de manière cyclique et notre règne de feu brûlera de nouveau un jour.
russian: Время идёт по кругу. Когда-нибудь наше огненное царство обязательно разгорится вновь.
bulgarian: Time is cyclical, and our reign of fire will surely burn again.

english: The age of dragons may have passed, but do not fret.
french: L'époque des dragons est révolue, mais ne t'inquiète pas.
russian: Времена драконов прошли, но не предавайся отчаянию.
bulgarian: The age of dragons may have passed, but do not fret.

english: We should do as we did in my youth...
french: Nous devrions faire comme au temps de ma jeunesse...
russian: Надо попробовать развлечься, как в молодости...
bulgarian: We should do as we did in my youth...

english: Single out the brawniest mortals and make them fight for our entertainment.
french: Distinguer les mortels les plus combatifs et les faire s'affronter pour notre divertissement.
russian: Выбрать самых крепких смертных и заставить их сражаться нам на потеху.
bulgarian: Single out the brawniest mortals and make them fight for our entertainment.

english: Then the winner will have the honor of fighting me.
french: Le vainqueur aurait ensuite l'honneur de se battre contre moi.
russian: А победитель заслужит честь сражаться со мной.
bulgarian: Then the winner will have the honor of fighting me.

english: What do you say, [Ari]?
french: Qu'en dis-tu, [Ari] ?
russian: Что скажешь, [Ari]?
bulgarian: What do you say, [Ari]?

english: Today, I find myself feeling listless.
french: Je me sens apathique, aujourd'hui.
russian: Сегодня я чувствую необыкновенное утомление.
bulgarian: Today, I find myself feeling listless.

english: It is a mode of expression that I favor.
french: C'est un mode d'expression que je privilégie.
russian: Для меня это наиболее привычный способ самовыражения.
bulgarian: It is a mode of expression that I favor.

english: Perhaps you and I can bring it back into fashion.
french: Peut-être que toi et moi, nous pourrions le remettre à la mode.
russian: Возможно, вместе у нас получится вернуть его в моду.
bulgarian: Perhaps you and I can bring it back into fashion.

english: I am surprised the people of this era do not wear the bones of their enemies.
french: Je suis surprise que le peuple de cette époque n'arbore pas les os de ses ennemis.
russian: Я удивлена, что люди в эту эпоху не носят кости своих врагов.
bulgarian: I am surprised the people of this era do not wear the bones of their enemies.

english: But fear not... they will be reborn as $Rose Hips$ with the coming of winter.
french: Mais n'aie crainte... Elles renaîtront sous la forme d'$églantines$ à l'arrivée de l'hiver.
russian: Но не бойся... Когда придёт зима, они переродятся в $шиповник$.
bulgarian: But fear not... they will be reborn as $Rose Hips$ with the coming of winter.

english: Such is the cycle of death and rebirth.
french: Tel est le cycle de la mort et de la renaissance.
russian: Таковы законы жизни и смерти.
bulgarian: Such is the cycle of death and rebirth.

english: I see the $Roses$ withered at the end of summer...
french: Je constate que les $roses$ ont fané à la fin de l'été...
russian: Я видела, как в конце лета увяли $розы$...
bulgarian: I see the $Roses$ withered at the end of summer...

english: Gazing upon this manor garden, I can see that Celine has been successful in finding her path in this lifetime.
french: Quand je contemple le jardin de ce manoir, je constate que Céline est parvenue à trouver sa voie dans l'existence.
russian: Присмотревшись к саду особняка, я отмечаю, что Селин удалось найти свой путь в этой жизни.
bulgarian: Gazing upon this manor garden, I can see that Celine has been successful in finding her path in this lifetime.

english: I wonder what she might accomplish, if she turned her eye to destruction rather than creation...
french: Je me demande de quoi elle serait capable si elle se tournait vers la destruction, plutôt que la création...
russian: Интересно, каких высот она смогла бы достичь, если бы обратила свои таланты на разрушение, а не на созидание...
bulgarian: I wonder what she might accomplish, if she turned her eye to destruction rather than creation...

english: Such a thought amuses me.
french: Cette pensée m'amuse.
russian: Мне занимательно об этом размышлять.
bulgarian: Such a thought amuses me.

english: Interesting...
french: C'est intéressant...
russian: Любопытно...
bulgarian: Interesting...

english: Each inhabitant has its own needs and demands.
french: Chaque habitant a des besoins et des exigences qui lui sont propres.
russian: У каждого обитателя свои желания и потребности.
bulgarian: Each inhabitant has its own needs and demands.

english: I ruled my own kingdoms to great success for eons...
french: J'ai dirigé mes royaumes avec grand succès pendant des siècles...
russian: Я управляла своими королевствами многие тысячелетия — и с большим успехом...
bulgarian: I ruled my own kingdoms to great success for eons...

english: But unfortunately, plants seem to wither at my touch.
french: Mais malheureusement, les plantes semblent dépérir quand je les touche.
russian: Но, к сожалению, растения увядают, когда я их касаюсь.
bulgarian: But unfortunately, plants seem to wither at my touch.

english: Managing a garden is like managing a kingdom...
french: La gestion d'un jardin est semblable à celle d'un royaume...
russian: Следить за садом — всё равно что следить за королевством...
bulgarian: Managing a garden is like managing a kingdom...

english: And soon, the pretty flowers in this garden will succumb to the frosts of winter.
french: Et bientôt, les jolies fleurs de ce jardin succomberont aux gelées de l'hiver.
russian: Скоро прелестные цветы в этом саду падут перед зимними холодами.
bulgarian: And soon, the pretty flowers in this garden will succumb to the frosts of winter.

english: In death, they will nurture what comes after.
french: Dans la mort, elles nourriront ce qui viendra après elles.
russian: И их смерть подготовит почву для тех, кто придёт после них.
bulgarian: In death, they will nurture what comes after.

english: Endings always serve a purpose, you see.
french: Une fin sert toujours un but, vois-tu.
russian: Как видишь, окончание — всегда лишь шаг к новой цели.
bulgarian: Endings always serve a purpose, you see.

english: The air becomes sharp with cold...
french: L'air froid devient piquant...
russian: В воздухе уже чувствуется колючий мороз...
bulgarian: The air becomes sharp with cold...

english: There is no need to actually feed villagers to the fish... but the thought of it is enough to keep subjects in line.
french: Nul besoin de nourrir ces poissons avec des habitants... mais cette perspective suffit généralement à rendre des sujets dociles.
russian: Местных жителей вовсе не обязательно отправлять им на корм... Но эта мысль поможет держать их в повиновении.
bulgarian: There is no need to actually feed villagers to the fish... but the thought of it is enough to keep subjects in line.

english: I am not certain she took my proposal seriously...
french: Je ne suis pas certaine qu'elle ait pris ma proposition au sérieux.
russian: Я не уверена, что она восприняла моё предложение всерьёз.
bulgarian: I am not certain she took my proposal seriously...

english: I suggested to Adeline to add some man-eating fish to the manor pond.
french: J'ai suggéré à Adeline d'ajouter des poissons mangeurs d'hommes dans l'étang du manoir.
russian: Я предложила Аделине добавить в пруд возле особняка рыб-людоедов.
bulgarian: I suggested to Adeline to add some man-eating fish to the manor pond.

english: Humans will put up a statue to commemorate anything will they not?
french: Les humains dressent des statues commémoratives pour n'importe quoi, non ?
russian: Люди готовы воздвигать статуи чему попало...
bulgarian: Humans will put up a statue to commemorate anything will they not?

english: I have a hideous top that I do not wear anymore, perhaps the villagers would like to build a great big stele in the middle of town to immortalize it?
french: J'ai un petit haut très laid que je ne porte plus, peut-être qu'ils aimeraient construire une grande stèle au milieu de la ville pour l'immortaliser ?
russian: У меня есть отвратительный, топ, который я больше не ношу. Может, они захотят увековечить его в виде большущей стелы посреди города?
bulgarian: I have a hideous top that I do not wear anymore, perhaps the villagers would like to build a great big stele in the middle of town to immortalize it?

english: So generous, what powers does it have?
french: C'est très généreux de ta part, quel est son pouvoir ?
russian: Очень щедро с твоей стороны. А какие у него силы?
bulgarian: So generous, what powers does it have?

english: Look, if you're just giving away cute tops, I'll take it.
french: Si tu te débarrasses de tes jolis hauts, je le veux bien.
russian: Слушай, если ты отдашь хорошенький топ просто так, то я лучше возьму себе.
bulgarian: Look, if you're just giving away cute tops, I'll take it.

english: You know what? Never mind.
french: Tu sais quoi ? Oublie ça.
russian: Знаешь что? Лучше не стоит.
bulgarian: You know what? Never mind.

english: The villagers erected a stele to enshrine the Dragonsworn's... old boots?
french: Les habitants ont érigé une stèle pour conserver précieusement les... vieilles bottes du paladin du dragon ?
russian: Местные жители возвели стелу в честь... старой обуви драконоверного?
bulgarian: The villagers erected a stele to enshrine the Dragonsworn's... old boots?

english: I commend you.
french: Tu as tout mon respect.
russian: Хвалю.
bulgarian: I commend you.

english: It is impressive that you solved the mystery of the stele, [Ari].
french: Tu as résolu le mystère de la stèle, [Ari], c'est impressionnant.
russian: Я впечатлена, что тебе удалось разгадать загадку этой стелы, [Ari].
bulgarian: It is impressive that you solved the mystery of the stele, [Ari].

english: To think the sum of mortal knowledge could be reduced to trinkets in a room...
french: Imaginer que la somme des connaissances humaines puisse se réduire à quelques babioles dans une pièce...
russian: Подумать только, все познания людей о мире помещаются в зал с необычными безделушками...
bulgarian: To think the sum of mortal knowledge could be reduced to trinkets in a room...

english: Errol does a passable impression of a dragon, I think.
french: Errol ferait un dragon tout à fait acceptable, je crois.
russian: А Эррол, по-моему, вполне сносно напоминает дракона.
bulgarian: Errol does a passable impression of a dragon, I think.

english: What a charming hoard this museum is...
french: Quelle ravissante accumulation de richesses que ce musée !
russian: Этот музей — очаровательная гора сокровищ.
bulgarian: What a charming hoard this museum is...

english: It seems an age or two passed whilst I slumbered.
french: On dirait qu'une ère ou deux a passé pendant que j'étais plongée dans le sommeil.
russian: Видимо, за время моего сна прошла парочка эпох.
bulgarian: It seems an age or two passed whilst I slumbered.

english: I do not recognize the stylistic elements that decorate some of these artifacts.
french: Je ne reconnais pas les éléments stylistiques qui ornent certains de ces artéfacts.
russian: Я не узнаю стилистические элементы в украшениях некоторых артефактов.
bulgarian: I do not recognize the stylistic elements that decorate some of these artifacts.

english: Just now, I saw a common crystal goblet on display. I recognized a scratch on the stem... I drank from that very goblet during mealtimes.
french: Je viens de voir qu'un gobelet en cristal très quelconque était exposé. J'ai reconnu une rayure sur son pied... Je m'en servais pendant mes repas.
russian: Я только что видела на витрине обыкновенный хрустальный бокал. Я распознала его по царапине на ножке... Именно из него я пила во время приёма пищи.
bulgarian: Just now, I saw a common crystal goblet on display. I recognized a scratch on the stem... I drank from that very goblet during mealtimes.

english: Such a mundane thing. Who knew it might be revered as emblematic of the past?
french: Quel objet sans intérêt ! Qui aurait cru qu'il pourrait être vénéré comme un emblème du passé ?
russian: Такая обыденная вещица. Кто бы мог подумать, что она станет ассоциироваться с древностью?
bulgarian: Such a mundane thing. Who knew it might be revered as emblematic of the past?

english: It is unusual to see what is considered an antiquity in this day and age.
french: Observer ce qui est considéré comme une antiquité aujourd'hui est assez inhabituel.
russian: Удивительно, что в нынешние дни считается древней диковинкой.
bulgarian: It is unusual to see what is considered an antiquity in this day and age.

english: I commissioned that denomination myself. It was minted to commemorate my hundredth year of rule.
french: J'ai moi-même décidé de sa valeur. Elle fut frappée pour commémorer ma centième année de règne.
russian: Этот выпуск отчеканили по моему личному заказу в честь столетия моего царства.
bulgarian: I commissioned that denomination myself. It was minted to commemorate my hundredth year of rule.

english: You may find it difficult to make out due to the wear of centuries, but each is emblazoned with my likeness.
french: Cela peut être difficile à voir, en raison de l'usure des siècles, mais chacune d'elles porte mon effigie.
russian: На каждой из них есть моё изображение. Хотя за долгие века оно во многом стёрлось, и теперь его непросто заметить.
bulgarian: You may find it difficult to make out due to the wear of centuries, but each is emblazoned with my likeness.

english: That coin in the Museum display... it is a currency that circulated during my reign.
french: Cette pièce de monnaie, exposée dans le musée... Elle était en circulation durant mon règne.
russian: В музее выставляется одна монета... Это валюта, которой пользовались во времена моего правления.
bulgarian: That coin in the Museum display... it is a currency that circulated during my reign.

english: I no longer find it fashionable, but... if the notion takes me, perhaps I will take it back.
french: Je ne le trouve plus à la mode, mais... si l'envie m'en prend, je le récupérerai peut-être.
russian: На мой взгляд, у него недостаточно стильный фасон... Но если мне захочется, я его заберу.
bulgarian: I no longer find it fashionable, but... if the notion takes me, perhaps I will take it back.

english: It is rightfully mine, after all.
french: Après tout, il m'appartient de droit.
russian: В конце концов, он по праву должен принадлежать мне.
bulgarian: It is rightfully mine, after all.

english: I just saw an old circlet of mine on display.
french: Je viens de voir un de mes anciens diadèmes en exposition.
russian: Я недавно видела на витрине венец, который когда-то носила.
bulgarian: I just saw an old circlet of mine on display.

english: They are a formidable trio.
french: Ils forment un trio formidable.
russian: Из них вышло внушительное трио.
bulgarian: They are a formidable trio.

english: Josie, Elsie, and Hemlock... look how they enthrall the masses with their performance.
french: Jo, Elsie et Hemlock... Regarde comme ils ravissent les foules avec leur spectacle.
russian: Джози, Элси и Хемлок... так очаровывают публику представлением.
bulgarian: Josie, Elsie, and Hemlock... look how they enthrall the masses with their performance.

english: I think I should like to see it.
french: Je crois que j'aimerais y assister.
russian: Думаю, я послушаю с удовольствием.
bulgarian: I think I should like to see it.

english: The nobility would surely complain of my pauldrons blocking their view... but I would make short work of them.
french: Les nobles se plaindraient sûrement que mes épaulières leur cachent la vue... Mais je leur réglerais vite leur compte.
russian: Аристократы сразу начнут ворчать, что мои наплечники загораживают обзор... Но я с ними легко разделаюсь.
bulgarian: The nobility would surely complain of my pauldrons blocking their view... but I would make short work of them.

english: If Elsie ever comes out of her self-imposed country exile and performs another opera in the Capital...
french: Si Elsie renonçait un jour à son exil à la campagne et offrait une autre représentation d'opéra à la capitale...
russian: Если Элси когда-нибудь решит вернуться в столицу из своей добровольной ссылки и исполнить там оперу...
bulgarian: If Elsie ever comes out of her self-imposed country exile and performs another opera in the Capital...

english: There is simply nothing else like it.
french: Il n'y a rien de comparable à cela.
russian: Других подобных удовольствий просто нет.
bulgarian: There is simply nothing else like it.

english: If there is one thing I will credit to you mortals above all others, it is music.
french: S'il y a bien une chose, plus que tout autre, dont j'attribue le mérite aux mortels, c'est la musique.
russian: У вас, смертных, есть один талант, который я не могу не признать, — это музыка.
bulgarian: If there is one thing I will credit to you mortals above all others, it is music.

english: And the wasting season makes way for the cold, dark season of slumber.
french: Et celle-ci préfigure la saison, sombre et froide, du sommeil.
russian: А за сезоном увядания следует холодный и тёмный сезон спячки.
bulgarian: And the wasting season makes way for the cold, dark season of slumber.

english: The thought of that makes me smile.
french: Cette pensée me donne le sourire.
russian: От этой мысли я невольно улыбаюсь.
bulgarian: The thought of that makes me smile.

english: The air has become quite brisk. That heralds the wasting season.
french: L'air s'est beaucoup rafraîchi. Voilà qui annonce la saison de la dégénérescence.
russian: Ветер — предвестник сезона увядания. И сейчас он стал прохладным и порывистым.
bulgarian: The air has become quite brisk. That heralds the wasting season.

english: While the sentiment pleases me...
french: Bien que cette opinion me plaise...
russian: И, хоть это утверждение доставляет мне удовольствие...
bulgarian: While the sentiment pleases me...

english: In reality, spirits wander in every season.
french: En réalité, les esprits errent en toute saison.
russian: На самом деле бродячие духи встречаются во все сезоны.
bulgarian: In reality, spirits wander in every season.

english: Death does not vacation, [Ari].
french: La mort ne prend pas de vacances, [Ari].
russian: От смерти нет отпуска, [Ari].
bulgarian: Death does not vacation, [Ari].

english: It seems that in this era, autumn is considered the season of ghosts.
french: Il semble que dans cette région, l'automne soit considéré comme la saison des fantômes.
russian: Как я вижу, в эту эпоху осень считается порой призраков.
bulgarian: It seems that in this era, autumn is considered the season of ghosts.

english: Curious that it is no longer the case.
french: Il est curieux que cela ne soit plus le cas.
russian: Занимательно, что эта мода прошла.
bulgarian: Curious that it is no longer the case.

english: In my time, summer was the season for chainmail garments.
french: À mon époque, l'été était la saison des vêtements en cotte de mailles.
russian: В мои времена лето было порой кольчужных одеяний.
bulgarian: In my time, summer was the season for chainmail garments.

english: I must give today's mortals some credit.
french: Je dois accorder ce crédit aux mortels d'aujourd'hui.
russian: Должна выразить уважение смертным нынешних дней.
bulgarian: I must give today's mortals some credit.

english: It is wise to acknowledge anything that thrives in winter.
french: Il est sage de remercier tout ce qui prospère en hiver.
russian: Разумно признавать заслуги тех, кто способен развиваться даже зимой.
bulgarian: It is wise to acknowledge anything that thrives in winter.

english: Mortals did not cavort in the cold season, in the time before my imprisonment.
french: Les mortels ne s'ébattaient pas à la saison froide, à l'époque qui a précédé mon emprisonnement.
russian: В пору до моего заточения смертные не были так веселы зимой.
bulgarian: Mortals did not cavort in the cold season, in the time before my imprisonment.

english: It reminds me of taking wing, cutting through the clouds-
french: Cela me rappelle quand je volais, coupant à travers les nuages...
russian: Я вспоминаю, как взмывала в воздух, разрезая облака..
bulgarian: It reminds me of taking wing, cutting through the clouds-

english: Roaring into the relentless, frigid winds.
french: Rugissant au milieu des vents glacés et impitoyables.
russian: И ревела наперекор безжалостным леденящим ветрам.
bulgarian: Roaring into the relentless, frigid winds.

english: I do enjoy the cold.
french: J'aime le froid.
russian: Мне нравятся холода
bulgarian: I do enjoy the cold.

english: And night... is where I am strongest.
french: Et la nuit... est le moment où je suis la plus forte.
russian: А ночь... Это время, когда я сильнее всего.
bulgarian: And night... is where I am strongest.

english: Winter is a long, cold night.
french: L'hiver est une longue et froide nuit.
russian: Зима — как долгая холодная ночь.
bulgarian: Winter is a long, cold night.

english: She might get irritated if you disturb her solitude.
french: Elle risque de s'irriter si l'on dérange sa solitude.
russian: Вероятно, она разозлится, если потревожить её одиночество.
bulgarian: She might get irritated if you disturb her solitude.

english: Seridia's expression is distant...
french: Seridia affiche une expression distante...
russian: У Серидии отрешённое выражение лица...
bulgarian: Seridia's expression is distant...

english: Perhaps it's better to leave, before you experience the effects firsthand.
french: Mieux vaut partir, avant d'en goûter directement les effets.
russian: Вероятно, лучше уйти, пока не пришлось испытать его эффект на себе.
bulgarian: Perhaps it's better to leave, before you experience the effects firsthand.

english: Seridia seems to be casting some kind of spell...
french: Seridia semble en train de jeter un sort...
russian: Серидия, кажется, готовит какое-то заклинание...
bulgarian: Seridia seems to be casting some kind of spell...

english: Seridia taps leylines distant and near to pull power from the land, weaving them into a spell of increasing complexity.
french: Seridia puise son énergie dans les lignes telluriques proches ou lointaines pour en faire un sort très complexe.
russian: Серидия черпает из земли силу, настраивается на магические жилы, что вблизи и в далёких краях, и сплетает их в магическое полотно невероятной сложности.
bulgarian: Seridia taps leylines distant and near to pull power from the land, weaving them into a spell of increasing complexity.

english: Best to leave the dragon to her magics, for now.
french: Mieux vaut laisser le dragon à sa magie pour l'instant.
russian: Пока что лучше оставить дракона одну.
bulgarian: Best to leave the dragon to her magics, for now.

english: The aura around Seridia is... sinister.
french: Seridia est entourée d'une aura... sinistre.
russian: Серидия источает зловещую ауру...
bulgarian: The aura around Seridia is... sinister.

english: Despite your magical prowess, you are unable to comprehend the spell Seridia is casting.
french: Malgré vos talents pour la magie, vous ne parvenez pas à comprendre le sort que lance Seridia.
russian: Несмотря на ваши познания в магии, вам не удаётся разобрать смысл заклинания, которое творит Серидия.
bulgarian: Despite your magical prowess, you are unable to comprehend the spell Seridia is casting.

english: Why does she appear to deny her noble blood?
french: Pourquoi semble-t-elle nier sa noblesse ?
russian: Она зачем-то будто отказывается от своего благородного происхождения.
bulgarian: Why does she appear to deny her noble blood?

english: I have advised her that subjects should kneel before her...
french: Je lui ai indiqué que ses sujets devraient s'agenouiller devant elle...
russian: Я посоветовала ей требовать от подданных вставать на колени...
bulgarian: I have advised her that subjects should kneel before her...

english: Instead, she makes community with them. Is she a fool?
french: Mais au lieu de cela, elle s'intègre dans leur communauté. Est-elle inconsciente ?
russian: А она вместо этого общается с ними на равных. Возможно, она глупа?
bulgarian: Instead, she makes community with them. Is she a fool?

english: Unless... it is a ruse to keep them complacent?
french: À moins que... ce soit là une ruse pour qu'ils soient satisfaits ?
russian: Или, быть может... Это лишь прикрытие, чтобы усыпить их бдительность?
bulgarian: Unless... it is a ruse to keep them complacent?

english: So she may demand more stone, more wood.
french: Afin de leur demander plus de pierre, de bois.
russian: Чтобы требовать с них больше камня и древесины.
bulgarian: So she may demand more stone, more wood.

english: Her cleverness... I see it, now. Yes.
french: C'est très malin de sa part... Je le vois, à présent. Oui.
russian: Да... Теперь я могу её оценить её хитроумие...
bulgarian: Her cleverness... I see it, now. Yes.

english: The highborn beauty who rules Mistria. Adeline...
french: La beauté de sang noble qui dirige Mistria, Adeline...
russian: Высокородная красавица, что правит Мистрией, — Аделина...
bulgarian: The highborn beauty who rules Mistria. Adeline...

english: Men like that are quite easy to manipulate.
french: Ces hommes-là sont très faciles à manipuler.
russian: Такие люди легко поддаются на манипуляции.
bulgarian: Men like that are quite easy to manipulate.

english: I have heard that he has a knack for procuring items of great luxury...
french: J'ai entendu dire qu'il savait y faire pour se procurer des objets de grande valeur...
russian: Я слышала, у него талант находить предметы невиданной роскоши...
bulgarian: I have heard that he has a knack for procuring items of great luxury...

english: Perhaps he will be useful to me.
french: Peut-être me sera-t-il utile.
russian: Возможно, он может послужить моим целям.
bulgarian: Perhaps he will be useful to me.

english: That rogue of a merchant, Balor. He has shades of light and dark within him...
french: Balor, cette fripouille de marchand. L'obscurité et la lumière se mélangent en lui.
russian: Этот плутоватый торговец, Балор, таит в себе светлые и тёмные стороны.
bulgarian: That rogue of a merchant, Balor. He has shades of light and dark within him...

english: Once a rose, he has long been a thorn.
french: S'il fut un jour une rose, il est depuis longtemps une épine.
russian: Когда-то он был розой, но от неё уже давно остались одни шипы.
bulgarian: Once a rose, he has long been a thorn.

english: I should like to punish him, but perhaps there is no need.
french: J'aimerais le punir, mais cela n'est peut-être pas nécessaire.
russian: Я бы хотела его покарать, но, возможно, этого не требуется.
bulgarian: I should like to punish him, but perhaps there is no need.

english: I am not sure what I could do that he has not already done to himself.
french: Je ne sais pas ce que je pourrais lui faire qu'il ne s'est déjà infligé à lui-même.
russian: Не знаю, способна ли я сделать его жизнь хуже, чем сделал он сам.
bulgarian: I am not sure what I could do that he has not already done to himself.

english: You see, I have long embraced the assumption of mortal form...
french: Vois-tu, j'ai depuis longtemps choisi d'adopter une forme mortelle.
russian: Видишь ли, я давно привыкла принимать смертное обличье...
bulgarian: You see, I have long embraced the assumption of mortal form...

english: But such a thing was anathema to him.
french: Mais une telle chose était pour lui un anathème.
russian: Но для него это всегда было табу.
bulgarian: But such a thing was anathema to him.

english: Clinging to orthodoxy for millenia, only to defang himself now...
french: Il s'est accroché pendant des millénaires à cette orthodoxie, avant de finalement renoncer à ses crocs...
russian: Спустя тысячелетия строгого догматизма он сам лишил себя клыков...
bulgarian: Clinging to orthodoxy for millenia, only to defang himself now...

english: I do look forward to seeing how it plays out!
french: J'ai hâte de voir ce que cela va donner !
russian: Мне не терпится увидеть, чем это обернётся в дальнейшем!
bulgarian: I do look forward to seeing how it plays out!

english: As you might imagine, there is much history between Caldarus and I.
french: Comme tu peux l'imaginer, l'histoire est longue entre Caldarus et moi.
russian: Как ты, вероятно, догадываешься, у нас с Кальдарусом долгая история.
bulgarian: As you might imagine, there is much history between Caldarus and I.

english: To think such an upstart would DARE to confine me.
french: Imaginer qu'un tel morveux ait OSÉ m'enfermer.
russian: Подумать только, как ОСМЕЛИЛСЯ такой выскочка меня пленить!
bulgarian: To think such an upstart would DARE to confine me.

english: No matter. Such arrogance never goes unpunished for long.
french: Peu importe. Une telle arrogance ne reste jamais longtemps impunie.
russian: Впрочем, это не важно. Такая дерзость никогда не остаётся безнаказанной.
bulgarian: No matter. Such arrogance never goes unpunished for long.

english: Caldarus...
french: Caldarus...
russian: Кальдарус...
bulgarian: Caldarus...

english: While I might be considered a dragon of the night.
french: Alors que je serais plutôt un dragon de la nuit.
russian: А меня в таком случае считать драконом ночи.
bulgarian: While I might be considered a dragon of the night.

english: But make no mistake...
french: Mais ne t'y trompe pas...
russian: Но не стоит заблуждаться...
bulgarian: But make no mistake...

english: It was Caldarus who last plunged this world into darkness.
french: C'est Caldarus qui a le dernier plongé ce monde dans les ténèbres.
russian: Именно Кальдарус вверг этот мир во тьму.
bulgarian: It was Caldarus who last plunged this world into darkness.

english: And I who guided back the light.
french: Et moi qui l'ai ramené vers la lumière.
russian: А я вывела его назад, к свету.
bulgarian: And I who guided back the light.

english: One might call Caldarus a dragon of the day-
french: On pourrait définir Caldarus comme un dragon du jour.
russian: Кальдаруса можно было бы назвать драконом дня...
bulgarian: One might call Caldarus a dragon of the day-

english: I wonder if she is aware...?
french: Je me demande si elle le réalise...
russian: Интересно, она вообще знает?..
bulgarian: I wonder if she is aware...?

english: It seems that much has been forgotten while I was imprisoned.
french: Beaucoup de choses semblent avoir été oubliées pendant que j'étais emprisonnée.
russian: Судя по всему, за время моего заточения многое было забыто.
bulgarian: It seems that much has been forgotten while I was imprisoned.

english: Your neighbor, Celine...
french: Céline, ta voisine...
russian: Твоя соседка, Селин...
bulgarian: Your neighbor, Celine...

english: Are you familiar with the bitter brew sold at her dispensary?
french: Connais-tu bien le breuvage amer qu'elle vend à son officine ?
russian:
Ты

знакомы

знакомазнакомзнакомо с тем горьким отваром, что продаётся в её бакалейной?
bulgarian: Are you familiar with the bitter brew sold at her dispensary?

english: It appears to have an addictive quality...
french: Il semble avoir des propriétés addictives...
russian: Судя по всему, он способен вызывать привыкание...
bulgarian: It appears to have an addictive quality...

english: Allowing her to ensnare the villagers and ensure their loyal patronage week after week.
french: Cela lui permet de prendre au piège les habitants et de s'assurer leur fréquentation fidèle, semaine après semaine.
russian: И это позволяет ей удерживать местных жителей в качестве постоянных клиентов на протяжении многих недель.
bulgarian: Allowing her to ensnare the villagers and ensure their loyal patronage week after week.

english: Impressive.
french: C'est impressionnant.
russian: Впечатляющая схема.
bulgarian: Impressive.

english: That traveling proprietress, Darcy...
french: Darcy, la propriétaire itinérante...
russian: Насчёт этой Дарси с её передвижной лавочкой...
bulgarian: That traveling proprietress, Darcy...

english: To revive the Dragonguard at such a young age... true heroism may yet lie ahead of her.
french: Ressusciter la Garde des dragons à un si jeune âge... Il se pourrait qu'elle fasse plus tard preuve d'un véritable héroïsme.
russian: В столь юном возрасте она решила возродить Драконью стражу... Возможно, её ждёт будущее настоящего героя.
bulgarian: To revive the Dragonguard at such a young age... true heroism may yet lie ahead of her.

english: Heroism... that may be at cross purposes with my own.
french: Un héroïsme... qui pourrait bien n'être pas aligné avec mes propres objectifs.
russian: И этот героизм... может противоречить моим планам.
bulgarian: Heroism... that may be at cross purposes with my own.

english: Better to influence the child now. With a gift, perhaps?
french: Mieux vaut influencer cet enfant dès maintenant. Avec un cadeau, peut-être ?
russian: Лучше склонить её в правильную сторону, пока она ребёнок. Возможно, с помощью подарка?
bulgarian: Better to influence the child now. With a gift, perhaps?

english: I have heard she likes... swords.
french: J'ai entendu dire qu'elle aimait... les épées.
russian: Я слышала, ей нравятся... мечи.
bulgarian: I have heard she likes... swords.

english: The rambunctious child, Dell... she is of concern to me.
french: Dell, l'enfant remuante... elle me préoccupe.
russian: Эта неугомонная девчонка, Делл... меня весьма беспокоит.
bulgarian: The rambunctious child, Dell... she is of concern to me.

english: I find it irksome that he does not trust me.
french: Je trouve irritant qu'il ne me fasse pas confiance.
russian: Меня раздражает его недоверие.
bulgarian: I find it irksome that he does not trust me.

english: Though I suppose it is only natural to be protective of one's sworn lady.
french: Même s'il est sans doute bien naturel pour lui de protéger la dame qu'il sert.
russian: Хотя, полагаю, это естественное стремление оберегать свою госпожу.
bulgarian: Though I suppose it is only natural to be protective of one's sworn lady.

english: Would you not agree, [Ari]?
french: N'es-tu pas d'accord, [Ari] ?
russian:
Ты

согласны

согласнасогласенсогласно, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Would you not agree, [Ari]?

english: My disciple's familiar, Dozy...
french: Dozy, l'animal de compagnie de ma disciple...
russian: Фамильяр моей послушницы, Дрёма...
bulgarian: My disciple's familiar, Dozy...

english: To see him scrabbling in the dust, searching for scraps of history...
french: Le voir fouiller la poussière à tâtons, à la recherche de morceaux d'histoire...
russian: Я видела, как он копается в пыли, разыскивая крупицы истории...
bulgarian: To see him scrabbling in the dust, searching for scraps of history...

english: It is unbecoming.
french: C'est inconvenant.
russian: Это совершенно не подобает его положению.
bulgarian: It is unbecoming.

english: Do not mention my hoard of treasures to him.
french: N'évoque pas avec lui mes trésors accumulés.
russian: Не упоминай при нём мою гору сокровищ.
bulgarian: Do not mention my hoard of treasures to him.

english: I know his type. He would become insufferable.
french: Je connais ce genre de personnes. Il deviendrait insupportable.
russian: Я таких знаю: он станет назойлив, как муха.
bulgarian: I know his type. He would become insufferable.

english: The highborn boy... Eiland.
french: Le jeune homme de haute naissance... Eiland.
russian: Тот высокородный юноша... Эйланд.
bulgarian: The highborn boy... Eiland.

english: He seems to possess great physical strength.
french: Il semble doté d'une grande force.
russian: Как я вижу, обладает солидной физической силой.
bulgarian: He seems to possess great physical strength.

english: For an academic to take on such a form, especially at his age...
french: Pour qu'un homme de savoir ait ce physique, surtout à son âge...
russian: Для исследователя необычно иметь такое телосложение — особенно в его летах...
bulgarian: For an academic to take on such a form, especially at his age...

english: The tomes of this era must be quite heavy.
french: C'est que les livres d'aujourd'hui doivent peser très lourd.
russian: Вероятно, научные тома в эту эпоху весьма тяжелы.
bulgarian: The tomes of this era must be quite heavy.

english: That ursine scholar, Errol...
french: Errol, l'érudit mal léché...
russian: Этот здоровяк-учёный, Эррол...
bulgarian: That ursine scholar, Errol...

english: I've seen him speaking with his beasts, coddling them as if they were his own young.
french: Je l'ai vu parler à ses animaux, les choyer comme s'ils étaient ses propres petits.
russian: Я видела, как он общается со зверьми и нянчится, будто с собственным потомством.
bulgarian: I've seen him speaking with his beasts, coddling them as if they were his own young.

english: His blood is old... perhaps the oldest I have encountered in Mistria, where mortals are concerned.
french: Il est d'un sang ancien, sans doute le plus ancien de ceux que j'ai croisés à Mistria, parmi les mortels.
russian: У него богатая родословная... Возможно, самая древняя в Мистрии, если считать среди смертных.
bulgarian: His blood is old... perhaps the oldest I have encountered in Mistria, where mortals are concerned.

english: It seems that old blood does not amount to much these days.
french: On dirait que l'ancienneté du sang ne veuille plus dire grand-chose, à l'époque actuelle.
russian: Видимо, в нынешнее время родословная ничего не значит...
bulgarian: It seems that old blood does not amount to much these days.

english: The tall farmer, Hayden...
french: Hayden, le fermier de grande taille...
russian: Насчёт высокого фермера, Хейдена...
bulgarian: The tall farmer, Hayden...

english: However...
french: En revanche...
russian: И всё же...
bulgarian: However...

english: The vintage $Red Wine$ in his cellar is... acceptable. So I will allow him the fiefdom of his bar.
french: Le vieux $vin rouge$ de sa cave est... passable. Je lui accorde donc son établissement en fief.
russian: Выдержанное $красное вино$ из его погреба... приемлемо. Так что я позволю ему сохранить его барный надел.
bulgarian: The vintage $Red Wine$ in his cellar is... acceptable. So I will allow him the fiefdom of his bar.

english: For now.
french: Pour l'instant.
russian: Пока что.
bulgarian: For now.

english: The barman, Hemlock... I do not trust him nor his smiling demeanor.
french: Hemlock, celui qui tient la taverne... Je ne lui fais pas confiance, pas plus qu'à son attitude souriante.
russian: Здешний бармен Хемлок... Я не доверяю ни ему, ни его улыбчивой обходительности.
bulgarian: The barman, Hemlock... I do not trust him nor his smiling demeanor.

english: But when I see one with talent, I cannot help but speculate at their potential.
french: Mais quand je vois quelqu'un de talentueux, je ne peux m'empêcher de spéculer sur son potentiel.
russian: Но когда я замечаю талант, удержаться и не воспользоваться им невозможно.
bulgarian: But when I see one with talent, I cannot help but speculate at their potential.

english: For instance, that prideful fowl, Henrietta... she is more clever than the average bird.
french: Par exemple, Henrietta, la poule ombrageuse... Elle est plus maligne que bien des volatiles.
russian: Например, эта горделивая курица, Генриетта... Она умнее обычных птиц.
bulgarian: For instance, that prideful fowl, Henrietta... she is more clever than the average bird.

english: Perhaps I can find a use for her.
french: Elle pourrait peut-être m'être utile.
russian: Возможно, я смогу найти ей применение.
bulgarian: Perhaps I can find a use for her.

english: No one suspects a chicken of espionage.
french: Personne n'irait soupçonner une poule d'espionnage.
russian: Никто не ожидает шпионажа от курицы.
bulgarian: No one suspects a chicken of espionage.

english: I made a promise that I would keep the peace, this time around...
french: J'ai fait la promesse de maintenir la paix, cette fois...
russian: Я обещала, что на этот раз буду поддерживать мир...
bulgarian: I made a promise that I would keep the peace, this time around...

english: Despite no aptitude for sorcery, his japes and wordplay seem to cause great pain to those around him.
french: Bien qu'il n'ait pas d'aptitude pour la sorcellerie, ses blagues et jeux de mots semblent causer de la souffrance à son entourage.
russian: Хоть и не имеет чародейских наклонностей, способен причинять окружающим страдания своими словесными шутками.
bulgarian: Despite no aptitude for sorcery, his japes and wordplay seem to cause great pain to those around him.

english: A most delightful skill.
french: C'est une compétence délicieuse.
russian: Какое прелестное умение!
bulgarian: A most delightful skill.

english: In another life, I may have asked him to join my court.
french: Dans une autre vie, j'aurais pu lui demander de rejoindre ma cour.
russian: В другой жизни я, быть может, сделала бы его своим придворным.
bulgarian: In another life, I may have asked him to join my court.

english: The clever one, Holt...
french: Holt, le petit malin...
russian: Этот остряк Хольт...
bulgarian: The clever one, Holt...

english: She invites strangers into her home...
french: Elle invite chez elle des étrangers...
russian: Она приглашает незнакомых людей к себе домой...
bulgarian: She invites strangers into her home...

english: Then treats them as family? And feeds them, too?
french: Puis les traite comme s'ils étaient de la famille ? Elle les nourrit, aussi ?
russian: И обращается с ними как с семьёй? Да к тому же их кормит?
bulgarian: Then treats them as family? And feeds them, too?

english: If strangers dared to darken my door, it would cost them more than their coin.
french: Si des étrangers osaient frapper à ma porte, il leur en coûterait très cher.
russian: Если бы на мой порог ступила хоть тень незнакомца, он бы не отделался одним лишь золотом.
bulgarian: If strangers dared to darken my door, it would cost them more than their coin.

english: I do not understand the motivations of that innkeep, Josephine.
french: Je ne comprends pas les motivations de Joséphine, la tenancière de l'auberge.
russian: Мотивы Джозефины, хозяйки трактира, мне совершенно не понятны.
bulgarian: I do not understand the motivations of that innkeep, Josephine.

english: It pleases me greatly to find that my influence continues in this era.
french: Cela me réjouit grandement de constater que mon influence perdure à l'époque actuelle.
russian: Мне несказанно приятно, что мой авторитет имеет вес в эту эпоху.
bulgarian: It pleases me greatly to find that my influence continues in this era.

english: Adherents like yourselves are apostles of my legacy.
french: Des adeptes tels que vous êtes les apôtres de mon héritage.
russian: Благодаря таким последователям, как вы, сохраняется моё наследие.
bulgarian: Adherents like yourselves are apostles of my legacy.

english: Now if only we could convince Dozy to join your ranks.
french: Si seulement nous pouvions convaincre Dozy de rejoindre nos rangs.
russian: Вот если бы вы уговорили Дрёму вступить в мои ряды.
bulgarian: Now if only we could convince Dozy to join your ranks.

english: You see, he has not yet warmed to my presence.
french: Il continue d'accueillir ma présence avec froideur.
russian: Видишь ли, он до сих пор не свыкся с моим обществом.
bulgarian: You see, he has not yet warmed to my presence.

english: My dark disciple, Juniper...
french: Juniper, mon obscure disciple...
russian: Моя тёмная послушница, Джунипер...
bulgarian: My dark disciple, Juniper...

english: If he has truly been discharged from his work obligations, why does he not spend his days in leisure?
french: S'il a réellement été déchargé de ses obligations de travailleur, que ne passe-t-il ses journées à profiter de ce loisir ?
russian: Если он теперь свободен от рабочих обязанностей, то почему не живёт в своё удовольствие?
bulgarian: If he has truly been discharged from his work obligations, why does he not spend his days in leisure?

english: If I were him, I would become quite draconian in my demands. It is the right of the eldest and wisest.
french: À sa place, j'aurais des exigences draconiennes. C'est là le droit des plus âgés et des plus sages.
russian: У меня на его месте были бы драконовские требования. Таково право старших и мудрых.
bulgarian: If I were him, I would become quite draconian in my demands. It is the right of the eldest and wisest.

english: And I would know, as there are none elder nor wiser than me.
french: Et je sais de quoi je parle, personne n'est plus âgé ni plus sage que moi.
russian: Мне ли не знать: ведь я старше и мудрее всех на свете.
bulgarian: And I would know, as there are none elder nor wiser than me.

english: I do not understand the elder woodworker, Landen.
french: Je ne comprends pas Landen, le menuisier le plus âgé.
russian: Я не могу понять вашего пожилого столяра, Ландена.
bulgarian: I do not understand the elder woodworker, Landen.

english: I wonder if he has much experience tailoring with the bones of his enemies.
french: Je me demande s'il a de l'expérience dans le sur-mesure à partir des os de ses ennemis.
russian: Интересно, у него был опыт работы с костями заклятых врагов?
bulgarian: I wonder if he has much experience tailoring with the bones of his enemies.

english: Perhaps I can teach him a thing or two.
french: Je pourrais peut-être lui enseigner une ou deux choses.
russian: Возможно, у меня найдётся для него парочка советов.
bulgarian: Perhaps I can teach him a thing or two.

english: That exiled market clothier, Louis...
french: Louis, le confectionneur de vêtements en exil...
russian: Ваш заезжий суконщик, Луи...
bulgarian: That exiled market clothier, Louis...

english: It is a pity that he does not share his sister's grand ambitions.
french: Dommage qu'il ne partage pas les ambitions de grandeur de sa sœur.
russian: Жаль, что он не разделяет высоких устремлений своей сестры...
bulgarian: It is a pity that he does not share his sister's grand ambitions.

english: Still... some things crystallize with age. There is time yet.
french: Malgré tout, certaines choses cristallisent avec l'âge. Il a encore le temps.
russian: И всё же... какие-то вещи приходят с возрастом. Время ещё есть.
bulgarian: Still... some things crystallize with age. There is time yet.

english: The scholarly child, Luc. He is quite clever. And observant.
french: Luc, l'enfant studieux. Il est très malin. Et observateur.
russian: Люк — весьма эрудированное дитя. Он умён и наблюдателен.
bulgarian: The scholarly child, Luc. He is quite clever. And observant.

english: Do you not see her tremendous potential? Her capacity for merciless rulership?
french: Ne vois-tu pas son immense potentiel ? Sa capacité à devenir une dirigeante impitoyable ?
russian: Неужели ты не замечаешь её невероятный потенциал? Её таланты безжалостного правителя?
bulgarian: Do you not see her tremendous potential? Her capacity for merciless rulership?

english: It is a bit like seeing myself as a fledgling again.
french: C'est un peu comme si je me revoyais, enfant.
russian: Она немного напоминает меня саму, когда я только вылупилась...
bulgarian: It is a bit like seeing myself as a fledgling again.

english: It is rare for me to take on a pupil, but... perhaps it is time.
french: Il est rare pour moi d'accepter des élèves, mais... peut-être est-ce le moment.
russian: Я редко беру учеников, но... Возможно, это подходящий случай.
bulgarian: It is rare for me to take on a pupil, but... perhaps it is time.

english: Maple, child of ambition...
french: Maple est une enfant ambitieuse...
russian: Мэйпл, дитя амбиций...
bulgarian: Maple, child of ambition...

english: He was quite a thorn in your side, was he not?
french: Il a été particulièrement pénible avec toi, non ?
russian: Он тебе изрядно насолил, правда ведь?
bulgarian: He was quite a thorn in your side, was he not?

english: Do you wish for me to obliterate him?
french: Souhaites-tu que je le réduise à néant ?
russian: И ты не желаешь, чтобы я его испепелила?
bulgarian: Do you wish for me to obliterate him?

english: That prickly metalsmith, March...
french: March, le travailleur du métal susceptible...
russian: Этот колкий кователь Март...
bulgarian: That prickly metalsmith, March...

english: All things ought to be repurposed after they have lost their original function.
french: Tous les objets devraient trouver une nouvelle utilité après avoir perdu leur fonction initiale.
russian: Вещи, утратившие своё назначение, всегда необходимо приспосабливать к новому.
bulgarian: All things ought to be repurposed after they have lost their original function.

english: The bones of one's fallen foes, for example.
french: Les os des ennemis morts au combat, par exemple.
russian: Например, кости поверженных врагов.
bulgarian: The bones of one's fallen foes, for example.

english: Merri, the pretty tinkerer... she shows great sense, for a mortal.
french: Merri, la jolie brocanteuse... Elle fait preuve de beaucoup de bon sens, pour une mortelle.
russian: Мэрри, миловидная ремесленница... для смертного необыкновенно разумна.
bulgarian: Merri, the pretty tinkerer... she shows great sense, for a mortal.

english: Common sense and a cunning mind are not to be trifled with.
french: Il ne faut pas prendre à la légère un grand sens pratique associé à un esprit vif.
russian: Со столь рассудительным и находчивым человеком лучше не шутить.
bulgarian: Common sense and a cunning mind are not to be trifled with.

english: Nora, the stately merchantess. She is one to be mindful of.
french: Nora, l'imposante marchande. Elle mérite mon attention.
russian: Нора — весьма представительная торговка. Не стоит упускать её из виду.
bulgarian: Nora, the stately merchantess. She is one to be mindful of.

english: So malleable.
french: Tellement malléable.
russian: И такой услужливый.
bulgarian: So malleable.

english: In time, I am sure that I will find use for him.
french: Je suis sûre que le moment venu, je pourrais lui trouver une utilité.
russian: Уверена, рано или поздно я найду, как его использовать.
bulgarian: In time, I am sure that I will find use for him.

english: That friendly oaf, Olric. He is so earnest.
french: Olric, le sympathique nigaud... Il est tellement honnête.
russian: Этот приветливый осёл, Ольрик, такой прямолинейный.
bulgarian: That friendly oaf, Olric. He is so earnest.

english: What?
french: Comment ?
russian: Что?
bulgarian: What?

english: I was just testing this modern method of acquiring food called "take out".
french: J'ai simplement testé cette méthode moderne pour obtenir de la nourriture appelée « à emporter ».
russian: Я решила опробовать нынешний метод получения еды «навынос».
bulgarian: I was just testing this modern method of acquiring food called "take out".

english: I "took out" more food than I anticipated.
french: J'ai « emporté » plus de nourriture que prévu.
russian: И «вынесла» больше, чем рассчитывала.
bulgarian: I "took out" more food than I anticipated.

english: Here, have some $Crystal Berry Pie$ while it is still warm!
french: Tiens, prends un peu de $tarte aux baies de cristal$ pendant qu'elle est encore tiède !
russian: Вот тебе $пирог из кристальных ягод$, бери, пока тёплый!
bulgarian: Here, have some $Crystal Berry Pie$ while it is still warm!

english: Are you hungry, [Ari]?
french: As-tu faim, [Ari] ?
russian:
Ты

голодные

голоднаяголодныйголодное, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Are you hungry, [Ari]?

english: I detect a spark of earth magic within him. Perhaps he could develop it if he had the right teacher.
french: Je détecte en lui une étincelle de magie de la terre. Il pourrait la développer, s'il recevait l'enseignement adapté.
russian: Я обнаружила у него задатки магии земли. Возможно, он мог бы их раскрыть, если бы встретил подходящего наставика.
bulgarian: I detect a spark of earth magic within him. Perhaps he could develop it if he had the right teacher.

english: It is unfortunate his demeanor is so similar to that of Caldarus.
french: Quel dommage que son attitude soit si semblable à celle de Caldarus !
russian: Но увы: он ведёт себя, будто второй Кальдарус.
bulgarian: It is unfortunate his demeanor is so similar to that of Caldarus.

english: I can barely abide one of such a person, let alone two.
french: J'ai déjà du mal à tolérer une personne de ce genre, alors deux...
russian: Я едва выношу одного такого, а уж тем более двоих.
bulgarian: I can barely abide one of such a person, let alone two.

english: That quiet woodworker, Ryis...
french: Ryis, le menuisier très calme...
russian: Этот тихий столяр Риз...
bulgarian: That quiet woodworker, Ryis...

english: He will die by my hand.
french: Il périra de ma main.
russian: Когда-нибудь умрёт от моей руки.
bulgarian: He will die by my hand.

english: The impertinent chef from the Capital, Taliferro...
french: L'impertinent chef cuisinier venu de la capitale, Taliferro...
russian: Талиферро, этот столичный повар-наглец...
bulgarian: The impertinent chef from the Capital, Taliferro...

english: One glance at her speaks of many battles...
french: Au premier coup d'œil, on comprend qu'elle a livré de nombreuses batailles.
russian: С первого взгляда заметно, как много битв она прошла...
bulgarian: One glance at her speaks of many battles...

english: And the potential for many more.
french: Et qu'elle a le potentiel pour de nombreuses autres.
russian: И как много ещё может пройти.
bulgarian: And the potential for many more.

english: That august warrior, Terithia.
french: Terithia, l'auguste combattante...
russian: Что до благородной воительницы Теризии...
bulgarian: That august warrior, Terithia.

english: She is quite intelligent. It is a shame she lacks mana capacity.
french: Elle est très intelligente. Dommage qu'elle manque de mana.
russian: Она весьма умна. Жаль, что у неё нет магических талантов.
bulgarian: She is quite intelligent. It is a shame she lacks mana capacity.

english: With the right guidance, she may have been useful.
french: Bien guidée, elle aurait pu être utile.
russian: Её можно было бы использовать, наставив на нужный путь.
bulgarian: With the right guidance, she may have been useful.

english: The village physician, Valen...
french: La médecin de la ville, Valen...
russian: Ваша сельская врачиха, Вален...
bulgarian: The village physician, Valen...

english: It makes me wonder what other blades she is accustomed to wielding.
french: Je me demande quelles autres lames elle a l'habitude d'utiliser.
russian: Теперь я задумалась, какие ещё клинки ей знакомы.
bulgarian: It makes me wonder what other blades she is accustomed to wielding.

english: I shall have to inquire.
french: Il va falloir que je me renseigne.
russian: Следует у неё спросить.
bulgarian: I shall have to inquire.

english: The wandering coiffeuse, Vera. She utilizes a blade with much skill.
french: Vera, la coiffeuse itinérante. Elle manie son rasoir avec une grande habileté.
russian: Бродячая цирюльница Вера так искусно обращается с бритвой.
bulgarian: The wandering coiffeuse, Vera. She utilizes a blade with much skill.

english: Just today I saw that fellow Holt throw away half a box of cookies in a panic before his youngest daughter could discover him eating them.
french: Aujourd'hui, par exemple, j'ai vu ce type, Holt, jeter précipitamment une boîte de cookies à moitié pleine pour éviter que sa plus jeune fille le voie en manger.
russian: Только сегодня я видела, как Хольт в панике выбросил полкоробки печенья, чтобы его младшая дочь не увидела, как он его ест.
bulgarian: Just today I saw that fellow Holt throw away half a box of cookies in a panic before his youngest daughter could discover him eating them.

english: Spying on the townsfolk has been quite rewarding.
french: Espionner les habitants est assez enrichissant.
russian: Слежка за местными жителями даёт свои плоды.
bulgarian: Spying on the townsfolk has been quite rewarding.

english: I did not think a mortal could be as slimy as a sapling...
french: Je n'imaginais pas qu'un mortel puisse être aussi glissant qu'une anguille...
russian: Не думала, что смертные бывают скользкие, как слизянки...
bulgarian: I did not think a mortal could be as slimy as a sapling...

english: I stand corrected.
french: Je me trompais.
russian: Но он меня в этом убедил.
bulgarian: I stand corrected.

english: The charlatan, Wheedle...
french: Wheedle, le charlatan...
russian: Этот шарлатан Хлюст...
bulgarian: The charlatan, Wheedle...

english: Why does the large one take orders from the small one?
french: Pourquoi est-ce le petit qui donne des ordres au plus costaud ?
russian: Почему большой человек принимает указания от маленького?
bulgarian: Why does the large one take orders from the small one?

english: The rules of hierarchy have changed quite a lot since my imprisonment.
french: Les règles hiérarchiques ont beaucoup changé depuis mon emprisonnement.
russian: Законы командования весьма изменились за время моего заточения.
bulgarian: The rules of hierarchy have changed quite a lot since my imprisonment.

english: Look, there. At the dig site.
french: Regarde, là-bas. Sur le site de fouilles.
russian: Смотри, вон там, на раскопках.
bulgarian: Look, there. At the dig site.

english: He has been gesturing for me to come to the dig site, and I have been feigning misunderstanding.
french: Il me fait de grands gestes pour que je vienne sur le site de fouilles, et je fais semblant de ne pas comprendre.
russian: Он уже какое-то время мне машет, чтобы я подошла на раскопки. Я притворяюсь, что не понимаю его.
bulgarian: He has been gesturing for me to come to the dig site, and I have been feigning misunderstanding.

english: Is he still waving? Do NOT wave back.
french: Fait-il encore signe ? Surtout, ne lui réponds pas.
russian: Он снова машет? НЕ СМЕЙ махать ему в ответ.
bulgarian: Is he still waving? Do NOT wave back.

english: [Ari], is Eiland looking over here?
french: [Ari], est-ce qu'Eiland est en train de regarder dans notre direction ?
russian: [Ari], скажи, Эйланд сюда смотрит?
bulgarian: [Ari], is Eiland looking over here?

english: Or they are searching for Errol's keys again. It is difficult to say.
french: À moins qu'ils soient encore en train de chercher les clés d'Errol. Difficile à dire.
russian: Либо они снова потеряли ключи Эррола. Сложно сказать наверняка.
bulgarian: Or they are searching for Errol's keys again. It is difficult to say.

english: Eiland and Errol appear excited. It seems they have made a discovery.
french: Eiland et Errol semblent agités. On dirait qu'ils ont fait une découverte.
russian: Эйланд с Эрролом выглядят взволнованно. Должно быть, они что-то обнаружили.
bulgarian: Eiland and Errol appear excited. It seems they have made a discovery.

english: How lovely.
french: C'est charmant.
russian: Очаровательно!
bulgarian: How lovely.

english: Like tears of blood on the wind.
french: On dirait des larmes de sang emportées par le vent.
russian: Словно кровавые слёзы разносит по ветру.
bulgarian: Like tears of blood on the wind.

english: This rain of flower petals...
french: Cette pluie de pétales de fleurs...
russian: Настоящий дождь из лепестков...
bulgarian: This rain of flower petals...

english: It heralds the time when flowers wither on the branch...
french: Elle annonce la saison où les fleurs fanent sur les branches...
russian: Они предвещают время, когда цветы увянут на ветвях...
bulgarian: It heralds the time when flowers wither on the branch...

english: The beauty of these petals in the air...
french: La beauté de ces pétales dans le vent...
russian: Как красиво разлетаются по ветру лепестки...
bulgarian: The beauty of these petals in the air...

english: Such dramatics.
french: Quel comédien !
russian: Как драматично.
bulgarian: Such dramatics.

english: The sky weeps again.
french: Le ciel pleure de nouveau.
russian: Вновь рыдают небеса.
bulgarian: The sky weeps again.

english: The land looks as bleached as bone.
french: La terre semble aussi blanche que des ossements.
russian: Земля блестит, как выбеленная кость.
bulgarian: The land looks as bleached as bone.

english: The day after a snowfall...
french: Le lendemain d'une chute de neige...
russian: В день после снегопада...
bulgarian: The day after a snowfall...

english: What is its purpose, I wonder.
french: Je me demande à quelle fin.
russian: Интересно, для чего оно предназначено.
bulgarian: What is its purpose, I wonder.

english: Perhaps for battle practice. I, too, honed my bloodthirst at their age.
french: Peut-être pour s'entraîner au combat. Moi aussi, à leur âge, j'aiguisais ma soif de sang.
russian: Вероятно, для боевой тренировки. Я в их возрасте тоже пестовала свою жажду крови.
bulgarian: Perhaps for battle practice. I, too, honed my bloodthirst at their age.

english: I saw the children make a false man out of snow...
french: J'ai vu les enfants fabriquer un faux homme à partir de neige...
russian: Я видела, как дети мастерили из снега чучело человека...
bulgarian: I saw the children make a false man out of snow...

english: Flakes like ash, blanketing the earth after a conflagration of dragonfire.
french: Des flocons semblables au manteau de cendre qui recouvre la terre après l'incendie provoqué par le souffle du dragon.
russian: Снежинки накрывают землю, словно пепел после бушующего пламени дракона.
bulgarian: Flakes like ash, blanketing the earth after a conflagration of dragonfire.

english: This fall of snow puts me in mind of my precocious youth...
french: Cette chute de neige m'évoque ma prime jeunesse...
russian: Этот снегопад напоминает мне о прелестных временах моей юности...
bulgarian: This fall of snow puts me in mind of my precocious youth...

english: There is nothing else like it.
french: Elle est sans égale.
russian: Бесподобно!
bulgarian: There is nothing else like it.

english: Ah, the music of the maelstrom!
french: Ah, la musique du chaos !
russian: Ах, эта музыка в урагане!
bulgarian: Ah, the music of the maelstrom!

english: Then leave me. I am in conversation with the elements.
french: Alors, laisse-moi. Je suis en train de converser avec les éléments.
russian: В таком случае оставь меня. Я общаюсь со стихиями.
bulgarian: Then leave me. I am in conversation with the elements.

english: The thunder... do you hear it?
french: Le tonnerre... tu l'entends ?
russian:
Грянул гром... Ты

слышали

слышаласлышалслышало?
bulgarian: The thunder... do you hear it?

english: I expect no less from my most loyal follower.
french: Je n'en attends pas moins de <she>ma plus grande</she><he>mon plus grand</he><they>maon plus grand·e</they> disciple.
russian: Именно этого я и жду от своих вернейших соратников.
bulgarian: I expect no less from my most loyal follower.

english: You have braved the storm to seek my counsel.
french: Tu as bravé l'orage pour chercher conseil auprès de moi.
russian:
Ты

прошли

прошлапрошёлпрошло сквозь бурю, чтобы прийти ко мне за советом.
bulgarian: You have braved the storm to seek my counsel.

english: I will happily demonstrate it for you once the formulae are complete.
french: Je serai heureuse de t'en faire la démonstration une fois les formules achevées.
russian: С удовольствием продемонстрирую его тебе, когда завершу формулы.
bulgarian: I will happily demonstrate it for you once the formulae are complete.

english: I am working on a spell that turns blood to fire.
french: Je travaille sur un sort qui transforme le sang en feu.
russian: Я разрабатываю заклинание, способное превратить кровь в огонь.
bulgarian: I am working on a spell that turns blood to fire.

english: Even when he sought to stop me centuries ago, he could only seal me temporarily.
french: Même quand il a cherché à m'arrêter, il y a des siècles de cela, il n'a pu que me confiner temporairement.
russian: Даже столетия назад, когда он желал помешать мне, он смог лишь временно заточить меня.
bulgarian: Even when he sought to stop me centuries ago, he could only seal me temporarily.

english: If our positions had been reversed...
french: Si les rôles avaient été inversés...
russian: Если бы мы поменялись местами...
bulgarian: If our positions had been reversed...

english: Mistria's "sleeping dragon" would have remained just that.
french: Le « dragon qui dort » de Mistria ne se serait jamais réveillé.
russian: Мистрийский «спящий дракон» не проснулся бы никогда.
bulgarian: Mistria's "sleeping dragon" would have remained just that.

english: Caldarus and I have different approaches to magic.
french: Caldarus et moi avons des approches de la magie très différentes.
russian: Подход к магии у нас с Кальдарусом различается.
bulgarian: Caldarus and I have different approaches to magic.

english: It is quite accurate... Her determination is impressive.
french: Elles sont très précises... Sa détermination est impressionnante.
russian: У неё получилось весьма точно... Я впечатлена её усердием.
bulgarian: It is quite accurate... Her determination is impressive.

english: You see where I have verified her observations in purple?
french: Vois-tu, en rouge, les endroits où j'ai validé ses observations ?
russian: Видишь, я выделила фиолетовым места, где я подтвердила её находки?
bulgarian: You see where I have verified her observations in purple?

english: Once I have a full picture... oh, the possibilities are endless.
french: Quand j'en aurai une vision complète... Oh, les possibilités sont infinies.
