russian: Когда у меня будет полная карта... мне откроются безграничные возможности.
bulgarian: Once I have a full picture... oh, the possibilities are endless.

english: Juniper turned over her survey of Mistria's leylines to me.
french: Juniper m'a transmis ses recherches sur les lignes telluriques qui parcourent Mistria.
russian: Джунипер показала мне свои наблюдения за магическими жилами в Мистрии.
bulgarian: Juniper turned over her survey of Mistria's leylines to me.

english: I have taken on a mortal form, but my physiology is not like the other villagers...
french: J'ai adopté une forme mortelle, mais ma physiologie n'est pas la même que celle des autres habitants...
russian: Я приняла смертное обличье, но моя физиология не такая, как у остальных жителей...
bulgarian: I have taken on a mortal form, but my physiology is not like the other villagers...

english: The heat of the bath can sneak up on me. I would appreciate your assistance with regulating my body temperature.
french: La chaleur du bain peut me gagner insidieusement. J'apprécierais que tu m'apportes ton aide afin de réguler ma température corporelle.
russian: Жар в купальне может застать меня врасплох. Я желаю прибегнуть к твоей помощи в контроле температуры моего тела.
bulgarian: The heat of the bath can sneak up on me. I would appreciate your assistance with regulating my body temperature.

english: Come. The $Bathhouse$ awaits.
french: Viens. Les $bains$ nous attendent.
russian: Идём. $Купальня$ ждёт нас.
bulgarian: Come. The $Bathhouse$ awaits.

english: [Ari], I require companionship in the bath.
french: [Ari], il me faut de la compagnie dans le bain.
russian: [Ari], мне требуется сопровождение в ванной.
bulgarian: [Ari], I require companionship in the bath.

english: You will accompany me, of course.
french: Tu vas m'accompagner, cela va de soi.
russian: Разумеется, ты составишь мне компанию.
bulgarian: You will accompany me, of course.

english: I should like to visit the $Bathhouse$, [Ari].
french: J'aimerais visiter les $bains$, [Ari].
russian: Я желаю посетить $купальню$, [Ari].
bulgarian: I should like to visit the $Bathhouse$, [Ari].

english: It was enjoyable. I feel cleansed in mind and body.
french: Appréciable. Je me sens purifiée, dans mon corps et dans mon esprit.
russian: Приятным. Я чувствую очищение разума и тела.
bulgarian: It was enjoyable. I feel cleansed in mind and body.

english: And it would appear I have not lost my touch.
french: Et on dirait que je n'ai pas perdu la main.
russian: Как видно, этот навык я не потеряла.
bulgarian: And it would appear I have not lost my touch.

english: And now, you look radiant as the moon.
french: À présent, tu <he>es aussi radieux que</he><she>es aussi radieuse que</she><they>irradies comme</they> la lune, aujourd'hui.
russian: И теперь ты сияешь, как луна.
bulgarian: And now, you look radiant as the moon.

english: Stay there a moment. Allow me to admire you a while longer.
french: Reste là encore un peu. Laisse-moi t'admirer encore un moment.
russian: Постой ещё мгновение. Дай ещё полюбоваться.
bulgarian: Stay there a moment. Allow me to admire you a while longer.

english: I would hope you feel the same, [Ari]. You were very brave to trust me as you did.
french: J'espère que tu ressens la même chose, [Ari]. Il fallait du courage pour me faire confiance, comme tu l'as fait.
russian: Я надеюсь, что твои чувства сходны, [Ari]. С твоей стороны было очень смело мне довериться.
bulgarian: I would hope you feel the same, [Ari]. You were very brave to trust me as you did.

english: You mean when you washed my back?
french: Quand tu m'as frotté le dos, tu veux dire ?
russian:
Ты про тот момент, когда я

попросили

попросилапопросилпопросило потереть спину?
bulgarian: You mean when you washed my back?

english: Of course I trust you.
french: Bien sûr que je te fais confiance.
russian: Разумеется, я тебе доверяю.
bulgarian: Of course I trust you.

english: Yes. My claws are quite useful for exfoliating, if I use a light touch...
french: Oui, mes griffes sont un bon exfoliant, quand j'appuie très légèrement...
russian: Да. Мои когти — хороший инструмент для отшелушивания, если касаться осторожно...
bulgarian: Yes. My claws are quite useful for exfoliating, if I use a light touch...

english: But in the end, they are still the claws of a dragon. Your trust... was noted.
french: Mais cela reste des griffes de dragon, malgré tout. Ta confiance... a été appréciée.
russian: Но всё же это когти дракона. Твоё доверие... Я его запомню.
bulgarian: But in the end, they are still the claws of a dragon. Your trust... was noted.

english: Looking at you now... you are as radiant as the moon, today.
french: Quand je te regarde... <he>Je te trouve aussi radieux que</he><she>Je te trouve aussi radieuse que</she><they>Tu irradies comme</they> la lune, aujourd'hui.
russian: Сегодня я смотрю на тебя и вижу... Ты сияешь, как луна.
bulgarian: Looking at you now... you are as radiant as the moon, today.

english: Perhaps I will look at you a while longer.
french: Je vais peut-être continuer de te regarder un peu.
russian: Пожалуй, я посмотрю ещё.
bulgarian: Perhaps I will look at you a while longer.

english: Yes. It was... noted.
french: Oui. Je l'ai... remarqué.
russian: Хорошо... Я это запомню.
bulgarian: Yes. It was... noted.

english: It is easier to show than to explain the traditional draconic method of exfoliation.
french: Il est plus simple de montrer que d'expliquer la méthode traditionnelle des dragons pour l'exfoliation.
russian: Традиционный драконий способ отшелушивания кожи проще показывать, чем объяснять.
bulgarian: It is easier to show than to explain the traditional draconic method of exfoliation.

english: One's claws must be applied with the lightest pressure.
french: La pression appliquée par les griffes doit être extrêmement légère.
russian: Когти надо прикладывать с самым легчайшим нажимом.
bulgarian: One's claws must be applied with the lightest pressure.

english: Your companionship in the bath was...
french: Ta compagnie dans le bain a été...
russian: Твоё сопровождение в купальне было...
bulgarian: Your companionship in the bath was...

english: I expect you to take me again soon.
french: J'attends de toi que tu m'y emmènes de nouveau bientôt.
russian: Я рассчитываю на повторное приглашение.
bulgarian: I expect you to take me again soon.

english: I enjoy this Mistrian custom of bathing together. It is both relaxing and invigorating.
french: J'apprécie cette coutume mistrienne de prendre un bain ensemble. C'est à la fois relaxant et revigorant.
russian: Мне нравится мистрийский обычай совместного купания. Это одновременно расслабляет и наполняет силами.
bulgarian: I enjoy this Mistrian custom of bathing together. It is both relaxing and invigorating.

english: And I like you, as well.
french: Et je t'apprécie également.
russian: И нравится проводить время с тобой.
bulgarian: And I like you, as well.

english: It is only natural to combine the things one likes.
french: Il est tout naturel d'associer les choses que l'on apprécie.
russian: Вполне естественно совмещать эти вещи.
bulgarian: It is only natural to combine the things one likes.

english: Shall we go?
french: Nous y allons ?
russian: Пойдём же?
bulgarian: Shall we go?

english: I like walking along the shore and gazing at the primordial sea...
french: J'apprécie de marcher le long du rivage en contemplant l'océan primordial...
russian: Мне нравится прогуливаться по берегу и смотреть на первобытный океан...
bulgarian: I like walking along the shore and gazing at the primordial sea...

english: You will accompany me, of course.
french: Tu vas m'accompagner, cela va de soi.
russian: И ты непременно составишь мне компанию.
bulgarian: You will accompany me, of course.

english: I wish to gaze upon the sea again, [Ari].
french: Je souhaite contempler à nouveau la mer, [Ari].
russian: [Ari], я хочу вновь насладиться видами моря.
bulgarian: I wish to gaze upon the sea again, [Ari].

english: I am given to silences from time to time, so I thought I should make it clear:
french: Je suis parfois encline au silence, je me suis donc dit que je devais dire les choses clairement :
russian: Временами я подолгу молчу, так что я решила кое-что прояснить:
bulgarian: I am given to silences from time to time, so I thought I should make it clear:

english: [Ari], you...
french: Eh bien, [Ari]...
russian: [Ari], ты...
bulgarian: [Ari], you...

english: You are breathtakingly direct.
french: Tes propos sont si directs que j'en ai le souffle coupé.
russian: От твоей прямоты захватывает дух.
bulgarian: You are breathtakingly direct.

english: I did not tell you this in the moment, but when we stood in the sea breeze together...
french: Je ne te l'ai pas dit sur le moment, mais quand nous nous tenions ensemble face à la brise marine...
russian: Тогда я тебе не сказала, но когда мы вдвоём стояли, овеваемые морским бризом...
bulgarian: I did not tell you this in the moment, but when we stood in the sea breeze together...

english: I closed my eyes and imagined we were flying, side-by-side.
french: J'ai fermé les yeux et imaginé que nous volions, côte à côte.
russian: Я закрыла глаза и представила, что мы с тобой летим бок о бок.
bulgarian: I closed my eyes and imagined we were flying, side-by-side.

english: I do not know what possessed me to fantasize about you in such a manner.
french: Je ne sais pas ce qui m'a pris de rêver de toi de la sorte.
russian: Не знаю, что заставило меня включить тебя в такие фантазии.
bulgarian: I do not know what possessed me to fantasize about you in such a manner.

english: But the thought makes my face warm.
french: Mais à cette pensée, mon visage s'est échauffé.
russian: Но от этой мысли моё лицо становится горячее.
bulgarian: But the thought makes my face warm.

english: Our time at the $Beach$... I quite enjoyed it.
french: Notre promenade sur la $plage$... Je l'ai beaucoup appréciée.
russian: Наша прогулка по $пляжу$... мне весьма понравилась.
bulgarian: Our time at the $Beach$... I quite enjoyed it.

english: And I would be pleased to know...
french: Et j'aimerais savoir...
russian: И я бы хотела узнать...
bulgarian: And I would be pleased to know...

english: What is it that draws you most to the shore, [Ari]?
french: Qu'est-ce qui t'attire le plus, sur le rivage, [Ari] ?
russian: Чем морской берег привлекает тебя, [Ari]?
bulgarian: What is it that draws you most to the shore, [Ari]?

english: The sights, smells and sounds...
french: La vue, les odeurs et les sons...
russian: Видами, запахами, звуками...
bulgarian: The sights, smells and sounds...

english: Sharing the experience with you.
french: Partager cette expérience avec toi.
russian: Возможностью побыть с тобой.
bulgarian: Sharing the experience with you.

english: The sensory experience. Yes.
french: L'expérience sensorielle. Oui.
russian: Чувственный опыт. Понимаю.
bulgarian: The sensory experience. Yes.

english: I did not tell you this in the moment, but when we stood in the sea breeze together...
french: Je ne te l'ai pas dit sur le moment, mais quand nous nous tenions ensemble face à la brise marine...
russian: Тогда я тебе не сказала, но когда мы вдвоём стояли, овеваемые морским бризом...
bulgarian: I did not tell you this in the moment, but when we stood in the sea breeze together...

english: I closed my eyes and imagined we were flying, side-by-side.
french: J'ai fermé les yeux et imaginé que nous volions, côte à côte.
russian: Я закрыла глаза и представила, что мы с тобой летим бок о бок.
bulgarian: I closed my eyes and imagined we were flying, side-by-side.

english: I do not know what possessed me to fantasize about you in such a manner.
french: Je ne sais pas ce qui m'a pris de rêver de toi de la sorte.
russian: Не знаю, что заставило меня включить тебя в такие фантазии.
bulgarian: I do not know what possessed me to fantasize about you in such a manner.

english: But the thought makes my face warm.
french: Mais à cette pensée, mon visage s'est échauffé.
russian: Но от этой мысли моё лицо становится горячее.
bulgarian: But the thought makes my face warm.

english: [Ari].
french: [Ari].
russian: [Ari].
bulgarian: [Ari].

english: I would walk the shore with you again in a wingbeat.
french: En un clin d'œil, je marcherais à nouveau sur la plage en ta compagnie.
russian: И я готова снова пройтись с тобой по пляжу, стоит лишь махнуть крылом.
bulgarian: I would walk the shore with you again in a wingbeat.

english: You need but ask, and I shall join you.
french: Il te suffit de me le demander et je me joindrai à toi.
russian: Только скажи, и я пойду с тобой.
bulgarian: You need but ask, and I shall join you.

english: I was thinking about our $Date$...
french: Je repensais à notre $rendez-vous$...
russian: Я вспоминала наше $свидание$...
bulgarian: I was thinking about our $Date$...

english: You fill a little basket with morsels? And then carry it into the wilderness to devour it?
french: Tu emplis un petit panier de délices ? Puis tu l'emportes en pleine nature pour tout dévorer ?
russian: Надо наполнить маленькую корзинку яствами? А затем отправиться в лес и там поглотить их?
bulgarian: You fill a little basket with morsels? And then carry it into the wilderness to devour it?

english: I see. A picnic is a kind of survival exercise.
french: Je vois. Un pique-nique est une sorte d'exercice de survie.
russian: Понятно. Значит, пикник — это тренировка выживания.
bulgarian: I see. A picnic is a kind of survival exercise.

english: And you wish to conduct this exercise in the $Deep Woods$? Inside of enemy territory?
french: Et tu souhaites mener cet exercice à $Boissombre$ ? En plein territoire ennemi ?
russian: И ты хочешь провести его в $глубокой чаще$? Вблизи от стана врага?
bulgarian: And you wish to conduct this exercise in the $Deep Woods$? Inside of enemy territory?

english: Something about this stirs my heart.
french: Il y a là quelque chose qui m'émeut.
russian: Эта мысль волнует моё сердце.
bulgarian: Something about this stirs my heart.

english: Yes. Let us... picnic.
french: Entendu. Allons... pique-niquer.
russian: Да... Давай сходим на пикник.
bulgarian: Yes. Let us... picnic.

english: Tell me more of this... picnic you speak of.
french: Dis-m'en plus... Ce pique-nique dont tu parles.
russian: Расскажи мне больше про этот... пикник, как ты говоришь.
bulgarian: Tell me more of this... picnic you speak of.

english: And it is my turn to fill the survival basket.
french: Et c'est à mon tour de remplir le panier de survie.
russian: И теперь мой черёд подбирать наш паёк для выживания.
bulgarian: And it is my turn to fill the survival basket.

english: Behold! The finest fare, liberated from the Inn.
french: Regarde ! Les mets les plus délicats, prélevés à l'auberge.
russian: Узри! Здесь лучшая провизия, что можно достать в трактире.
bulgarian: Behold! The finest fare, liberated from the Inn.

english: Now, let us go and find a secluded corner of the $Deep Woods$ to amuse ourselves.
french: À présent, allons trouver à $Boissombre$ un coin reculé pour nous amuser.
russian: А теперь пойдём искать в $глубокой чаще$ укромный уголок, забавы ради.
bulgarian: Now, let us go and find a secluded corner of the $Deep Woods$ to amuse ourselves.

english: It is time to embark upon another picnic, [Ari].
french: Le moment est venu de se lancer dans un autre pique-nique, [Ari].
russian: Пришла пора снова отправиться на пикник, [Ari].
bulgarian: It is time to embark upon another picnic, [Ari].

english: Let us pack our basket of rations and steal deep into enemy territory...
french: Préparons nos paniers de rations et enfonçons-nous loin en territoire ennemi...
russian: Давай наполним корзину провизией и прокрадёмся вглубь вражеской территории...
bulgarian: Let us pack our basket of rations and steal deep into enemy territory...

english: Yes. Let us picnic once more.
french: Oui. Retournons pique-niquer encore une fois.
russian: Да. Пойдём на пикник снова.
bulgarian: Yes. Let us picnic once more.

english: [Ari], I desire to feel the thrill of eating outdoors again.
french: Vois-tu, [Ari], je désire éprouver à nouveau le frisson d'un repas en extérieur.
russian: [Ari], я желаю повторить наш захватывающий опыт еды на природе.
bulgarian: [Ari], I desire to feel the thrill of eating outdoors again.

english: I found it to be quite thrilling.
french: Elle m'a fait vibrer.
russian: Твоя идея пикника в $глубокой чаще$ приводит меня в волнение.
bulgarian: I found it to be quite thrilling.

english: I have never considered trespassing thusly to be a romantic exercise...
french: Je n'avais jamais envisagé qu'entrer ainsi sur une propriété privée puisse être un exercice romantique...
russian: Раньше я бы не подумала, что нарушение границ можно превратить в романтический опыт...
bulgarian: I have never considered trespassing thusly to be a romantic exercise...

english: But I am happy to be proven wrong.
french: Mais je suis heureuse d'avoir eu tort.
russian: Но я рада, что оказалась неправа.
bulgarian: But I am happy to be proven wrong.

english: Let us trespass again soon.
french: Retournons faire une nouvelle intrusion bientôt.
russian: Давай же скоро совершим новое вторжение.
bulgarian: Let us trespass again soon.

english: [Ari], as romantic activities go, your idea of a picnic in the $Deep Woods$...
french: Dis-moi, [Ari], en ce qui concerne les activités romantiques, ton idée de pique-nique à $Boissombre$...
russian: [Ari], что касается романтических встреч...
bulgarian: [Ari], as romantic activities go, your idea of a picnic in the $Deep Woods$...

english: To smuggle ourselves into the $Deep Woods$, so we might eat and amuse ourselves in secret...
french: Entrer en douce à $Boissombre$ pour pouvoir manger et nous amuser en secret...
russian: Проникнуть в $глубокую чащу$ и втайне отдыхать и вкушать пищу...
bulgarian: To smuggle ourselves into the $Deep Woods$, so we might eat and amuse ourselves in secret...

english: I look forward to the next one.
french: J'attends la prochaine avec impatience.
russian: С нетерпением жду следующей.
bulgarian: I look forward to the next one.

english: It makes me feel like a mischievous youngling again.
french: J'ai eu l'impression d'être à nouveau une jeunette malicieuse.
russian: Я снова чувствую себя юной проказницей.
bulgarian: It makes me feel like a mischievous youngling again.

english: Oh? Did you get up to a lot of mischief back then?
french: Oh ? Tu faisais beaucoup de bêtises, à l'époque ?
russian: Ого! А ты в детстве много проказничала?
bulgarian: Oh? Did you get up to a lot of mischief back then?

english: Me too. I like getting up to trouble with you.
french: Moi aussi. J'aime beaucoup semer le bazar avec toi.
russian: И я. Мне нравится безобразничать вместе с тобой.
bulgarian: Me too. I like getting up to trouble with you.

english: One might say that.
french: Je crois qu'on peut le dire.
russian: Да, можно так сказать.
bulgarian: One might say that.

english: But then I rose to power, and became the one who decides what mischief is. I suppose, at that point, the shine comes off.
french: Mais ensuite, j'ai été au pouvoir et je suis devenue celle qui décide de ce qui est une bêtise ou pas. Dès lors, cela perd de son attrait.
russian: Но затем я пришла к власти и стала сама решать, что считать баловстом. Тогда подобные забавы утратили шарм.
bulgarian: But then I rose to power, and became the one who decides what mischief is. I suppose, at that point, the shine comes off.

english: But you have reminded me of what I saw in such diversions, [Ari].
french: Mais tu m'as rappelé ce que je voyais dans de telles distractions, [Ari].
russian:
Но ты

напомнили

напомниланапомнилнапомнило, чем меня так привлекали подобные выходки, [Ari].
bulgarian: But you have reminded me of what I saw in such diversions, [Ari].

english: Provide me with more such diversions soon.
french: Offre-moi d'autres divertissements de ce genre.
russian: Надеюсь, скоро ты снова предложишь мне подобную затею.
bulgarian: Provide me with more such diversions soon.

english: Oho...
french: Oho...
russian: Хо-хо...
bulgarian: Oho...

english: You knew just what to say.
french: C'est précisément ce que j'avais envie d'entendre.
russian: Ты говоришь самые подходящие слова.
bulgarian: You knew just what to say.

english: You provide me with pleasing diversions, [Ari].
french: Tu m'offres de plaisantes distractions, [Ari].
russian: Мне нравятся затеи, которые ты предлагаешь, [Ari].
bulgarian: You provide me with pleasing diversions, [Ari].

english: I enjoyed our picnic, [Ari].
french: J'ai apprécié notre pique-nique, [Ari].
russian: Мне понравился наш пикник, [Ari].
bulgarian: I enjoyed our picnic, [Ari].

english: And I will turn the memory over in my mind until the next one.
french: Et je me le remémorerai sans cesse, jusqu'au prochain.
russian: И я буду любоваться этим воспоминанием до следующего раза.
bulgarian: And I will turn the memory over in my mind until the next one.

english: I enjoyed our picnic, [Ari].
french: J'ai apprécié notre pique-nique, [Ari].
russian: Мне понравился наш пикник, [Ari].
bulgarian: I enjoyed our picnic, [Ari].

english: I see...
french: Je vois...
russian: Что ж...
bulgarian: I see...

english: To cut away at the rough exterior of a natural form, to reveal its true potential...
french: Retirer la partie extérieure brute d'une formation naturelle afin d'en révéler le véritable potentiel...
russian: Разломить грубую оболочку природной формы, раскрыть внутренний потенциал...
bulgarian: To cut away at the rough exterior of a natural form, to reveal its true potential...

english: Such an activity sounds very much to my tastes.
french: Une telle activité semble très à mon goût.
russian: Такое занятие должно прийтись мне по вкусу.
bulgarian: Such an activity sounds very much to my tastes.

english: You know me well, [Ari]. Let us go.
french: Tu me connais bien, [Ari]. Allons-y.
russian: Ты хорошо меня знаешь, [Ari].
bulgarian: You know me well, [Ari]. Let us go.

english: You wish for my company... in re-shaping a gemstone?
french: Tu souhaites avoir ma compagnie... pour modifier la forme d'un joyau ?
russian: Ты хочешь, чтобы я составила тебе компанию... в изменении формы камня?
bulgarian: You wish for my company... in re-shaping a gemstone?

english: And I wish to assist you in growing your hoard...
french: Et je souhaite t'aider à accumuler ton propre trésor...
russian: И я хочу помочь тебе вырастить свою груду сокровищ.
bulgarian: And I wish to assist you in growing your hoard...

english: For a magnificent hoard is greatly attractive to a dragon such as myself.
french: Car de magnifiques richesses sont très attirantes pour un dragon tel que moi.
russian: Ведь впечатляющие сокровища весьма привлекательны для дракона.
bulgarian: For a magnificent hoard is greatly attractive to a dragon such as myself.

english: Come. Let us create a treasure together.
french: Viens. Créons un trésor ensemble.
russian: Идём. Будем вместе создавать драгоценности.
bulgarian: Come. Let us create a treasure together.

english: [Ari]. I desire once more to cut a gemstone together. Our previous undertaking was quite gratifying.
french: J'aimerais à nouveau que nous fassions de la taille de pierre ensemble, [Ari]. Notre précédente expérience a été très gratifiante.
russian: [Ari], я желаю вновь заняться совместной огранкой. Наша предыдущая попытка доставила мне немало отрады.
bulgarian: [Ari]. I desire once more to cut a gemstone together. Our previous undertaking was quite gratifying.

english: It was with our hands joined that we were able to create such a striking jewel...
french: C'est en unissant nos mains que nous sommes parvenus à créer un joyau aussi remarquable
russian: Только совместными усилиями у нас получилось создать такую потрясающую драгоценность.
bulgarian: It was with our hands joined that we were able to create such a striking jewel...

english: You have, of course, added it to your personal hoard?
french: Tu l'as, bien entendu, ajouté à ton trésor personnel, n'est-ce pas ?
russian:
Ты, безусловно,

добавили

добавиладобавилдобавило её в свою груду сокровищ?
bulgarian: You have, of course, added it to your personal hoard?

english: Of course, I'll treasure it!
french: Bien sûr, je vais le chérir !
russian: Конечно, я буду хранить её у себя!
bulgarian: Of course, I'll treasure it!

english: Right, I'll definitely never sell it!
french: Exact, je ne le vendrai jamais, c'est certain !
russian: Да, я точно никогда её не продам!
bulgarian: Right, I'll definitely never sell it!

english: Yes, good.
french: Oui, parfait.
russian: Отлично.
bulgarian: Yes, good.

english: It is in a dragon's nature to commit the story of every bauble in her hoard to heart.
french: Il est dans la nature d'un dragon de prendre à cœur l'histoire de chacune des babioles qui constitue son trésor.
russian: Запоминать историю каждой своей безделушки — такова натура дракона.
bulgarian: It is in a dragon's nature to commit the story of every bauble in her hoard to heart.

english: They do well to remind you of what has passed, and what is important.
french: Elles sont un bon moyen de se souvenir du passé et de ce qui importe.
russian: В них — лучшее напоминание о том, что было, и о том, что важно.
bulgarian: They do well to remind you of what has passed, and what is important.

english: Of course.
french: Bien sûr.
russian: Разумеется.
bulgarian: Of course.

english: However, gems are not the only type of hoard one can keep...
french: Cependant, les pierres précieuses ne sont pas les seules richesses que l'on peut conserver...
russian: Хотя помимо драгоценных камней бывают и другие сокровища...
bulgarian: However, gems are not the only type of hoard one can keep...

english: So do not hesitate to sell such tokens, if you have cause.
french: N'hésite pas à vendre ce genre de témoignage symbolique, si tu en as besoin.
russian: Так что не стесняйся продавать такие вещички, если на то будут причины.
bulgarian: So do not hesitate to sell such tokens, if you have cause.

english: I simply expect you to demand an exorbitant price for it.
french: J'attends simplement de toi que tu en exiges un prix exorbitant.
russian:
Я лишь прошу, чтобы ты

запрашивали

запрашивалазапрашивалзпрашивало невероятные цены.
bulgarian: I simply expect you to demand an exorbitant price for it.

english: In my many lives, I have never cut a gem in such an intimate setting.
french: Dans mes nombreuses vies, je n'ai jamais taillé de pierres dans un cadre aussi intime.
russian: Я прожила много жизней, но никогда не занималась огранкой в такой интимной обстановке.
bulgarian: In my many lives, I have never cut a gem in such an intimate setting.

english: To turn it into a unique, glittering treasure.
french: La voir se transformer en un trésor unique et scintillant.
russian: И как он превращается в уникальную сверкающую драгоценность.
bulgarian: To turn it into a unique, glittering treasure.

english: I look forward to our next foray together.
french: J'attends avec impatience notre prochaine tentative.
russian: Я уже жду, когда мы повторим этот опыт вновь.
bulgarian: I look forward to our next foray together.

english: It is most pleasurable to watch your hands manipulate the facets of a gemstone...
french: Regarder tes mains manipuler les facettes d'une pierre précieuse est très plaisant...
russian: Приятно было наблюдать, как твои руки управляются с гранями камня...
bulgarian: It is most pleasurable to watch your hands manipulate the facets of a gemstone...

english: When I was Queen, such invitations arrived with pomp and show.
french: Quand j'étais reine, de telles invitations me parvenaient avec force pompe et étalage.
russian: Когда я была королевой, такие предложения сопровождались пышными церемониями.
bulgarian: When I was Queen, such invitations arrived with pomp and show.

english: To be asked so directly, with no preamble...
french: Me le voir demandé aussi directement, sans préambule...
russian: Получить приглашение вот так просто и напрямую...
bulgarian: To be asked so directly, with no preamble...

english: I like it.
french: Cela me plaît !
russian: Да, мне нравится.
bulgarian: I like it.

english: Let us eat without pretext, [Ari].
french: Allons manger sans avoir besoin de prétexte, [Ari].
russian: Давай поедим вместе без церемоний, [Ari].
bulgarian: Let us eat without pretext, [Ari].

english: An invitation to eat at the $Inn$? With you?
french: Une invitation à déjeuner à l'$auberge$ ? Avec toi ?
russian: Ты приглашаешь меня поесть в $трактир$? Вдвоём?
bulgarian: An invitation to eat at the $Inn$? With you?

english: I would like to eat, and desire your company. You will accompany me to the $Sleeping Dragon Inn$.
french: J'aimerais manger et j'apprécierais ta compagnie. Tu vas m'accompagner à l'$auberge du Dragon qui dort$.
russian: Я желаю поесть в твоём обществе. Ты составишь мне компанию в $трактире «Спящий дракон»$.
bulgarian: I would like to eat, and desire your company. You will accompany me to the $Sleeping Dragon Inn$.

english: At least... that is my hope. It is your choice. What say you?
french: Du moins... c'est ce que j'espère. Le choix t'appartient. Qu'en dis-tu ?
russian: Во всяком случае... я надеюсь на это. У тебя есть выбор. Что скажешь?
bulgarian: At least... that is my hope. It is your choice. What say you?

english: Yes?
french: Oui ?
russian: Да?
bulgarian: Yes?

english: Then come, let us dine together.
french: Alors, viens, allons dîner ensemble.
russian: Тогда пойдём же, отобедаем вместе.
bulgarian: Then come, let us dine together.

english: Allow me to take a page from your book, [Ari], and speak directly.
french: Permets-moi de prendre exemple sur toi, [Ari], et de parler sans détour.
russian: [Ari], я воспользуюсь твоим примером и буду говорить прямо.
bulgarian: Allow me to take a page from your book, [Ari], and speak directly.

english: Will you join me, so I might satisfy both needs together?
french: Te joindras-tu à moi, afin que je puisse satisfaire ces deux besoins simultanément ?
russian: Составишь мне компанию, дабы утолить оба моих желания?
bulgarian: Will you join me, so I might satisfy both needs together?

english: Excellent. Let us go.
french: Parfait. Allons-y.
russian: Превосходно. Пойдём же.
bulgarian: Excellent. Let us go.

english: I hunger for sustenance, and company.
french: J'ai faim de subsistance et de compagnie.

Ты что,

спутали

спуталаспуталспутало облик этого клоуна с моим?
bulgarian: Have you mistaken that buffoon's visage for mine?

english: A new amusement for my hoard? I accept.
french: Une nouveauté pour enrichir mon trésor ? Je l'accepte.
russian: Занимательное пополнение моей груды сокровищ? Я согласна.
bulgarian: A new amusement for my hoard? I accept.

english: You have provided an interesting diversion, [Ari]. I will take it.
french: Tu m'as offert une distraction intéressante, [Ari]. J'accepte.
russian:
Ты

принесли

принеслапринёспринесло мне любопытное развлечение, [Ari]. Я заберу его.
bulgarian: You have provided an interesting diversion, [Ari]. I will take it.

english: With this, my hoard of tribute continues to grow.
french: Avec cela, mon trésor s'enrichit d'un tribut de plus.
russian: Итак, я продолжаю накапливать подношения.
bulgarian: With this, my hoard of tribute continues to grow.

english: Do bring me more of your trophies. It pleases me.
french: Apporte-moi d'autres trophées. Cela me plaît.
russian: Приноси мне ещё своих трофеев. Мне это по нраву.
bulgarian: Do bring me more of your trophies. It pleases me.

english: You have become an adept hunter, [Ari].
french: Tu te débrouilles désormais fort bien pour la chasse, [Ari].
russian:
Ты

стали

сталасталстало ловко охотиться, [Ari]!
bulgarian: You have become an adept hunter, [Ari].

english: Yes... I will make use of this in my rituals.
french: Oui... Je vais utiliser cela dans mes rituels.
russian: Да... Мне это точно пригодится для ритуалов.
bulgarian: Yes... I will make use of this in my rituals.

english: I do favor the dark flora of Mistria.
french: J'ai une préférence pour la flore obscure de Mistria.
russian: Тёмная флора Мистрии мне по нраву.
bulgarian: I do favor the dark flora of Mistria.

english: Yes... this is quite appropriate for one of my station. I am pleased.
french: Oui... Cela conviendra parfaitement à l'un de mes autels. Je suis ravie.
russian: Да... Поистине достойно моего положения. Я довольна.
bulgarian: Yes... this is quite appropriate for one of my station. I am pleased.

english: Oh... what an exquisite offering.
french: Oh... Quelle ravissante offrande !
russian: О... Какое изысканное подношение.
bulgarian: Oh... what an exquisite offering.

english: You are most attentive.
french: Tu fais preuve d'une grande attention.
russian:
Ты превосходно

внимательны

внимательнавнимателенвнимательно.
bulgarian: You are most attentive.

english: I see that you have done well observing my predilections...
french: Je vois que tu as observé de près mes préférences...
russian:
Вижу, ты внимательно

изучили

изучилаизучилизучило мои пристрастия...
bulgarian: I see that you have done well observing my predilections...

english: But to receive this gift directly from your hands... I find it all the more pleasing.
french: Mais recevoir ce présent de tes mains... Cela est d'autant plus agréable.
russian: Но получить этот подарок прямо из твоих рук... ощущается ещё приятнее.
bulgarian: But to receive this gift directly from your hands... I find it all the more pleasing.

english: There was a time when such tribute would be offered at an altar.
french: Il fut un temps où un tel tribut aurait été une offrande posée sur un autel.
russian: В былые времена подобные подношения делались на алтаре.
bulgarian: There was a time when such tribute would be offered at an altar.

english: It is pleasing to receive such fine evidence of its persistence.
french: Il est plaisant de voir que cet art perdure en recevant une preuve aussi raffinée.
russian: Приятно видеть столь искусное доказательство, что она ещё жива.
bulgarian: It is pleasing to receive such fine evidence of its persistence.

english: Most impressive. Dragon-forging has become a rarified art form...
french: Très impressionnant. La forge-dragon est devenue une forme d'art extrêmement rare...
russian: Выдающаяся работа. Драконья ковка стала крайне редкой формой искусства...
bulgarian: Most impressive. Dragon-forging has become a rarified art form...

english: I will enjoy this indulgence.
french: Je vais savourer ce petit plaisir.
russian: Я побалую свои слабости.
bulgarian: I will enjoy this indulgence.

english: What a delectable morsel.
french: Quelle nourriture délectable !
russian: Лакомый кусочек!
bulgarian: What a delectable morsel.

english: Especially one that once formed a monster. Thank you.
french: Surtout s'il constituait précédemment un monstre. Merci.
russian: Особенно, если раньше он был монстром. Спасибо.
bulgarian: Especially one that once formed a monster. Thank you.

english: Wonderful. A perfect cube of stone has many uses.
french: Magnifique. Un cube de pierre parfait a de nombreux usages.
russian: Чудесно. Идеальный каменный куб полезен в самых разных областях.
bulgarian: Wonderful. A perfect cube of stone has many uses.

english: A charming confection. I do hope you hunted the monstrous ingredients yourself.
french: Quelle ravissante réalisation ! J'espère vraiment que tu as toi-même chassé les ingrédients issus de monstres.
russian: Миленькое лакомство. Надеюсь, все ингредиенты добыты в охоте лично тобой.
bulgarian: A charming confection. I do hope you hunted the monstrous ingredients yourself.

english: I am pleased their cuteness also compels you to squish them into oblivion.
french: Je suis ravie de voir que toi aussi, leur mignonnerie te pousse à les écrabouiller.
russian: Приятно, что эта миловидность побуждает тебя растоптать их в клочья.
bulgarian: I am pleased their cuteness also compels you to squish them into oblivion.

english: The $Saplings$ of the Mines have such a charming visage...
french: Les $jeunes pousses$ des mines ont un visage si mignon...
russian: У $слизянок$ в шахтах такое очаровательное личико...
bulgarian: The $Saplings$ of the Mines have such a charming visage...

english: A fine trophy. Well done.
french: Joli trophée. Bravo.
russian: Это хороший трофей. Отличная работа.
bulgarian: A fine trophy. Well done.

english: You have been hunting $Stalagmites$ in the depths of the Mines, I see.
french: Tu as chassé des $stalagmiteux$ dans les profondeurs des mines, à ce que je vois.
russian:
Вижу, ты

охотились

охотиласьохотилсяохотилось на $сталагмитов$ в глубинах шахт...
bulgarian: You have been hunting $Stalagmites$ in the depths of the Mines, I see.

english: I do not understand why this concoction is not more popular...
french: Je ne comprends pas pourquoi cette préparation n'est pas plus populaire...
russian: Не понимаю, почему это варево так непопулярно...
bulgarian: I do not understand why this concoction is not more popular...

english: For it tastes of the defeat of one's enemies.
french: Elle a le goût de la défaite de l'ennemi.
russian: Ведь оно несёт вкус поверженных врагов.
bulgarian: For it tastes of the defeat of one's enemies.

english: A delightful treat, this =Monster Mash=.
french: C'est un vrai régal, cette =bouillie de monstre=.
russian: Эта =монстрокаша= — замечательное лакомство.
bulgarian: A delightful treat, this =Monster Mash=.

english: A most useful prize. Thank you.
french: C'est une récompense très utile. Merci.
russian: Это очень полезный трофей. Спасибо.
bulgarian: A most useful prize. Thank you.

english: You must have defeated a $Mushroom$ of the Mines to harvest these spores.
french: Tu as dû vaincre un $méchampignon$ pour récolter ces spores.
russian: Чтобы собрать эти споры, тебе, вероятно, пришлось сразить $гриб$ в шахтах.
bulgarian: You must have defeated a $Mushroom$ of the Mines to harvest these spores.

english: This will make a fine pauldron. My thanks, [Ari].
french: Voilà qui fera une belle épaulière. Je te remercie, [Ari].
russian: Отлично подойдёт мне в качестве наплечника. Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: This will make a fine pauldron. My thanks, [Ari].

english: The shell of a Monster from the Mines...
french: La carapace d'un monstre des mines...
russian: Панцирь монстра из шахт...
bulgarian: The shell of a Monster from the Mines...

english: They are not true cats, but still shed whiskers. I find such a facsimile charming. Thank you.
french: Ce ne sont pas de véritables chats, mais ils perdent néanmoins des moustaches. Je trouve cette copie charmante. Merci.
russian: Это не настоящие кошки, но из них всё равно выпадают усики. На мой взгляд, очаровательное подражание. Спасибо.
bulgarian: They are not true cats, but still shed whiskers. I find such a facsimile charming. Thank you.

english: So you have encountered the inchoate felines of the Mines.
french: Tu as donc rencontré les félins inachevés des mines.
russian:
Вижу, ты

встретили

встретилавстретилвстретило в шахтах зарождающихся кошачьих.
bulgarian: So you have encountered the inchoate felines of the Mines.

english: Yes... this has potential. Thank you.
french: Oui... Il y a là du potentiel. Merci.
russian: Да... я уже вижу потенциал. Спасибо.
bulgarian: Yes... this has potential. Thank you.

english: A =Monster Wing= from Mistria's depths makes a fine magical ingredient.
french: Une =aile de monstre= issue des profondeurs de Mistria constitue un bon ingrédient magique.
russian: =Крыло монстра= из мистрийских подземелий — отличный ингредиент для колдовства.
bulgarian: A =Monster Wing= from Mistria's depths makes a fine magical ingredient.

english: A gift? I see.
french: Un cadeau ? Je vois.
russian: Это подарок? Ладно.
bulgarian: A gift? I see.

english: Your gift does not displease me, [Ari].
french: Ton présent ne me déplaît pas, [Ari].
russian: Твой подарок мне не противен, [Ari].
bulgarian: Your gift does not displease me, [Ari].

english: Is this an offering? Interesting.
french: Est-ce une offrande ? Intéressant.
russian: Это такое подношение? Занимательно.
bulgarian: Is this an offering? Interesting.

english: And I am drawn to things that flourish in darkness. Thank you.
french: Et je suis attirée par tout ce qui fleurit dans l'obscurité. Merci.
russian: Меня манят вещи, способные расцветать во тьме. Спасибо.
bulgarian: And I am drawn to things that flourish in darkness. Thank you.

english: The =Night Queen= is as beautiful as it is rare...
french: La =fleur de lune= est aussi belle que rare...
russian: =Царица ночи= так прекрасна и так редка...
bulgarian: The =Night Queen= is as beautiful as it is rare...

english: And so, worthy of me.
french: Et par conséquent, digne de moi.
russian: И потому он меня достоин.
bulgarian: And so, worthy of me.

english: Rarer than gold, hard as diamond, and a superb conduit for magic... =Perfect Mistril= is queen of the earth's riches.
french: Plus rare que l'or, dur comme le diamant et excellent conducteur de magie... Le =mistril pur= est le roi des richesses de la terre.
russian: Ещё реже золота, твёрдый, как алмаз, и превосходный проводник магии... Среди всех богатств земли =идеальный мистрил= — это королева.
bulgarian: Rarer than gold, hard as diamond, and a superb conduit for magic... =Perfect Mistril= is queen of the earth's riches.

english: This will make a fine addition to my hoard.
french: Voilà qui fera un bel ajout à mon trésor.
russian: Это будет прекрасным пополнением моей сокровищницы.
bulgarian: This will make a fine addition to my hoard.

english: I am not unmoved by things that sparkle brightly.
french: Je ne suis pas insensible à ce qui brille vivement.
russian: Соблазны блестящих вещиц мне не чужды.
bulgarian: I am not unmoved by things that sparkle brightly.

english: Sentimentality is unbecoming of a former queen, but... I do have an affection for these blooms.
french: Il est malvenu pour une ancienne reine d'être sentimentale, mais... j'ai de l'affection pour ces fleurs.
russian: Бывшей королеве не к лицу сентиментальность... Однако к этим цветам я питаю слабость.
bulgarian: Sentimentality is unbecoming of a former queen, but... I do have an affection for these blooms.

english: My worshippers once adorned my altars with garlands of =Plum Blossoms= strung together...
french: Ceux qui me vénéraient ornaient jadis mes autels avec des guirlandes de =fleurs de prunier= nouées ensemble...
russian: Когда-то мои последователи украшали мои алтари венками из =цветов сливы=.
bulgarian: My worshippers once adorned my altars with garlands of =Plum Blossoms= strung together...

english: It is a shame these are not poisonous... but I will still make use of it.
french: Il est dommage que ceux-ci ne soient pas empoisonnés... mais j'en ferai néanmoins usage.
russian: Жаль, что они не ядовиты...Но я всё равно найду им применение.
bulgarian: It is a shame these are not poisonous... but I will still make use of it.

english: I do have a fondness for mushrooms from the deepest depths of the Mines.
french: J'ai un faible pour les champignons qui viennent du plus profond des mines.
russian: Я питаю слабость к грибам из самых глубин здешних шахт.
bulgarian: I do have a fondness for mushrooms from the deepest depths of the Mines.

english: They make for a dish complex in both flavor and history.
french: Elles donnent à ce plat une complexité à la fois dans ses saveurs et dans son histoire.
russian: Блюдо из них богато и вкусом, и историей.
bulgarian: They make for a dish complex in both flavor and history.

english: It pleases me to see they still grow in abundance after all these years.
french: Je suis ravie de voir qu'elles poussent encore en abondance après toutes ces années.
russian: Приятно видеть, что спустя столько лет они здесь так обильно растут.
bulgarian: It pleases me to see they still grow in abundance after all these years.

english: Ah, a pastry of $Queen Berries$...?
french: Ah, une pâtisserie aux $baies de la reine$...?
russian: Выпечка из $королевских ягод$?..
bulgarian: Ah, a pastry of $Queen Berries$...?

english: A most thoughtful tribute.
french: Quel tribut plein d'attention !
russian: Это очень любезное подношение.
bulgarian: A most thoughtful tribute.

english: These mushrooms are known to be rather poisonous.
french: Ces champignons sont réputés pour être assez toxiques.
russian: Эти грибы известны своей ядовитостью.
bulgarian: These mushrooms are known to be rather poisonous.

english: I will consume it... and combine its powers with my own.
french: Je vais le consommer... et combiner ses pouvoirs aux miens.
russian: Я поглощу его... и его сила соединится с моей.
bulgarian: I will consume it... and combine its powers with my own.

english: The echo of magic from the deepest mines emanates from this =Spell Fruit Parfait=...
french: L'écho de la magie qui règne au plus profond des mines émane de ce =parfait à l'amuse-papilles=...
russian: Это =волшебное парфе= источает отголоски магии из самых глубин подземных шахт...
bulgarian: The echo of magic from the deepest mines emanates from this =Spell Fruit Parfait=...

english: I was worshipped as a queen in those days, and all was my dominion.
french: J'étais à l'époque vénérée comme une reine, et tout ceci était mon domaine.
russian: В те дни мне поклонялись как королеве. Моё царство простиралось повсюду.
bulgarian: I was worshipped as a queen in those days, and all was my dominion.

english: How nostalgic!
french: Quelle nostalgie !
russian: Ах, какие воспоминания!
bulgarian: How nostalgic!

english: Ah! Statuettes such as this were carved at the height of my reign.
french: Ah ! Des statuettes comme celle-ci ont été sculptées à l'apogée de mon règne.
russian: А! Подобные статуэтки изготавливали на пике моего правления.
bulgarian: Ah! Statuettes such as this were carved at the height of my reign.

english: If every plant should thrive in darkness rather than sunlight... what an interesting world that would be.
french: Si chaque plante pouvait prospérer dans l'obscurité plutôt qu'à la lumière du soleil... Quel monde intéressant ce serait.
russian: Если бы все растения расцветали во тьме, а не под солнцем... получился бы такой занимательный мир.
bulgarian: If every plant should thrive in darkness rather than sunlight... what an interesting world that would be.

english: A perfect =Void Herb= specimen.
french: Un spécimen parfait d'=herbe du néant=.
russian: Превосходный образец =пустотной травы=.
bulgarian: A perfect =Void Herb= specimen.

english: That process creates this useful little bauble. How nice.
french: C'est ce procédé qui crée cette petite babiole bien utile. Elle est très jolie.
russian: Благодаря этому процессу получаются такие полезные бусины. Очень удачно.
bulgarian: That process creates this useful little bauble. How nice.

english: Occasionally when something mundane falls into the void, the void will calcify around it.
french: Il arrive parfois que quand un objet banal tombe dans le néant, ce dernier se calcifie autour de lui.
russian: Иногда обыкновенный предмет падает в пустоту, и она сгущается вокруг него.
bulgarian: Occasionally when something mundane falls into the void, the void will calcify around it.

english: I enjoy the flavor it adds to my concoctions.
french: J'aime la saveur qu'elle donne à mes préparations.
russian: Она придаёт моим отварам приятный вкус.
bulgarian: I enjoy the flavor it adds to my concoctions.

english: I do not recommend that you try it yourself, however.
french: Malgré tout, je ne te conseille pas d'y goûter.
russian: Но тебе я её пробовать не советую.
bulgarian: I do not recommend that you try it yourself, however.

english: Oh, good. I have need of =Void Powder= now and again.
french: Oh, très bien. J'ai parfois besoin de =poudre du néant=.
russian: А, отлично. Мне временами бывает нужна =пустотная пыль=.
bulgarian: Oh, good. I have need of =Void Powder= now and again.

english: This shall be useful to me, [Ari].
french: Cela me sera utile, [Ari].
russian: Я использую его в деле, [Ari].
bulgarian: This shall be useful to me, [Ari].

english: What a fine sample of =Void Stone=.
french: Quel bel échantillon de =pierre du néant= !
russian: Какой аккуратный экземпляр =пустотного камня=.
bulgarian: What a fine sample of =Void Stone=.

english: I remember when I had a whole troupe of musicians at my beck and call...
french: Je me rappelle quand j'avais une troupe de musiciens entière à ma disposition...
russian: Помню, в былые времена мне прислуживала целая труппа музыкантов...
bulgarian: I remember when I had a whole troupe of musicians at my beck and call...

english: Still, a $Song Crystal$ is much more convenient to listen to when you're in the bath.
french: Mais j'admets qu'il est bien plus pratique d'écouter un $cristal musical$ quand on est dans son bain.
russian: Но $поющий кристалл$ гораздо удобнее слушать, когда принимаешь ванну.
bulgarian: Still, a $Song Crystal$ is much more convenient to listen to when you're in the bath.

english: That bard, Zorel, is most talented.
french: Cette ménestrelle, Zorel, a un talent incroyable.
russian: Эта Зорель — весьма талантливый бард.
bulgarian: That bard, Zorel, is most talented.

english: Oh, not really.
french: Oh, pas vraiment.
russian: О, вовсе нет.
bulgarian: Oh, not really.

english: Er, well...
french: Euh, eh bien...
russian: Эм, ну...
bulgarian: Er, well...

english: I just thought it would be amusing if someone tried to touch it.
french: Je me suis dit que ce serait amusant si quelqu'un essayait d'y toucher.
russian: Я просто подумала: будет забавно, когда кто-нибудь решит его потрогать.
bulgarian: I just thought it would be amusing if someone tried to touch it.

english: I have taken it upon myself to set up a protective shock barrier on that piece of $Voidite$ in the Museum.
french: J'ai pris l'initiative de mettre en place une barrière de protection électrisée autour de ce morceau de $cristal du néant$, dans le musée.
russian: По собственному почину я решила окружить кусок $пустотита$ в музее стрекающим барьером.
bulgarian: I have taken it upon myself to set up a protective shock barrier on that piece of $Voidite$ in the Museum.

english: Is it that dangerous?
french: Est-ce si dangereux que cela ?
russian: Он настолько опасен?
bulgarian: Is it that dangerous?

english: That's so considerate of you!
french: Quelle gentille attention de ta part !
russian: Как заботливо с твоей стороны!
bulgarian: That's so considerate of you!

english: Well, as long as my good taste is still being admired.
french: Enfin, du moment qu'on continue d'admirer mon bon goût.
russian: Что ж, приятно, что мой изысканный вкус до сих пор в почёте.
bulgarian: Well, as long as my good taste is still being admired.

english: That $Worn Pendant$ at the Museum... it may have been mine, once upon a time.
french: Cet $ancien pendentif$ au musée... Il se peut qu'il m'ait appartenu, il y a fort longtemps.
russian: Тот $потёртый кулон$ в музее... возможно, когда-то давно был моим.
bulgarian: That $Worn Pendant$ at the Museum... it may have been mine, once upon a time.

english: Are you busy today?
french: Es-tu <he>occupé</he><she>occupée</she><they>occupé·e</they>, aujourd'hui ?
russian:
Ты сегодня

заняты

занятазанятзанято?
bulgarian: Are you busy today?

english: Do let me know if you have any interesting schemes planned.
french: Fais-moi savoir si tu as des stratagèmes intéressants prévus.
russian: Сообщи, если у тебя появятся коварные планы.
bulgarian: Do let me know if you have any interesting schemes planned.

english: [Ari], good morning!
french: Bonjour, [Ari] !
russian: [Ari], доброе утро!
bulgarian: [Ari], good morning!

english: Should you not be tending to your farm at this hour?
french: Ne devrais-tu pas t'occuper de ta ferme, à cette heure-ci ?
russian: Разве в этот час ты не занимаешься своей фермой?
bulgarian: Should you not be tending to your farm at this hour?

english: Or is my company just that appealing?
french: Ou est-ce ma compagnie qui t'attire autant ?

english: But the moment you are not, do not hesitate to declare it. I will call upon every one of my powers to ensure that you are happy and content.
french: Mais si cela venait à changer, tu devrais me le dire. J'utiliserai tous mes pouvoirs pour que tu ailles bien et que tu ne manques de rien.
russian: Но едва почувствуешь ухудшение, сообщай без утайки. Я сделаю всё, что в моей власти, чтобы обеспечить твоё благоденствие и уют.
bulgarian: But the moment you are not, do not hesitate to declare it. I will call upon every one of my powers to ensure that you are happy and content.

english: Tell me, [Ari]... how do you feel today?
french: Dis-moi, [Ari]... Comment te sens-tu, aujourd'hui ?
russian: Скажи мне, [Ari]... Как ты сегодня себя чувствуешь?
bulgarian: Tell me, [Ari]... how do you feel today?

english: I think the baby is getting bigger!
french: Je crois que le bébé grandit !
russian: По-моему, малыш растёт!
bulgarian: I think the baby is getting bigger!

english: My clothes are tighter, I think.
french: J'ai l'impression que mes vêtements me serrent.
russian: По-моему, моя одежда стала теснее...
bulgarian: My clothes are tighter, I think.

english: I'm feeling good today.
french: Je me sens bien aujourd'hui.
russian: Сегодня я чувствую себя хорошо.
bulgarian: I'm feeling good today.

english: Aha. I feel it. The baby has strong legs...
french: Ha ha. Je le sens. Cette enfant a de la force dans les jambes...
russian: А, я чувствую. Сильные ножки...
bulgarian: Aha. I feel it. The baby has strong legs...

english: Unless that was a punch? We will have to ask her once she arrives.
french: À moins qu'il se soit agi d'un coup de poing ? Il faudra le lui demander à son arrivée.
russian: Или это был кулак? Спросим у неё, когда она выползет.
bulgarian: Unless that was a punch? We will have to ask her once she arrives.

english: Oh, is the baby kicking? May I?
french: Oh, le bébé donne des coups de pied ? Je peux ?
russian: Ой, малыш пинается? Можно мне?
bulgarian: Oh, is the baby kicking? May I?

english: $Brid$. It is a strong name, is it not?
french: $Brid$. C'est un prénom qui inspire la force, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: $Брид$. Сильно звучит, правда?
bulgarian: $Brid$. It is a strong name, is it not?

english: Ah, but it is your decision. Draconic tradition calls for the expecting parent to select a name.
french: Ah, mais la décision t'appartient. Selon les traditions draconiques, c'est le parent qui porte l'enfant qui choisit.
russian: Но решение всё равно за тобой. Согласно драконьим традициям, имя выбирает беременный родитель.
bulgarian: Ah, but it is your decision. Draconic tradition calls for the expecting parent to select a name.

english: I will be happy with whatever name you choose.
french: Qu'importe le nom que tu lui donneras, je serai heureuse.
russian: Ты можешь выбрать любое имя, и я буду довольна.
bulgarian: I will be happy with whatever name you choose.

english: The baby... in my dreams last night, she visited me, and shared a name that she likes.
french: Notre bébé m'a rendu visite en rêve, la nuit dernière. Elle m'a fait part d'un prénom qu'elle aime bien.
russian: Наша малышка... Навестила меня ночью во сне и поведала, какое имя ей по нраву.
bulgarian: The baby... in my dreams last night, she visited me, and shared a name that she likes.

english: I will stay close to home, in the coming days... that way I will be here when I am needed. We will welcome her together.
french: Je ne m'éloignerai pas dans les prochains jours. Ainsi, je serai présente lorsque tu auras besoin de moi. Nous l'accueillerons ensemble.
russian: В ближайшие дни я не буду отдаляться от дома... Чтобы быть рядом, когда я нужна. Мы встретим её вместе.
bulgarian: I will stay close to home, in the coming days... that way I will be here when I am needed. We will welcome her together.

english: My dreams of our baby have grown more vivid... she will arrive soon.
french: Les rêves que je fais de notre enfant sont de plus en plus nets... Elle arrivera bientôt.
russian: Мои сны о ребёнке становятся всё яснее... она прибудет очень скоро.
bulgarian: My dreams of our baby have grown more vivid... she will arrive soon.

english: Despite her... disposition, Seridia is fiercely devoted to those she loves. You are obviously within that circle, and that now extends to your child.
french: Malgré son tempérament, Seridia est entièrement dévouée aux êtres qu'elle aime. Tu fais évidemment partie de ce cercle, tout comme votre enfant.
russian: Несмотря на её... специфический нрав, Серидия горячо преданна тем, кого любит. Ты, безусловно входишь в этот круг. А теперь он включает и ваше дитя.
bulgarian: Despite her... disposition, Seridia is fiercely devoted to those she loves. You are obviously within that circle, and that now extends to your child.

english: They will find no stronger protector.
french: Personne n'est mieux placé qu'elle pour assurer sa protection.
russian: Более могучего защитника для ребёнка не найти.
bulgarian: They will find no stronger protector.

english: And I will be sure to watch over them, as well.
french: Et moi aussi, je veillerai sur votre famille.
russian: И я тоже буду за ним приглядывать.
bulgarian: And I will be sure to watch over them, as well.

english: I have heard it said that you and Seridia are expecting a child... this is wonderful news.
french: J'ai entendu dire que Seridia et toi attendiez un enfant. C'est une merveilleuse nouvelle.
russian: До меня дошла весть, что вы с Серидией ждёте ребёнка... Это чудесное известие.
bulgarian: I have heard it said that you and Seridia are expecting a child... this is wonderful news.

english: I'm so excited to be an auntie again. I'm everyone's honorary auntie, after all!
french: J'ai tellement hâte d'être à nouveau tatie. Je suis un peu la tatie de tout le monde, ici !
russian: Я с радостью побуду тётушкой ещё раз. Знаешь, я весь всем тут почётная тётушка!
bulgarian: I'm so excited to be an auntie again. I'm everyone's honorary auntie, after all!

english: I hear you and Seridia are expecting? What marvelous news!
french: Il paraît que vous attendez un enfant, Seridia et toi ? Quelle excellente nouvelle !
russian: Я слышала, что вы с Серидией ждёте малыша? Какая восхитительная новость!
bulgarian: I hear you and Seridia are expecting? What marvelous news!

english: If Miss Seridia was a queen, that means your baby will be half queen, right?
french: Comme Seridia était reine, ça veut dire que votre bébé sera à moitié une princesse, non ?
russian: Если мисс Серидия была королевой, это значит, что ребёнок полу-королева, так ведь?
bulgarian: If Miss Seridia was a queen, that means your baby will be half queen, right?

english: When they get older, I'll invite them to join my royal entourage! I can't wait!
french: Quand votre enfant sera assez grande, je l'accueillerai dans ma cour royale ! J'ai hâte !
russian: Когда она подрастёт, я приглашу её в свою королевскую свиту! Уже хочу пригласить!
bulgarian: When they get older, I'll invite them to join my royal entourage! I can't wait!

english: I heard you and Miss Seridia are having a baby!
french: Il paraît que mademoiselle Seridia et toi allez avoir un bébé !
russian: Я слышала, что у тебя и мисс Серидии будет малыш!
bulgarian: I heard you and Miss Seridia are having a baby!

english: Just what the baby wanted.
french: C'est exactement ce qu'espérait le bébé.
russian: Именно это сейчас нужно малышу.
bulgarian: Just what the baby wanted.

english: Thank you, [Ari].
french: Merci, [Ari].
russian: Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari].

english: Oh, yes! This is just what I... ahem.
french: Oui ! C'est juste que je... hum.
russian: О, да! Именно этого мне... кхм.
bulgarian: Oh, yes! This is just what I... ahem.

english: To me, this is the most powerful, intimate magic that mortals know.
french: Pour moi, il s'agit de la magie la plus puissante et la plus profonde que les mortels connaissent.
russian: По моему мнению, это величайшая, самая сокровенная магия, известная смертным.
bulgarian: To me, this is the most powerful, intimate magic that mortals know.

english: It is humbling, and exhilarating.
french: Je ressens une très grande humilité et une très grande exaltation.
russian: Это поучительный и в то же время восхитительный опыт.
bulgarian: It is humbling, and exhilarating.

english: And I cannot wait to meet our little one. She is eager to meet us, [Ari].
french: J'ai hâte de faire la connaissance de notre enfant. Elle aussi est impatiente de nous rencontrer, [Ari].
russian: Я жду встречи с нашим чадом. А она ждёт встречи с нами, [Ari].
bulgarian: And I cannot wait to meet our little one. She is eager to meet us, [Ari].

english: To be a vessel for the cycle of reincarnation...
french: Être le réceptacle du cycle de la réincarnation...
russian: Cтать сосудом для цикла перерождений...
bulgarian: To be a vessel for the cycle of reincarnation...

english: The baby. She desires...
french: Notre bébé veut...
russian: Наше дитя. Ей необходимо...
bulgarian: The baby. She desires...

english: An $Ice Cream Sundae$. Immediately.
french: Une $coupe de crème glacée$. Immédiatement.
russian: Мороженое «сандей». Немедленно.
bulgarian: An $Ice Cream Sundae$. Immediately.

english: The baby does?
french: Tu es sûre que c'est notre bébé qui veut ça ?
russian: Это точно для неё?
bulgarian: The baby does?

english: Anything for you!
french: Tes désirs sont des ordres !
russian: Всё для тебя!
bulgarian: Anything for you!

english: I would never crave such a mundane, frivolous dessert.
french: Il n'est pas dans ma nature de désirer un dessert aussi banal et futile.
russian: Мне ни к чему столь прозаичный и фривольный десерт.
bulgarian: I would never crave such a mundane, frivolous dessert.

english: So yes. Do not disappoint the baby, [Ari].
french: Tu ne vas quand même pas décevoir notre bébé, [Ari].
russian: Так что да, для неё. Не расстраивай малыша, [Ari].
bulgarian: So yes. Do not disappoint the baby, [Ari].

english: Anything for the baby, you mean.
french: Non, les désirs de notre bébé sont des ordres.
russian: Ты хочешь сказать: всё для малыша.
bulgarian: Anything for the baby, you mean.

english: Well, no matter. I... we will await your return, sundae in hand.
french: Enfin, peu importe. J'attendrai... Nous attendrons ton retour, coupe de crème glacée en main.
russian: Впрочем, неважно. Я... Мы будем ждать твоего возвращения. И обязательно с мороженым.
bulgarian: Well, no matter. I... we will await your return, sundae in hand.

english: [Ari]. Listen to me very carefully.
french: [Ari], Écoute-moi attentivement.
russian: [Ari]. Слушай меня внимательно.
bulgarian: [Ari]. Listen to me very carefully.

english: It is not unexpected. The child of a dragon and a mortal is bound to be powerful, and so pronounced effects on the pregnancy are to be expected.
french: Rien de surprenant à cela. L'enfant d'un dragon et d'un mortel est forcément puissant. Il est logique que les désagréments de la grossesse soient plus prononcés.
russian: Этого следовало ожидать. Дитя дракона и смертного — могучее создание, так что резкие побочные эффекты при беременности естественны.
bulgarian: It is not unexpected. The child of a dragon and a mortal is bound to be powerful, and so pronounced effects on the pregnancy are to be expected.

english: In any other situation, I would use magic to remedy an illness... but the risks are not worth the relief.
french: Dans d'autres circonstances, j'aurais eu recours à la magie, mais il vaut mieux éviter tout risque pour si peu.
russian: В иной ситуации я бы прибегла к помощи магии, чтобы исцелить недуг... Но сейчас я не буду рисковать ради мимолётного облегчения.
bulgarian: In any other situation, I would use magic to remedy an illness... but the risks are not worth the relief.

english: Fear not. I will prevail... I have faced greater trials and felled stronger foes.
french: Ne t'en fais pas. Je survivrai. J'ai traversé des épreuves bien pires et vaincu des adversaires bien plus redoutables.
russian: Не бойся. Я всё вынесу... Я превзошла большие испытания и повергла более грозных врагов.
bulgarian: Fear not. I will prevail... I have faced greater trials and felled stronger foes.

english: Still. You must be extra nice to me today.
french: Ça ne doit pas t'empêcher d'être aux petits soins pour moi.
russian: Но всё равно будь со мной понежнее.
bulgarian: Still. You must be extra nice to me today.

english: I am experiencing a particularly acute wave of morning sickness, [Ari].
french: Mes nausées matinales sont particulièrement fortes aujourd'hui, [Ari].
russian: Я испытываю необычайно острый приступ утренней тошноты, [Ari].
bulgarian: I am experiencing a particularly acute wave of morning sickness, [Ari].

english: If this continues, I will need to commission new attire.
french: Si cela continue, je vais devoir m'en commander de nouveaux.
russian: Если это будет продолжаться, мне придётся заказать новый наряд.
bulgarian: If this continues, I will need to commission new attire.

english: Tell me, can Louis work with monster bones?
french: Dis-moi, Louis sait-il utiliser les ossements de monstres ?
russian: Скажи мне, умеет ли Луи работать с костями монстров?
bulgarian: Tell me, can Louis work with monster bones?

english: My clothes... have become tighter. Our baby grows.
french: Mes vêtements me serrent un peu. Notre bébé grandit.
russian: Моя одежда... ощущается тесно. Наш малыш растёт.
bulgarian: My clothes... have become tighter. Our baby grows.

english: Come here, [Ari]. Place your hand on my stomach.
french: Approche, [Ari]. Pose ta main sur mon ventre.
russian: Подойди, [Ari]. Положи руку мне на брюхо.
bulgarian: Come here, [Ari]. Place your hand on my stomach.

english: Do you feel it? She kicks powerfully... it is lucky I am strong enough to carry her.
french: Tu sens ? Elle a de la force dans les jambes... Heureusement que je suis assez résistante pour la porter.
russian: Ты чувствуешь её мощные удары?.. Хорошо, что я достаточно сильна, чтобы её выносить.
bulgarian: Do you feel it? She kicks powerfully... it is lucky I am strong enough to carry her.

english: The baby kicks.
french: Le bébé donne des coups de pied.
russian: Малыш пинается.
bulgarian: The baby kicks.

english: $Brid$. It is a strong name, is it not?
french: $Brid$. C'est un prénom qui inspire la force, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: $Брид$. Сильно звучит, правда?
bulgarian: $Brid$. It is a strong name, is it not?

english: Ah, but do not worry. While it is draconic tradition for the expecting mother to choose a name, I am not beholden to convention.
french: Ah, mais ne t'inquiète pas. Selon les traditions draconiques, le choix du nom revient à la maman qui porte l'enfant, mais je m'en moque.
russian: Но ты можешь не переживать. Согласно драконьим традициям, имя выбирает беременная мать, но я не связана обычаями.
bulgarian: Ah, but do not worry. While it is draconic tradition for the expecting mother to choose a name, I am not beholden to convention.

english: I will be happy with whatever name we decide upon together.
french: Qu'importe le prénom que nous choisirons ensemble, je serai satisfaite.
russian: Мы можем вместе выбрать любое имя, и я буду довольна.
bulgarian: I will be happy with whatever name we decide upon together.

english: The baby... in my dreams last night, she shared with me a name she likes.
french: Notre bébé m'est apparu en rêve, la nuit dernière. Elle m'a fait part d'un prénom qu'elle aime bien.
russian: Наша малышка... Навестила меня ночью во сне и поведала, какое имя ей по нраву.
bulgarian: The baby... in my dreams last night, she shared with me a name she likes.

english: Stay near, in the coming days... I would like to welcome her together.
french: Ne t'éloigne pas trop dans les jours à venir. J'aimerais que nous soyons ensemble pour l'accueillir.
russian: Не отходи далеко в ближайшие дни... Я хочу, чтобы мы встретили её вместе.
bulgarian: Stay near, in the coming days... I would like to welcome her together.

english: My dreams of our baby have grown more vivid... she will be arriving soon.
french: Les rêves que je fais de notre enfant sont de plus en plus nets... Elle va bientôt arriver.
russian: Мои сны о ребёнке становятся всё яснее... она прибудет очень скоро.
bulgarian: My dreams of our baby have grown more vivid... she will be arriving soon.

english: To meet again a soul we surely journeyed with before... it is a powerful, intimate type of magic.
french: Recroiser une âme avec laquelle nous avons sans doute voyagé par le passé, c'est une magie puissante et profonde.
russian: Вновь встретить душу, с которой бы без сомнения пересекались в прошлых жизнях... Это великая и сокровенная магия.
bulgarian: To meet again a soul we surely journeyed with before... it is a powerful, intimate type of magic.

english: I cannot wait to meet our little one, and for us to be reunited once more.
french: J'ai tellement hâte de rencontrer notre enfant, nous serons de nouveau ensemble.
russian: Я с нетерпением жду воссоединения с нашим малышом.
bulgarian: I cannot wait to meet our little one, and for us to be reunited once more.

english: To participate in the cycle of reincarnation...
french: Faire ma part dans le grand cycle de la réincarnation...
russian: Стать частью цикла перерождений...
bulgarian: To participate in the cycle of reincarnation...

english: I hope you are not troubled by hand-me-downs. We will have plenty of time to spoil our child later, when she has grown...
french: J'espère que tu n'as rien contre les objets d'occasion. Nous aurons bien le temps de gâter notre enfant lorsqu'elle sera grande...
russian: Надеюсь, тебя не смутит, если она будет донашивать вещи. У нас ещё будет возможность побаловать ребёнка, когда она подрастёт.
bulgarian: I hope you are not troubled by hand-me-downs. We will have plenty of time to spoil our child later, when she has grown...

english: In the meantime, she must make do with this golden rattle and jewel-encrusted onesie.
french: D'ici là, elle devra se contenter de ce hochet doré et de cette grenouillère incrustée de pierres précieuses.
russian: На первое время пускай довольствуется золотой погремушкой и комбинезоном с самоцветами.
bulgarian: In the meantime, she must make do with this golden rattle and jewel-encrusted onesie.

english: I have been sifting through my hoard, gathering things in anticipation of the baby's arrival.
french: J'ai passé en revue mes trésors afin de mettre de côté certaines choses avant l'arrivée du bébé.
russian: Я перебирала свои сокровища в поисках вещей, которые могут пригодиться ребёнку.
bulgarian: I have been sifting through my hoard, gathering things in anticipation of the baby's arrival.

english: I have been a mother in past lives, and I am comfortable in motherhood.
french: J'ai déjà été mère dans des vies antérieures, et la maternité ne me pose aucun problème.
russian: Я была матерью в прошлых жизнях, и материнство мне не чуждо.
bulgarian: I have been a mother in past lives, and I am comfortable in motherhood.

english: And [Ari], for what it is worth...
french: Et [Ari], d'après moi...
russian: И ещё, [Ari], я тоже тебе скажу...
bulgarian: And [Ari], for what it is worth...

english: Our daughter will adore you. I am certain of that much.
french: Notre fille va t'adorer. J'en suis persuadée.
russian: Наша дочь будет от тебя без ума. В этом я уверена точно.
bulgarian: Our daughter will adore you. I am certain of that much.

english: Yes. You are here, and you ground me.
french: Oui. Tu es là et tu me permets de garder les pieds sur terre.
russian: Да. Ведь ты рядом со мной и можешь меня успокоить.
bulgarian: Yes. You are here, and you ground me.

english: Together, with you... I think we can make her very happy indeed.
french: Ensemble, je crois que nous pourrons la rendre très heureuse.
russian: Вместе с тобой... Я верю, что мы сможем принести ей счастье.
bulgarian: Together, with you... I think we can make her very happy indeed.

english: But I am far from a perfect being, and there is a thought that nags at me.
french: Mais je suis loin d'être un être parfait et quelque chose me turlupine.
russian: Но я далека от совершенства, и одна мысль не даёт мне покоя.
bulgarian: But I am far from a perfect being, and there is a thought that nags at me.

english: Will I be able to live up to her expectations? This child summoned to the world by our love?
french: Saurai-je me montrer à la hauteur de cette enfant appelée à naître dans ce monde grâce à notre amour ?
russian: Смогу ли я соответствовать её ожиданиям? Ожиданиям ребёнка, призванного в этот мир силой нашей любви?
bulgarian: Will I be able to live up to her expectations? This child summoned to the world by our love?

english: Of course.
french: Bien sûr.
russian: Разумеется.
bulgarian: Of course.

english: She's going to love having you as a mom.
french: Elle adorera t'avoir comme mère.
russian: Она будет просто счастлива, что ты её мать.
bulgarian: She's going to love having you as a mom.

english: I'll do everything I can to help you make it so.
french: Je ferai tout mon possible pour que ce soit le cas.
russian: Я сделаю всё, что в моих силах, чтобы помочь тебе.
bulgarian: I'll do everything I can to help you make it so.

english: You... did not hesitate.
french: Tu n'as pas hésité avant de me répondre.
russian:
Ты... даже не

сомневались

сомневаласьсомневалсясомневалось.
bulgarian: You... did not hesitate.

english: Thank you. I did not realize the question was making me so tense.
french: Merci. Je ne me rendais pas compte que cette question me rendait aussi nerveuse.
russian: Спасибо. Я не сразу осознала, как сильно меня тревожил этот вопрос.
bulgarian: Thank you. I did not realize the question was making me so tense.

english: I promise that I will listen to you, and to her.
french: Je te promets que je serai à ton écoute, comme pour elle.
russian: Я обещаю слушать тебя и её.
bulgarian: I promise that I will listen to you, and to her.

english: And together... we will have a happy life.
french: Et ensemble, nous aurons une vie heureuse.
russian: Вместе... мы будем вести счастливую жизнь.
bulgarian: And together... we will have a happy life.

english: Do you think so?
french: Tu crois ?
russian: Ты так думаешь?
bulgarian: Do you think so?

english: It is the pauldrons. They impress children easily.
french: Ce sont les épaulières. Elles impressionnent toujours les enfants.
russian: Главное — наплечники. Лучший способ впечатлить ребёнка.
bulgarian: It is the pauldrons. They impress children easily.

english: [Ari], I have been thinking...
french: [Ari], je réfléchissais...
russian: [Ari], меня посетила мысль...
bulgarian: [Ari], I have been thinking...

english: In the past, I have had strict notions regarding how best to raise a child...
french: Autrefois, j'avais des idées très arrêtées sur l'éducation des enfants.
russian: В прошлом у меня были строгие понятия о том, как надлежит воспитывать ребёнка...
bulgarian: In the past, I have had strict notions regarding how best to raise a child...

english: But this time seems... different. I am different.
french: Mais cette fois, c'est différent. Je suis différente.
russian: Но в этот раз... всё по-другому. Я сама другая.
bulgarian: But this time seems... different. I am different.

english: Then I received his wisdom...
french: J'ai appris de sa sagesse.
russian: И вот мне снизошло его откровение...
bulgarian: Then I received his wisdom...

english: "You gotta go with the flow!"
french: « Il suffit de se laisser porter ! »
russian: «Делай как само пойдёт!».
bulgarian: "You gotta go with the flow!"

english: And I thought, yes. I will allow you and the child to guide me.
french: Et je me suis dit qu'il avait raison. Vous serez mes boussoles, notre enfant et toi.
russian: И я подумала: верно. Я позволю тебе и ребёнку направлять меня.
bulgarian: And I thought, yes. I will allow you and the child to guide me.

english: Sometimes fool's gold... is simply gold.
french: Parfois, les idées les plus simples sont les meilleures.
russian: Иногда тупой гранит... полезней огранённого алмаза.
bulgarian: Sometimes fool's gold... is simply gold.

english: I was speaking to Olric recently, about differing parenting methods.
french: Il y a peu, je discutais avec Olric des différentes méthodes d'éducation.
russian: Недавно я обсуждала подходы к родительству с Ольриком.
bulgarian: I was speaking to Olric recently, about differing parenting methods.

english: Do not fret if her appearance seems to mostly take after me, at first. A baby's features change over time... eye and hair color settle.
french: Si jamais il me ressemble plus au début, ne t'inquiète pas. Certains traits d'un bébé évoluent. La couleur de ses yeux et sa teinte de cheveux peuvent changer.
russian: Не печалься, если сперва её облик будет больше напоминать мой. Со временем дети меняются... цвет волос и глаз принимает окончательную форму.
bulgarian: Do not fret if her appearance seems to mostly take after me, at first. A baby's features change over time... eye and hair color settle.

english: I do hope that in the long run, she has your eyes... and hair... and smile.
french: J'espère qu'au final, elle aura tes yeux... tes cheveux... et ton sourire.
russian: Я надеюсь, что в конце концов у неё будут твои глаза... и волосы... и улыбка.
bulgarian: I do hope that in the long run, she has your eyes... and hair... and smile.

english: I wonder what draconic traits the baby will express? And what mortal traits.
french: Je me demande de quelles caractéristiques draconiques et de quelles caractéristiques mortelles héritera notre bébé.
russian: Интересно, какие черты у нашего ребёнка будут от дракона, а какие от смертного?
bulgarian: I wonder what draconic traits the baby will express? And what mortal traits.

english: $Brid$. It is a strong name, is it not?
french: $Brid$. C'est un prénom qui inspire la force, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: $Брид$. Сильно звучит, правда?
bulgarian: $Brid$. It is a strong name, is it not?

english: Ah, but I think... I would like to leave the final decision to you.
french: Ah, mais je crois que je te laisserai le dernier mot.
russian: Но я всё же думаю... Пускай итоговое решение будет за тобой.
bulgarian: Ah, but I think... I would like to leave the final decision to you.

english: I will be happy with whatever name you choose.
french: Qu'importe le nom que tu lui donneras, je serai heureuse.
russian: Ты можешь выбрать любое имя, и я буду довольна.
bulgarian: I will be happy with whatever name you choose.

english: The baby... in my dreams last night, she visited me, and shared a name that she likes.
french: Notre bébé m'a rendu visite en rêve, la nuit dernière. Elle m'a fait part d'un prénom qu'elle aime bien.
russian: Наша малышка... Навестила меня ночью во сне и поведала, какое имя ей по нраву.
bulgarian: The baby... in my dreams last night, she visited me, and shared a name that she likes.

english: I will stay close to home, in the coming days... that way I will be here when she arrives. We will welcome her together.
french: Je ne m'éloignerai pas dans les prochains jours. Ainsi, je serai présente à son arrivée. Nous l'accueillerons ensemble.
russian: В ближайшие дни я не буду отдаляться от дома... Чтобы быть здесь, когда она появится. Мы встретим её вместе.
bulgarian: I will stay close to home, in the coming days... that way I will be here when she arrives. We will welcome her together.

english: My dreams of our baby have grown more vivid... she will arrive soon.
french: Les rêves que je fais de notre enfant sont de plus en plus nets... Elle arrivera bientôt.
russian: Мои сны о ребёнке становятся всё яснее... она прибудет очень скоро.
bulgarian: My dreams of our baby have grown more vivid... she will arrive soon.

english: Tell me... what will you do with your time?
