french: Dis-moi ! Que comptes-tu faire de ton temps libre ?
russian: Поведай... что ты собираешься делать в это время?
bulgarian: Tell me... what will you do with your time?

english: I'm going to go into the Mines!
french: J'ai bien envie de descendre dans la mine !
russian: Я планирую пойти в шахты!
bulgarian: I'm going to go into the Mines!

english: Maybe I'll go fishing.
french: J'irai peut-être pêcher.
russian: Может, схожу на рыбалку.
bulgarian: Maybe I'll go fishing.

english: I was thinking of doing some decorating...
french: Je pensais faire un peu de déco...
russian: Думаю заняться художественным оформлением...
bulgarian: I was thinking of doing some decorating...

english: This pleases me... my fine Dragonsworn, you are ever testing yourself.
french: J'en suis heureuse, noble paladin du dragon. Tu n'hésites pas à relever les défis qui se présentent à toi.
russian: Мой Драконоверный неустанно ищет новых испытаний... Это мне по нраву.
bulgarian: This pleases me... my fine Dragonsworn, you are ever testing yourself.

english: If you hunt any monster parts, do think of me. I enjoy receiving such tokens from you.
french: Si jamais tu trouves des restes de monstres, pense à moi. J'aime beaucoup ce genre de petites attentions.
russian: Если добудешь останки монстров, не забудь показать мне. Мне нравится получать от тебя такие подарки.
bulgarian: If you hunt any monster parts, do think of me. I enjoy receiving such tokens from you.

english: Yes, good. It is prudent to keep your hunting senses sharp.
french: C'est très bien. Il faut toujours développer son instinct de chasseur.
russian: Да, мудрое решение. Охотничье чутьё важно поддерживать в форме.
bulgarian: Yes, good. It is prudent to keep your hunting senses sharp.

english: Perhaps I will do the same... catching fish is a wonderful way to pass the time.
french: J'en ferai peut-être autant. Attraper des poissons est un moyen très agréable de passer le temps.
russian: Возможно, я тоже этим займусь... Ловля рыбы — чудесный способ провести время.
bulgarian: Perhaps I will do the same... catching fish is a wonderful way to pass the time.

english: This is a fine pastime.
french: C'est un bien beau hobby.
russian: Это достойное занятие.
bulgarian: This is a fine pastime.

english: I appreciate one who dedicates themselves to ensuring their home is a reflection of their interests.
french: J'apprécie de voir quelqu'un s'investir pour s'assurer que son intérieur reflète ses intérêts.
russian: У тех, кто готов уделить этому время, дом отражает внутренний мир. Я такое ценю.
bulgarian: I appreciate one who dedicates themselves to ensuring their home is a reflection of their interests.

english: Especially when there are skeletons involved.
french: Surtout si les squelettes sont de la partie.
russian: Особенно когда в оформлении используются скелеты.
bulgarian: Especially when there are skeletons involved.

english: I imagine we will part for the day, soon.
french: J'imagine que nous allons prendre congé pour la journée.
russian: Полагаю, скоро мы расстанемся до вечера.
bulgarian: I imagine we will part for the day, soon.

english: Be sure to keep your energy up until then.
french: Garde un peu d'énergie d'ici là.
russian: Сохрани для неё силы, не изматывай себя.
bulgarian: Be sure to keep your energy up until then.

english: The day finds you well, I hope. I am looking forward to seeing you at home tonight.
french: J'espère que ta journée se passe bien. J'ai hâte que nous nous retrouvions à la maison ce soir.
russian: Надеюсь, твой день проходит хорошо. Я уже жду нашей вечерней встречи дома.
bulgarian: The day finds you well, I hope. I am looking forward to seeing you at home tonight.

english: In that case, shall I save us both a trip to the General Store and magic some groceries to our home?
french: Que dirais-tu si j'apportais des provisions chez nous par magie pour nous épargner un passage au magasin général ?
russian: В таком случае я могу воспользоваться магией и доставить продукты из универмага прямо нам домой.
bulgarian: In that case, shall I save us both a trip to the General Store and magic some groceries to our home?

english: I promise I will leave a generous payment.
french: Je te promets que je leur laisserai une somme généreuse.
russian: Просто сэкономить время на покупках. Обещаю оставить взамен щедрую оплату.
bulgarian: I promise I will leave a generous payment.

english: You are having a full day. I am glad.
french: Tu as une journée bien remplie. J'en suis heureuse.
russian: Вижу, твой день наполнен событиями. Это меня радует.
bulgarian: You are having a full day. I am glad.

english: I will spend my afternoon hunting for fish, if you crave it.
french: Je compte passer mon après-midi à attraper du poisson si ça te dit.
russian: Я могу провести весь день, охотясь на рыбу, если ты того желаешь.
bulgarian: I will spend my afternoon hunting for fish, if you crave it.

english: Is there anything you would desire for dinner?
french: Y a-t-il quelque chose qui te ferait plaisir pour dîner ?
russian: Есть ли что-либо, чего тебе особенно хотелось бы на ужин?
bulgarian: Is there anything you would desire for dinner?

english: Such hands are meant for better things. Allow me to use magic to rectify such a banal chore.
french: Ces si jolies mains sont faites pour des choses plus gratifiantes. Laisse-moi utiliser la magie pour ce genre de tâche ménagère.
russian: Твоим рукам найдётся лучшее применения. Позволь мне решить это тривиальную бытовую задачу с помощью магии.
bulgarian: Such hands are meant for better things. Allow me to use magic to rectify such a banal chore.

english: [Ari], I see that you continue to do laundry by hand.
french: [Ari], je constate que tu fais toujours ta lessive à la main.
russian: [Ari], я замечаю, что ты продолжаешь стирать вручную.
bulgarian: [Ari], I see that you continue to do laundry by hand.

english: I was thinking about the sensation of your lips as they press to mine.
french: Je pensais à la sensation de tes lèvres sur les miennes.
russian: Мне на память пришло ощущение от соприкосновения твоих губ с моими.
bulgarian: I was thinking about the sensation of your lips as they press to mine.

english: It would please me if I need not only imagine it.
french: Mais j'aimerais ne pas seulement avoir à y penser.
russian: Мне было бы приятно испытать его не только в воображении.
bulgarian: It would please me if I need not only imagine it.

english: There you are, [Ari]. You know...
french: Te voilà, [Ari]. Tu sais...
russian: Вот ты где, [Ari]. Знаешь...
bulgarian: There you are, [Ari]. You know...

english: The way I change as we become closer still... it surprises me every day.
french: La façon dont je change à mesure que nous nous rapprochons me surprend toujours.
russian: Мы сближаемся, и оттого я меняюсь внутри... Это не перестаёт удивлять меня каждый день.
bulgarian: The way I change as we become closer still... it surprises me every day.

english: Being with you is a blessing, [Ari].
french: C'est une grande joie d'être à tes côtés, [Ari].
russian: Быть рядом с тобой — настоящее блаженство, [Ari].
bulgarian: Being with you is a blessing, [Ari].

english: It pleases me, [Ari]. Next time, I will be the one to expend my time.
french: Cela me ravit, [Ari]. La prochaine fois, c'est moi qui emploierai mon temps à en faire de même.
russian: Это доставляет мне удовольствие, [Ari]. В следующий раз я буду тратить своё время, чтобы прийти к тебе.
bulgarian: It pleases me, [Ari]. Next time, I will be the one to expend my time.

english: That you expend your limited hours seeking me out...
french: Dire que tu emploies ton temps limité d'être mortel à me chercher...
russian: Ты тратишь драгоценные часы своей смертной жизни ради встречи со мной...
bulgarian: That you expend your limited hours seeking me out...

english: However, if they are able to deceive us into receiving a second breakfast...
french: Toutefois, si jamais cette crapule arrivait à se jouer de nous pour obtenir un second petit-déjeuner...
russian: Хотя, если сможет нас с тобой обхитрить и получить второй завтрак...
bulgarian: However, if they are able to deceive us into receiving a second breakfast...

english: Then I would consider it well-earned. Such cunning deserves a reward.
french: Je considérerais cela comme bien mérité. Une telle ruse mériterait d'être récompensée.
russian: Я посчитаю, что это справедливо. Такая хитрость заслуживает награды.
bulgarian: Then I would consider it well-earned. Such cunning deserves a reward.

english: I have already given [pet_name] their daily sustenance.
french: J'ai déjà donné à [pet_name] sa pitance quotidienne.
russian: [pet_name] больше не нуждается в пропитании на сегодня.
bulgarian: I have already given [pet_name] their daily sustenance.

english: Intellectually, I know it to be an adaptation. And yet, it is difficult to resist such cuteness...
french: Je sais que c'est une interprétation de l'esprit. Il est pourtant difficile de résister à cette petite bouille si adorable...
russian: Умом я понимаю, что это адаптация. И всё же, такой миловидности трудно противостоять...
bulgarian: Intellectually, I know it to be an adaptation. And yet, it is difficult to resist such cuteness...

english: But I will remain strong.
french: Mais je saurai rester forte.
russian: Но я буду стойкой.
bulgarian: But I will remain strong.

english: [pet_name] has such a sweet, endearing face...
french: [pet_name] a un visage à croquer.
russian: [pet_name] обладает невероятно милой и подкупающей физиономией...
bulgarian: [pet_name] has such a sweet, endearing face...

english: I entered this marriage with the expectation we would share a bed...
french: J'ai accepté de me marier avec toi dans l'espoir de dormir à tes côtés.
russian: Я вступила в этот брак, ожидая, что мы разделим ложе.
bulgarian: I entered this marriage with the expectation we would share a bed...

english: Yet, I see you have not yet prepared your home with one big enough to hold us both.
french: Je constate pourtant qu'il n'y a pas de lit assez grand pour nous deux chez toi.
russian:
Однако я заметила, что ты до сих пор не

обустроили

обустроилаобустроилобустроило свой дом кроватью подобающего размера.
bulgarian: Yet, I see you have not yet prepared your home with one big enough to hold us both.

english: I expect you to remedy this.
french: J'espère que tu y remédieras au plus vite.
russian: Я рассчитываю, что ты исправишь это недоразумение.
bulgarian: I expect you to remedy this.

english: [Ari].
french: [Ari].
russian: [Ari].
bulgarian: [Ari].

english: I enjoy seeing the tell-tale signs of our aesthetic tastes coming together.
french: J'aime la façon dont nos goûts communs sont toujours plus visibles.
russian: Мне радует глаз, что наш вкус в предметах интерьера сходится.
bulgarian: I enjoy seeing the tell-tale signs of our aesthetic tastes coming together.

english: Our little estate looks very fine these days.
french: Notre maison et nos terres sont vraiment très jolies, ces jours-ci.
russian: Наше скромное поместье нынче выглядит превосходно.
bulgarian: Our little estate looks very fine these days.

english: Do you believe I have been properly welcomed into your home? I, your wife?
french: Crois-tu que j'aie été accueillie dans ta maison comme il se doit ? Moi, ton épouse ?
russian:
Полагаешь ли ты, что достойно

приняли

принялапринялприняло меня в своём доме? Меня, твою супругу?
bulgarian: Do you believe I have been properly welcomed into your home? I, your wife?

english: There is little I need, but I do expect a place for me to conduct my experiments.
french: J'ai assez peu d'exigences, mais il me faut au moins un endroit où mener mes expériences.
russian: Мне нужно немногое, однако я рассчитываю, что для моих магических опытов найдётся пространство.
bulgarian: There is little I need, but I do expect a place for me to conduct my experiments.

english: Otherwise... I will be forced to find a less convenient place to test my magics.
french: Dans le cas contraire, je me verrai contrainte de tester mes sorts dans un endroit bien moins adapté.
russian: Иначе... Я буду вынуждена искать менее удобное место для испытаний магии.
bulgarian: Otherwise... I will be forced to find a less convenient place to test my magics.

english: [Ari]. Heed my words.
french: [Ari], écoute-moi bien.
russian: [Ari]. Внемли моим словам.
bulgarian: [Ari]. Heed my words.

english: I am a dragon, a queen, a beast on the hunt...
french: Je suis tour à tour un dragon, une reine, une bête en chasse...
russian: Я дракон, я королева, я зверь на охоте...
bulgarian: I am a dragon, a queen, a beast on the hunt...

english: But then I awaken next to you... and you bring me back to myself.
french: Mais alors, je me réveille à côté de toi et tu m'aides à redevenir moi-même.
russian: Но затем я просыпаюсь рядом с тобой... И снова становлюсь собой.
bulgarian: But then I awaken next to you... and you bring me back to myself.

english: When I sleep, my past lives tumble together inside of my dreams...
french: Lorsque je dors, mes vies passées me reviennent en rêve.
russian: Пока я сплю, перед глазами смешиваются образы моих прошлых жизней...
bulgarian: When I sleep, my past lives tumble together inside of my dreams...

english: While I enjoy my nighttime machinations...
french: J'admets que j'aime beaucoup intriguer pendant la nuit.
russian: Мне нравится плести интриги по ночам...
bulgarian: While I enjoy my nighttime machinations...

english: I enjoy sleeping next to you moreso.
french: Mais je préfère de loin dormir à tes côtés.
russian: Но спать рядом с тобой мне нравится ещё больше.
bulgarian: I enjoy sleeping next to you moreso.

english: I see it will not be long before it is time to rest.
french: Je sais qu'il sera bientôt l'heure de se reposer.
russian: Вижу, приближается время ночного отдыха.
bulgarian: I see it will not be long before it is time to rest.

english: There is time yet in the day, and much mischief left to do before we must turn in.
french: La journée n'est pas terminée et il nous reste du temps pour faire plein de bêtises avant d'aller au lit.
russian: Этот день ещё не закончился, так что у нас хватит времени на множество проказ.
bulgarian: There is time yet in the day, and much mischief left to do before we must turn in.

english: Good evening, [Ari]. I do hope you are not drowsy yet.
french: Bonsoir, [Ari]. J'espère que tu n'as pas encore sommeil.
russian: Добрый вечер, [Ari]. Надеюсь, тебя ещё не захватала сонливость.
bulgarian: Good evening, [Ari]. I do hope you are not drowsy yet.

english: Even if it was uneventful, I find your retellings enjoyable.
french: Même s'il ne s'est rien passé de notable, j'aime quand tu me racontes ce que tu as fait.
russian: Даже когда событий немного, твои рассказы приносят мне удовольствие.
bulgarian: Even if it was uneventful, I find your retellings enjoyable.

english: I expect you to tell me of your day as we lounge in bed this evening, [Ari].
french: J'espère que tu me raconteras ta journée, lorsque nous serons au lit ce soir, [Ari].
russian: Я ожидаю, что ты расскажешь мне про свой день, когда мы отойдём на вечерний отдых в постели, [Ari].
bulgarian: I expect you to tell me of your day as we lounge in bed this evening, [Ari].

english: How I adore you, [Ari]. A thousand hoards are naught but dust next to you.
french: Tu es ce qu'il y a de plus cher à mes yeux, [Ari]. Des milliers de trésors ne sont que vétilles à côté de toi.
russian: Я преклоняюсь перед тобой, [Ari]. Пред твоим ногами тысячи сокровищ — пыль.
bulgarian: How I adore you, [Ari]. A thousand hoards are naught but dust next to you.

english: Ah, there you are...
french: Ah, te voilà...
russian: Ах, это ты...
bulgarian: Ah, there you are...

english: A shame that we cannot enjoy its many colors after night falls.
french: C'est dommage qu'on ne puisse pas apprécier ses myriades de couleurs une fois la nuit tombée.
russian: Жаль, что мы не можем любоваться его красками после захода солнца.
bulgarian: A shame that we cannot enjoy its many colors after night falls.

english: I adore this season of decay...
french: Comme j'aime cette saison qui marque le déclin...
russian: Меня восхищает сезон увядания...
bulgarian: I adore this season of decay...

english: Though... if such a thing is unpleasant to you...
french: Mais si cela ne te convient pas...
russian: Хотя... Если подобные ощущения тебе не в радость...
bulgarian: Though... if such a thing is unpleasant to you...

english: We can turn in early, and I will happily warm you in bed.
french: Nous pouvons aller nous coucher de bonne heure, je me ferai une joie de te réchauffer.
russian: Мы можем закончить день пораньше, и я с удовольствием согрею тебя в постели.
bulgarian: We can turn in early, and I will happily warm you in bed.

english: Mm, do you feel it? The evening air has acquired a bite.
french: Mmm, tu sens ? L'air commence à fraîchir le soir.
russian: Мм, ты чувствуешь? По вечерам спускается колючая прохлада.
bulgarian: Mm, do you feel it? The evening air has acquired a bite.

english: Otherwise I will be raking this farmstead all season!
french: Sans cela, je vais passer la saison entière à ratisser la ferme !
russian: Иначе я буду грести этот двор до конца осени!
bulgarian: Otherwise I will be raking this farmstead all season!

english: Perhaps it is time to devise a spell for gathering leaves...
french: Le temps est peut-être venu de mettre au point un sort pour ramasser les feuilles mortes...
russian: Для сбора листвы, вероятно, пора изобрести заклинание...
bulgarian: Perhaps it is time to devise a spell for gathering leaves...

english: Let us take a walk together, some time...
french: Nous devrions aller nous promener ensemble, un de ces jours.
russian: Давай найдём время и прогуляемся вместе...
bulgarian: Let us take a walk together, some time...

english: I would like to hear the leaves crunch beneath our feet.
french: J'aimerais entendre les feuilles qui craquent sous nos pieds.
russian: Хочу ощутить, как листва сминается под ногами.
bulgarian: I would like to hear the leaves crunch beneath our feet.

english: The air has grown crisp, as has the foliage.
french: L'air est plus vif et le feuillage se dessèche.
russian:
Слышали

СлышалаСлышалСлышало, как хрустят сухие листья? А с ними будто и сам воздух.
bulgarian: The air has grown crisp, as has the foliage.

english: Let us give it an eyeful today, shall we?
french: Tâchons de lui offrir un spectacle digne de ce nom aujourd'hui !
russian: Насладимся же красотой этого дня!
bulgarian: Let us give it an eyeful today, shall we?

english: Good morning, [Ari]. The sun is risen, watchful above us once more.
french: Bonjour, [Ari]. Le soleil est levé et nous observe à nouveau de là-haut.
russian: Доброе утро, [Ari]. Солнце непреклонно продолжает свой восход.
bulgarian: Good morning, [Ari]. The sun is risen, watchful above us once more.

english: I would not let just anyone observe my unguarded, slumbering form.
french: Je ne laisserais pas le premier venu m'observer pendant que je dors, sans défense.
russian: Не всякому я дозволяю смотреть на своё беззащитное спящее тело.
bulgarian: I would not let just anyone observe my unguarded, slumbering form.

english: So know that when we sleep together... it is because there is no one I trust more than you.
french: Alors, sache que si nous dormons ensemble, c'est parce que j'ai une confiance absolue en toi.
russian: Знай: мы спим вместе лишь потому... что никому я так не доверяю, как тебе.
bulgarian: So know that when we sleep together... it is because there is no one I trust more than you.

english: Do not tell me if I snore, though. I could not bear it.
french: Si toutefois je ronflais, garde-le pour toi. Je ne le supporterais pas.
russian: Только не говори, что я храплю. Я этого не вынесу.
bulgarian: Do not tell me if I snore, though. I could not bear it.

english: I thought of you as I awoke this morning.
french: Je pensais à toi, en me réveillant ce matin.
russian: Сегодня, пробудившись ото сна, я подумала о тебе.
bulgarian: I thought of you as I awoke this morning.

english: Like you, I have spells to change the weather...
french: Comme toi, je dispose de sorts qui me permettent de contrôler le temps qu'il fait...
russian: Я, как и ты, владею магией, позволяющей менять погоду...
bulgarian: Like you, I have spells to change the weather...

english: But it is a good lesson in humility for me, accepting the world as it is.
french: Mais accepter le monde comme il est constitue une leçon d'humilité.
russian: И всё же пускай это будет для меня уроком смирения. Я учусь принимать мир таким, какой он есть.
bulgarian: But it is a good lesson in humility for me, accepting the world as it is.

english: Though, I would change the world for you... if you asked.
french: En revanche, si tu me le demandais, je changerais tout pour toi.
russian: Но для тебя я готова его перевернуть... Если попросишь.
bulgarian: Though, I would change the world for you... if you asked.

english: The rain continues...
french: La pluie ne cesse pas...
russian: Дождь не отступает...
bulgarian: The rain continues...

english: That is why I have cast a simple spell on your boots. Water will not penetrate them.
french: C'est pour cela que j'ai lancé un sort à tes bottes. Elles sont imperméables désormais.
russian: Поэтому я наложила на твою обувь простое защитное заклятье. Вода в них не проникнет.
bulgarian: That is why I have cast a simple spell on your boots. Water will not penetrate them.

english: You are going out? The rain continues, unabated... but I know such weather is no barrier to you.
french: Tu sors ? Il pleut toujours autant, mais je sais que ce n'est pas ça qui t'arrête.
russian: Ты собираешься выходить? Дождь не стихает... Но я знаю, что такая погода тебе не помеха.
bulgarian: You are going out? The rain continues, unabated... but I know such weather is no barrier to you.

english: Morning ought to arrive later. I wished to spoon in bed a little longer...
french: Le matin devrait arriver plus tard. J'aimerais que nous restions plus longtemps, l'un<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they> contre l'autre.
russian: Я бы предпочла отложить утро, чтобы подольше полежать в твоих объятиях...
bulgarian: Morning ought to arrive later. I wished to spoon in bed a little longer...

english: The night... it is always too short.
french: La nuit est toujours trop courte.
russian: Ночь... всегда так коротка.
bulgarian: The night... it is always too short.

english: Dragons do not slip easily, due to the extra balance their tails provide...
french: Les dragons ne glissent pas facilement, car leur queue leur permet de garder l'équilibre...
russian: Драконы обычно не теряют равновесия, ведь у нас есть балансирующий хвост...
bulgarian: Dragons do not slip easily, due to the extra balance their tails provide...

english: But you do not have such a luxury.
french: Mais tu ne possèdes pas ce genre d'appendice.
russian: А тебе без него приходится труднее.
bulgarian: But you do not have such a luxury.

english: Unless perhaps... a spell to give you a tail?
french: À moins que je te lance un sort pour y remédier ?
russian: Может, ты хочешь... чтобы я наколдовала тебе хвост?
bulgarian: Unless perhaps... a spell to give you a tail?

english: Mind the ice when it grows dark, [Ari].
french: Le soir, fais attention aux plaques de glace, [Ari].
russian: Осторожно, [Ari], в темноте не видно льда.
bulgarian: Mind the ice when it grows dark, [Ari].

english: I... am happy that we can see it together.
french: Je suis heureuse que nous en profitions ensemble.
russian: Я... рада, что мы можешь наблюдать его вместе с тобой.
bulgarian: I... am happy that we can see it together.

english: It is snowing, [Ari]... a rare and beautiful sight that I wait the whole year to witness.
french: Il neige, [Ari]. C'est une vision rare et magnifique que j'espère toute l'année.
russian: [Ari], там снегопад... Это редкое и прекрасное зрелище. Я дожидаюсь его весь год.
bulgarian: It is snowing, [Ari]... a rare and beautiful sight that I wait the whole year to witness.

english: Perhaps today I will run magical experiments...
french: Je vais peut-être me lancer dans des expériences magiques, aujourd'hui...
russian: Может быть, сегодня я займусь магическими экспериментами...
bulgarian: Perhaps today I will run magical experiments...

english: Or perhaps I will laze about at the Bathhouse and theorize new spells instead.
french: Ou je vais flâner aux bains pour réfléchir à de nouveaux sorts.
russian: Или буду прохлаждаться в купальне, выдумывая новые заклинания.
bulgarian: Or perhaps I will laze about at the Bathhouse and theorize new spells instead.

english: The day awaits us.
french: Nous avons la journée devant nous.
russian: Нас ждёт новый день.
bulgarian: The day awaits us.

english: But I wish there was not so much yellow fluff in the air. It makes my eyes itch.
french: Toutefois, j'aimerais qu'il y ait moins de poussière jaune dans l'air. Cela m'irrite les yeux.
russian: Для меня в этом воздухе слишком много жёлтых пушинок. От них чешутся глаза.
bulgarian: But I wish there was not so much yellow fluff in the air. It makes my eyes itch.

english: Spring is a fine season and all...
french: Le printemps est une saison agréable.
russian: Весна — безусловно, красивое время года, но...
bulgarian: Spring is a fine season and all...

english: I enjoy viewing the farm with you in spring, watching as the land embarks on the long process of being reborn.
french: J'aime observer les terres avec toi, au printemps, quand toutes les plantes entament ce long processus de retour à la vie.
russian: Весной мне нравится обозревать ферму вместе с тобой. Смотреть, как земля начинает долгий процесс перерождения.
bulgarian: I enjoy viewing the farm with you in spring, watching as the land embarks on the long process of being reborn.

english: No matter. It will return soon enough.
french: Mais qu'importe. Il reviendra bien assez tôt.
russian: Но это пустяк. Вскоре она придёт вновь.
bulgarian: No matter. It will return soon enough.

english: Spring is fine enough... but I do miss the depths of winter.
french: Même si le printemps est agréable, les affres de l'hiver me manquent.
russian: Весна — хорошее время... Но я скучаю по глубокой зиме.
bulgarian: Spring is fine enough... but I do miss the depths of winter.

english: The snows recede, revealing a new type of beauty altogether.
french: Quand la neige fond, une beauté d'un tout autre genre apparaît.
russian: Из-под отходящего снега открывается новая, невиданная красота.
bulgarian: The snows recede, revealing a new type of beauty altogether.

english: Spring is the best season for finding bones, you know.
french: Le printemps est la saison idéale pour trouver des ossements, tu sais.
russian: Знаешь, весна — лучшее время для поиска костей.
bulgarian: Spring is the best season for finding bones, you know.

english: It is too hot to even hold each other in bed!
french: Il fait même trop chaud pour que nous nous étreignions au lit !
russian: Настолько жарко, что неудобно обнимать друг друга в постели!
bulgarian: It is too hot to even hold each other in bed!

english: Not that it will stop me...
french: Mais ce n'est pas cela qui m'en empêchera...
russian: Разумеется, меня это не остановит...
bulgarian: Not that it will stop me...

english: The summer heat is simply too oppressive.
french: La chaleur de l'été est bien trop accablante.
russian: Летняя жара совершенно невыносима.
bulgarian: The summer heat is simply too oppressive.

english: Like us, they are little stars, dancing in the void of night.
french: Comme nous, ce sont de petites étoiles qui virevoltent dans l'obscurité de la nuit.
russian: Как и мы с тобой, они подобны звёздам, танцующим во мраке ночи.
bulgarian: Like us, they are little stars, dancing in the void of night.

english: Summer nights are beautiful when the fireflies come out.
french: Les nuits d'été sont magnifiques quand les lucioles sont de sortie.
russian: Летние ночи так прекрасны, когда наружу вылетают светлячки.
bulgarian: Summer nights are beautiful when the fireflies come out.

english: It is like a challenge.
french: C'est un défi qu'il me faut relever.
russian: Будто бросают мне вызов.
bulgarian: It is like a challenge.

english: It is not the heat of this season that bothers me, but the brightness of the sun. The temerity of it...
french: Ce n'est pas la chaleur qui me dérange à cette saison, mais la lumière si vive du soleil. Quelle impudence !
russian: Мне досаждает не жара, а яркость летнего солнца. Его дерзкие лучи...
bulgarian: It is not the heat of this season that bothers me, but the brightness of the sun. The temerity of it...

english: A pleasant feeling, to be sure.
french: C'est une sensation des plus agréables.
russian: Это, безусловно, приятное чувство.
bulgarian: A pleasant feeling, to be sure.

english: The heat of summer reminds me of smoldering dragon fire.
french: La chaleur de l'été me rappelle le souffle ardent d'un dragon.
russian: Летняя жара напоминает мне палящее пламя дракона.
bulgarian: The heat of summer reminds me of smoldering dragon fire.

english: It seems I am forbidden from teaching the children of this town any method for animating their snowmen.
french: Apparemment, je n'ai pas le droit d'enseigner aux enfants comment donner vie à leurs bonshommes de neige.
russian: Как я поняла, мне запрещено обучать детей заклинаниям, оживляющим снеговиков.
bulgarian: It seems I am forbidden from teaching the children of this town any method for animating their snowmen.

english: I do not understand. Animating an effigy is a basic spell all children should know.
french: Je ne comprends pas. C'est pourtant là un sort élémentaire que tout enfant devrait connaître.
russian: Мне непонятен подобный запрет. Оживление куклы — базовое заклинание, его должен знать каждый ребёнок.
bulgarian: I do not understand. Animating an effigy is a basic spell all children should know.

english: While I have no complaint about winter itself, coexisting with the townsfolk brings compromise.
french: Bien que je n'aie pas à me plaindre de l'hiver en lui-même, vivre au contact des habitants d'ici nécessite de faire des compromis.
russian: На саму зиму я не жалуюсь. Но ради поддержания отношений с местными жителями приходится идти на уступки.
bulgarian: While I have no complaint about winter itself, coexisting with the townsfolk brings compromise.

english: It is the season for dark, unseen magics...
french: C'est la saison de la magie noire et de l'occulte.
russian: Это время для тёмной, скрытой магии...
bulgarian: It is the season for dark, unseen magics...

english: And getting cozy in bed.
french: Mais aussi des lits douillets.
russian: И для тёплой постели.
bulgarian: And getting cozy in bed.

english: The long nights, the bitterly cold air... winter is invigorating.
french: Avec ses longues nuits, cet air froid et mordant, l'hiver a quelque chose de vivifiant.
russian: Долгие ночи и пронизывающий мороз... Зима приносит мне бодрость.
bulgarian: The long nights, the bitterly cold air... winter is invigorating.

english: But the effort of getting out of bed in winter is a challenge.
french: Malheureusement, sortir du lit en plein hiver demande un très grand effort.
russian: Однако поднять себя с постели зимой стоит немалых усилий.
bulgarian: But the effort of getting out of bed in winter is a challenge.

english: I know there is much to do...
french: Je sais que j'ai une journée chargée...
russian: Я знаю, что нас ждёт много дел...
bulgarian: I know there is much to do...

english: I am happy I will be able to see it with you for many years to come.
french: Je suis heureuse à l'idée de pouvoir l'admirer à tes côtés tout au long des années qui viennent.
russian: Я рада, что смогу наслаждаться этим видом с тобой ещё долгие годы.
bulgarian: I am happy I will be able to see it with you for many years to come.

english: [farm_name] is beautiful in winter...
french: [farm_name] est magnifique en hiver.
russian: [farm_name] зимой выглядит великолепно...
bulgarian: [farm_name] is beautiful in winter...

english: And super-condenses it... into a diamond...
french: Ensuite, je leur appliquerai une telle pression qu'ils finiraient par former un diamant.
russian: И сжимающее его... в плотный алмаз...
bulgarian: And super-condenses it... into a diamond...

english: Perhaps a spell... that collects all unnecessary debris from an area...
french: Peut-être un sort qui permettrait de rassembler tous les débris d'une zone...
russian: Может, это будет заклинание... собирающее весь мусор в округе...
bulgarian: Perhaps a spell... that collects all unnecessary debris from an area...

english: I must devise a spell to eradicate dark stains from textiles.
french: Je dois mettre au point un sort pour faire disparaître les taches tenaces sur les textiles.
russian: Мне нужно разработать заклинание для очищения ткани от тёмных пятен.
bulgarian: I must devise a spell to eradicate dark stains from textiles.

english: Stains such as... hm. Red wine. Rust. Cherry juice and tomato sauce. Surely only those things.
french: Comme des taches... mmm... de vin, de rouille, de jus de cerise ou de sauce tomate. Rien de plus méchant.
russian: К примеру, от... Хм. Красного вина. Ржавчины. Вишнёвого сока и томатного кетчупа. Да, именно это меня волнует.
bulgarian: Stains such as... hm. Red wine. Rust. Cherry juice and tomato sauce. Surely only those things.

english: Ah yes... I am reminded...
french: Ah oui... J'allais oublier.
russian: Ах да... Я вспомнила...
bulgarian: Ah yes... I am reminded...

english: But if I tweak it, like so... then it can be used to polish windows instead. Unless... that is the wrong modification?
french: Mais en le modifiant un peu, comme ça, il permet de nettoyer les vitres à la place. À moins que je me sois trompée ?
russian: Но если его подкорректировать... его можно применять для очистки окон. Или... я ошиблась с модификатором?
bulgarian: But if I tweak it, like so... then it can be used to polish windows instead. Unless... that is the wrong modification?

english: Hm. I ought to do some testing, lest we end up with an unwanted interdimensional neighbor...
french: Mmm, je vais faire quelques tests, sinon nous pourrions nous retrouver sans le voir avec une faille interdimensionnelle.
russian: Хм. Надо провести больше тестов. Иначе у нам могут заглянуть наши межпространственные соседи...
bulgarian: Hm. I ought to do some testing, lest we end up with an unwanted interdimensional neighbor...

english: This old spell turns a window into a looking glass that peers into a neighboring dimension.
french: Grâce à ce sort très ancien, n'importe quelle fenêtre devient un miroir ouvrant sur une autre dimension.
russian: Эта древняя магия превращает окно в зеркало, отражающее соседнее измерение.
bulgarian: This old spell turns a window into a looking glass that peers into a neighboring dimension.

english: Surely he will not miss them?
french: J'espère qu'ils ne lui manqueront pas.
russian: Уверена, он не заметит их отсутствия.
bulgarian: Surely he will not miss them?

english: Eiland's collection of books is quite impressive, so I have been appropriating them as they catch my attention.
french: Eiland a une collection de livres impressionnante, alors je m'approprie ceux qui m'intéressent.
russian: Эйланд владеет впечатляющей коллекцией книг. Я время от времени конфискую те, что привлекают моё внимание.
bulgarian: Eiland's collection of books is quite impressive, so I have been appropriating them as they catch my attention.

english: Much of this work is deeply in the abstract, quite theoretical... and very, very clever.
french: Ces travaux étaient pour la plupart théoriques et abstraits, mais irréfutablement perspicaces.
russian: Большинство работ глубоко абстрактные, теоретические... и очень-очень умные.
bulgarian: Much of this work is deeply in the abstract, quite theoretical... and very, very clever.

english: It has been curious, learning how the study of magic progressed in a time with no true magical wellspring.
french: J'ai été surprise d'apprendre combien l'étude de la magie a progressé à une époque où elle n'était pas pratiquée.
russian: Любопытно наблюдать, как продвигалось изучение магии без настоящего источника силы.
bulgarian: It has been curious, learning how the study of magic progressed in a time with no true magical wellspring.

english: Ah, such antics.
french: Ah, comme c'était drôle.
russian: У них такие забавные козни.
bulgarian: Ah, such antics.

english: I have enjoyed catching up on the history of the Caldosian Empire.
french: J'ai beaucoup aimé rattraper ce que j'avais loupé de l'histoire de l'empire caldosien.
russian: Нагонять упущенную историю Кальдосийской империи оказалось увлекательным занятием.
bulgarian: I have enjoyed catching up on the history of the Caldosian Empire.

english: (Seridia is delicately conducting a little parade of embers. Each spark dances to her silent rhythm.)
french: (Seridia dirige habilement une petite parade de flammèches. Chaque étincelle danse au gré de la mesure qu'elle bat en silence.)
russian: (Серидия сосредоточенно дирижирует ансамблем угольков. Каждая искорка танцует под её неслышный ритм.)
bulgarian: (Seridia is delicately conducting a little parade of embers. Each spark dances to her silent rhythm.)

english: (From the look of it, Seridia is collecting energy. The fire pulsates in response.)
french: (Apparemment, Seridia est en train d'accumuler de l'énergie. Les flammes palpitent en retour.)
russian: (Судя по её виду, Серидия набирает энергию. Огонь пульсирует в ответ на её движения.)
bulgarian: (From the look of it, Seridia is collecting energy. The fire pulsates in response.)

english: (Seridia seems to be testing a new spell. She will surely tell you about it later, as you are settling into bed for the night.)
french: (Seridia semble tester un nouveau sort. Elle vous en parlera sûrement après, au moment d'aller vous coucher.)
russian: (Кажется, Серидия испытывает новое заклинание. Она обязательно расскажет вам про него позже, когда вы будете ложиться спать.)
bulgarian: (Seridia seems to be testing a new spell. She will surely tell you about it later, as you are settling into bed for the night.)

english: Our animals deserve first place in every regard.
bulgarian: Our animals deserve first place in every regard.

english: I am sure that the judges will agree.
bulgarian: I am sure that the judges will agree.

english: They better.
bulgarian: They better.

english: The day of the $Animal Festival$ has arrived.
bulgarian: The day of the $Animal Festival$ has arrived.

english: It is time to dance and make merry...
bulgarian: It is time to dance and make merry...

english: Today is the $Harvest Festival$, [Ari]. You know what that means, do you not?
bulgarian: Today is the $Harvest Festival$, [Ari]. You know what that means, do you not?

english: It pleases me that the tradition endures.
bulgarian: It pleases me that the tradition endures.

english: And it pleases me even more to enjoy it with you.
bulgarian: And it pleases me even more to enjoy it with you.

english: This evening marks this year's $Shooting Star Festival$...
bulgarian: This evening marks this year's $Shooting Star Festival$...

english: Come, let us see what chaos this flower-picking tournament has brought upon the townsfolk.
bulgarian: Come, let us see what chaos this flower-picking tournament has brought upon the townsfolk.

english: The $Spring Festival$ is upon us...
bulgarian: The $Spring Festival$ is upon us...

english: From where does Darcy conjure her coffees and cakes?
bulgarian: From where does Darcy conjure her coffees and cakes?

english: Perhaps today she will tell me her secrets.
bulgarian: Perhaps today she will tell me her secrets.

english: Saturday comes again... and with it, the Market.
bulgarian: Saturday comes again... and with it, the Market.

english: His taste is impeccable.
bulgarian: His taste is impeccable.

english: It is Market day. Today, I will visit Louis...
bulgarian: It is Market day. Today, I will visit Louis...

english: I think I will visit Merri's booth... she has many offerings suitable for adding to my hoard.
bulgarian: I think I will visit Merri's booth... she has many offerings suitable for adding to my hoard.

english: Saturday morning... so it is Market day again.
bulgarian: Saturday morning... so it is Market day again.

english: That Stillwell fellow claims to see the future...
bulgarian: That Stillwell fellow claims to see the future...

english: Well, he is not alone. Perhaps I will stop by his booth later and attempt to verify his skill for myself.
bulgarian: Well, he is not alone. Perhaps I will stop by his booth later and attempt to verify his skill for myself.

english: Good morning... it is Market day, is it not?
bulgarian: Good morning... it is Market day, is it not?

english: Perhaps I will go visit Taliferro and gaze at him disapprovingly.
bulgarian: Perhaps I will go visit Taliferro and gaze at him disapprovingly.

english: I enjoy watching him panic.
bulgarian: I enjoy watching him panic.

english: It is Saturday morning. I require amusement.
bulgarian: It is Saturday morning. I require amusement.

english: She is quite skilled... and quite fearless despite working in close proximity to my horns. I admire that.
bulgarian: She is quite skilled... and quite fearless despite working in close proximity to my horns. I admire that.

english: Good morning, [Ari]. I think I will visit Vera at the Market today.
bulgarian: Good morning, [Ari]. I think I will visit Vera at the Market today.

english: I threw it out immediately, of course.
bulgarian: I threw it out immediately, of course.

english: But I will visit him if I require amusement.
bulgarian: But I will visit him if I require amusement.

english: Good morning, [Ari]. I received a letter from Wheedle recently.
bulgarian: Good morning, [Ari]. I received a letter from Wheedle recently.

english: That Zorel... her enterprise always intrigues me.
bulgarian: That Zorel... her enterprise always intrigues me.

english: Few things have the power to move one so quickly as music.
bulgarian: Few things have the power to move one so quickly as music.

english: She would have thrived at my court, in another life.
bulgarian: She would have thrived at my court, in another life.

english: Another Saturday Market has arrived.
bulgarian: Another Saturday Market has arrived.

english: And now, we join those lives together. I will do the utmost to make this union joyful.
french: À présent, nos existences respectives se rejoignent. Je ferai tout mon possible pour que cette union soit heureuse.
russian: А теперь наши жизни сплелись воедино. Я сделаю всё, что в моих силах, чтобы этот союз приносил только радость.
bulgarian: And now, we join those lives together. I will do the utmost to make this union joyful.

english: I am elated, and unbearably excited. Together, we will make something new.
french: Cette idée m'emplit de joie et d'enthousiasme. Ensemble, nous allons créer quelque chose de nouveau.
russian: Я чувствую себя необычайно взволнованной, даже окрылённой. Вместе мы сотворим нечто совершенно новое.
bulgarian: I am elated, and unbearably excited. Together, we will make something new.

english: I can't wait.
french: Je n'en peux plus d'attendre.
russian: Мне уже не терпится.
bulgarian: I can't wait.

english: I'm so excited for our life together.
french: J'ai hâte qu'on passe notre vie ensemble.
russian:
Я

рады

радарадрадо, что мы начинаем совместную жизнь.
bulgarian: I'm so excited for our life together.

english: Nor I. And why should we?
french: Moi non plus. Alors, pourquoi remettre cela à plus tard ?
russian: Как и мне. Да и чего мы ждём?
bulgarian: Nor I. And why should we?

english: We can begin today. Right here and now.
french: Commençons dès aujourd'hui. Ici et maintenant.
russian: Мы можем начать сегодня же. Здесь и сейчас.
bulgarian: We can begin today. Right here and now.

english: Yes... I know already, this life will be an anchor. It will be good.
french: Oui... Je sais que cette vie sera un point d'ancrage. Ce sera épanouissant.
russian: Да... Я знаю наперёд, что эта жизнь станет моим якорем. Это будет хорошая жизнь.
bulgarian: Yes... I know already, this life will be an anchor. It will be good.

english: And know this, [Ari]. Anything you desire, physical or spiritual... I will see it done.
french: Et sache une chose, [Ari]. Quels que soient tes désirs, qu'ils soient physiques ou spirituels, je ferai en sorte qu'ils deviennent réalité.
russian: Знай, [Ari]. Какими бы ни были твои желания, материальные и духовные... Я их исполню.
bulgarian: And know this, [Ari]. Anything you desire, physical or spiritual... I will see it done.

english: [Ari]... you are the one who returned my life to me, from the bottom of an abyss...
french: [Ari], c'est toi qui m'as redonné vie et sortie du profond abîme où j'étais prisonnière...
russian:
[Ari]... Именно ты

возвратили

возвратилавозвратилвозвратило меня к жизни из подземных глубин...
bulgarian: [Ari]... you are the one who returned my life to me, from the bottom of an abyss...

english: It is all very charming. The animals in particular are far cuter than they have any right to be.
french: C'est vraiment charmant. En particulier les animaux : ils ne devraient pas avoir le droit d'être aussi mignons.
russian: Здесь очень мило устроено. И животные очаровательные до невозможности.
bulgarian: It is all very charming. The animals in particular are far cuter than they have any right to be.

english: However... Have you considered upgrading our little cottage into a castle? With towers? Ramparts? Fortifications?
french: Mais tu n'as jamais songé à transformer notre petite maisonnette en château ? Avec des tours, des remparts et des fortifications ?
russian:
И всё же... Ты не

думали

думаладумалдумало улучшить наше обиталище до замка? С башнями, заставами, укреплениями?
bulgarian: However... Have you considered upgrading our little cottage into a castle? With towers? Ramparts? Fortifications?

english: It is important to be able to protect what is most important to one's self.
french: Il est très important de protéger ce qui compte le plus à nos yeux.
russian: Важно уметь защитить то, что для тебя дорого.
bulgarian: It is important to be able to protect what is most important to one's self.

english: Not to mention, towers were quite popular during my reign. They give a home a sense of gravitas.
french: D'ailleurs, les tours étaient très en vogue durant mon règne. Elles apportent une touche de solennité à n'importe quelle propriété.
russian: К тому же, во времена моего правления башни были в моде. Они придают дому значительности.
bulgarian: Not to mention, towers were quite popular during my reign. They give a home a sense of gravitas.

english: I have now taken full account of the farm.
french: Je connais désormais l'ensemble de la ferme.
russian: Я завершила осмотр твой фермы.
bulgarian: I have now taken full account of the farm.

english: I take it that you have not seen any furniture moving of its own will recently? Dancing and prancing about?
french: Tu n'as vu aucun meuble se déplacer récemment ? Ou danser et sautiller de son propre chef ?
russian:
Как я понимаю, ты не

замечали

замечалазамечалзамечало, чтобы наша мебель самовольно двигалась? Кружилась и танцевала по комнате?
bulgarian: I take it that you have not seen any furniture moving of its own will recently? Dancing and prancing about?

english: Yes, excellent. Then all is rectified and in proper order.
french: Bien, excellent. Ça veut dire que tout est redevenu normal.
russian: Превосходно. Значит, всё в порядке, я всё исправила.
bulgarian: Yes, excellent. Then all is rectified and in proper order.

english: Wait, you... brought the furniture to life?
french: Comment ? Tu as donné vie à des meubles ?
russian: Погоди-ка... Ты оживила нашу мебель?
bulgarian: Wait, you... brought the furniture to life?

english: Wait, you were cleaning?
french: Attends, tu as fait le ménage ?
russian: Погоди, ты что, убиралась?
bulgarian: Wait, you were cleaning?

english: Hm? Oh yes.
french: Mmm ? Ah oui !
russian: Хм? А, да
bulgarian: Hm? Oh yes.

english: It was just for a moment. Do not fret, it is an occasional side-effect of the spell I use to clean my lair. Perfectly normal.
french: Cela n'a pas duré longtemps. Ne t'en fais pas, c'est juste un effet secondaire du sort que j'utilise pour nettoyer mon antre. Rien de grave.
russian: Лишь на мгновение. Не переживай, это побочный эффект заклинания, которое я использую для уборки в логове. Ничего сверхъестественного.
bulgarian: It was just for a moment. Do not fret, it is an occasional side-effect of the spell I use to clean my lair. Perfectly normal.

english: Very common, very mundane.
french: Ça arrive tout le temps.
russian: Просто бытовая рутина.
bulgarian: Very common, very mundane.

english: I once reigned over everything, which makes all realms my domain.
french: Il fut un temps où je régnais sur toute chose. Tout m'appartenait.
russian: Когда-то я правила всем светом, а значит, мне ничто не чуждо.
bulgarian: I once reigned over everything, which makes all realms my domain.

english: Which is to say, I may clean if the mood takes me. Or if it is of benefit to my beloved.
french: Cela veut dire que je fais le ménage si l'envie m'en prend. Ou si cela rend service à la personne que j'aime.
russian:
То есть, я могу иногда убираться, если будет настроение. Или если это порадует

моих возлюбленных

мою возлюбленнуюмоего возлюбленногомоё возлюбленное.
bulgarian: Which is to say, I may clean if the mood takes me. Or if it is of benefit to my beloved.

english: [Ari]... I have a perfectly innocent, cleaning-related inquiry for you.
french: [Ari], j'ai une question parfaitement innocente à te poser concernant le ménage.
russian: [Ari]... У меня к тебе совершенно безобидный вопрос касательно уборки.
bulgarian: [Ari]... I have a perfectly innocent, cleaning-related inquiry for you.

english: Worry not, I have mended all damaged furniture. As well as the puncture in the wall.
french: Mais ne t'en fais pas, j'ai réparé tout ce que j'avais abîmé. Et aussi les trous dans les murs.
russian: Не волнуйся, я уже починила сломанную мебель. И заделала брешь в стене.
bulgarian: Worry not, I have mended all damaged furniture. As well as the puncture in the wall.

english: But as your wife, I do have a request. Please do not mention any of this to the neighbors.
french: Toutefois, en tant qu'épouse, tu me promets que tu ne diras rien de tout cela aux voisins ?
russian: Но я хочу тебя кое-о-чём попросить как жена. Пожалуйста, не упоминай этот случай в разговорах с соседями.
bulgarian: But as your wife, I do have a request. Please do not mention any of this to the neighbors.

english: Oh no! Are you okay?
french: Oh non ! Tu ne t'es pas fait mal ?
russian: О, нет! Ты в порядке?
bulgarian: Oh no! Are you okay?

english: I'm sorry, that's so funny...
french: Pardon, mais c'est trop drôle...
russian: Прости, это слишком смешно...
bulgarian: I'm sorry, that's so funny...

english: Certainly. My tail is far more resilient than our furniture, after all.
french: Non, mes cornes sont bien plus résistantes que nos meubles.
russian: Разумеется. Ведь мой хвост гораздо прочнее нашей мебели.
bulgarian: Certainly. My tail is far more resilient than our furniture, after all.

english: It is only my ego that is bruised.
french: Seul mon ego en a pris un coup.
russian: Пострадало лишь моё самолюбие.
bulgarian: It is only my ego that is bruised.

english: You make merriment at my clumsiness?
french: Ma maladresse te fait rire ?
russian: Моя неуклюжесть вызывает у тебя смех?
bulgarian: You make merriment at my clumsiness?

english: If you were anyone else, I would see you punished.
french: N'importe qui d'autre aurait été puni de ma main.
russian: Если бы на твоём месте был кто-то ещё, он уже был бы сурово наказан.
bulgarian: If you were anyone else, I would see you punished.

english: But since it is you... I must admit, it was rather amusing.
french: Mais puisque c'est toi, je dois reconnaître que c'était plutôt amusant.
russian: Но поскольку это ты... Я признаю, было весьма забавно.
bulgarian: But since it is you... I must admit, it was rather amusing.

english: Ah, [Ari]. I am once again reminded that mortal homes are not built with tails in mind.
french: Ah, [Ari]. Je remarque une nouvelle fois, à mon corps défendant, que les maisons des mortels ne sont pas adaptées aux cornes des dragons.
russian: Ах, [Ari]. В очередной раз твой дом напомнил, что жилища смертных не рассчитаны на хвосты.
bulgarian: Ah, [Ari]. I am once again reminded that mortal homes are not built with tails in mind.

english: Court was full of unhappy arrangements for the sake of family and country.
french: À la cour, ce n'était qu'unions arrangées et tristes au nom de la famille et du royaume.
russian: При дворе всегда полно несчастливых браков, заключённых на благо семьи или государства.
bulgarian: Court was full of unhappy arrangements for the sake of family and country.

english: I did once have a vizier who seemed deeply infatuated with his partner, despite their marriage being arranged...
french: Toutefois, j'ai eu pour chambellan un homme qui semblait malgré tout fou amoureux de sa femme.
russian: Однажды был у меня визирь, без памяти влюблённый в своего партнёра. Пускай это и был брак по расчёту...
bulgarian: I did once have a vizier who seemed deeply infatuated with his partner, despite their marriage being arranged...

english: Though, he did try to poison me once. He was a complicated man.
french: Malheureusement, il a voulu m'empoisonner, un jour. C'était un homme assez complexe.
russian: Хотя один раз он пытался меня отравить. Это был сложный человек.
bulgarian: Though, he did try to poison me once. He was a complicated man.

english: In my life, there have been precious few role models for a loving partnership...
french: Au cours de ma vie, personne ne m'a expliqué ce qu'était l'amour.
russian: За свою жизнь я встречала крайне мало достойных примеров любви в отношениях...
bulgarian: In my life, there have been precious few role models for a loving partnership...

english: Will you adjust it for me?
french: Peux-tu les remettre droit ?
russian: Можешь мне поправить?
bulgarian: Will you adjust it for me?

english: Of course!
french: Bien sûr !
russian: Сейчас!
bulgarian: Of course!

english: Oh, it's a bit tangled.
french: Oh, ils se sont un peu emmêlés.
russian: Ой, они немного запутались.
bulgarian: Oh, it's a bit tangled.

english: Thank you.
french: Merci.
russian: Спасибо.
bulgarian: Thank you.

english: It is... good that I can ask you such things. In the past, to request assistance was to expose a fatal flaw.
french: Je suis heureuse de pouvoir te demander cela. Autrefois, demander de l'aide était un acte de faiblesse qui pouvait s'avérer fatal.
russian: Мне... приятно, что к тебе можно обратиться за помощью. Раньше такая просьба означала бы признание уязвимости.
bulgarian: It is... good that I can ask you such things. In the past, to request assistance was to expose a fatal flaw.

english: Your hands feel nice, too. That is also good.
french: Et la sensation de tes mains est agréable. Cela me plaît aussi beaucoup.
russian: И когда ты меня касаешься... Это тоже приятно.
bulgarian: Your hands feel nice, too. That is also good.

english: That explains it... thank you.
french: Ceci explique cela... Merci.
russian: Так вот, в чём дело... Спасибо.
bulgarian: That explains it... thank you.

english: It is... good that I can ask you such things. In the past, to request assistance was to expose a fatal flaw.
french: Je suis heureuse de pouvoir te demander cela. Autrefois, demander de l'aide était un acte de faiblesse qui pouvait s'avérer fatal.
russian: Мне... приятно, что к тебе можно обратиться за помощью. Раньше такая просьба означала бы признание уязвимости.
bulgarian: It is... good that I can ask you such things. In the past, to request assistance was to expose a fatal flaw.

english: Your hands feel nice, too. That is also good.
french: Et la sensation de tes mains est agréable. Cela me plaît aussi beaucoup.
russian: И когда ты меня касаешься... Это тоже приятно.
bulgarian: Your hands feel nice, too. That is also good.

english: [Ari], my jewelry feels crooked.
french: [Ari], j'ai l'impression que ma parure est de travers.
russian: [Ari] у меня, кажется, съехали украшения.
bulgarian: [Ari], my jewelry feels crooked.

english: I have learned of her many paramours, and her many near-marriages...
french: Elle m'a beaucoup parlé de ses innombrables amants et des nombreuses fois où elle a failli se marier.
russian: Я узнала про её многочисленные пассии, едва не дошедшие до брака...
bulgarian: I have learned of her many paramours, and her many near-marriages...

english: And she understands herself well enough to know none of those would-be fiancees would have made her happy.
french: En plus, elle se connaît assez pour savoir qu'aucun de ses soupirants ne l'aurait rendue heureuse.
russian: При этом она достаточно хорошо понимает себя и осознаёт, что никто из этих потенциальных супругов не смог бы принести ей счастья.
bulgarian: And she understands herself well enough to know none of those would-be fiancees would have made her happy.

english: I am not so self-assured as her. To have found someone who makes me so fulfilled... I celebrate it every day.
french: Je n'ai pas une telle confiance en moi. Je suis chaque jour reconnaissante d'avoir trouvé quelqu'un qui me comble à ce point.
russian: Я не могу похвастаться подобной самоуверенностью. Я нашла человека, который наполняет меня радостью... и каждый день прославляю эту встречу.
bulgarian: I am not so self-assured as her. To have found someone who makes me so fulfilled... I celebrate it every day.

english: I'll always celebrate you, too!
french: Moi aussi, je suis reconnaissant<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they> !
russian: Я тоже тебя прославляю!
bulgarian: I'll always celebrate you, too!

english: You celebrate me?
french: Je te comble ?
russian: Ты меня прославляешь?
bulgarian: You celebrate me?

english: Yes. In my heart I have always known this.
french: Oui. Je l'ai toujours su au fond de mon cœur.
russian: Верно. В душе я всегда это понимала.
bulgarian: Yes. In my heart I have always known this.

english: You need not even say it. You scoured the Mines endlessly to free me...
french: Tu n'as même pas à le dire. Tu as exploré les mines sans relâche pour me libérer...
russian:
Даже не обязательно было говорить. Ты

обрыскали

обрыскалаобрыскалобрыскало все шахты, чтобы освободить меня...
bulgarian: You need not even say it. You scoured the Mines endlessly to free me...

english: Know that I share your love, and will return your affections tenfold.
french: Sache que je partage ton amour et que je te rendrai ton affection au centuple.
russian: Знай, что я разделяю твою любовь и воздам за заботу стократ.
bulgarian: Know that I share your love, and will return your affections tenfold.

english: Of course... it is not even a question!
french: Bien sûr... Il n'y a même pas à se poser la question !
russian: Конечно... Это само собой разумеется!
bulgarian: Of course... it is not even a question!

english: Know that I share your love, and will return your affections tenfold.
french: Sache que je partage ton amour, et que je te rendrai ton affection au centuple.
russian: Знай, что я разделяю твою любовь и воздам за заботу стократ.
bulgarian: Know that I share your love, and will return your affections tenfold.

english: Despite her mortal lifespan, Elsie has accumulated great insight on life and love.
french: Malgré son espérance de vie réduite, Elsie a accumulé beaucoup de connaissances sur l'existence et sur l'amour.
russian: За свой смертный век Элси собрала немало премудростей — и о жизни, и о любви.
bulgarian: Despite her mortal lifespan, Elsie has accumulated great insight on life and love.

english: Living on this farm with you... it is precisely the opposite of what I endured for countless centuries.
french: La vie dans cette ferme, à tes côtés, c'est tout l'inverse de ce que j'ai enduré tout au long de ces innombrables siècles.
russian: А теперь я живу с тобой на ферме... и здесь всё ровно наоборот.
bulgarian: Living on this farm with you... it is precisely the opposite of what I endured for countless centuries.

english: It is as though I suddenly find myself in paradise, overflowing with lush green and flowers and... you.
french: C'est comme si je me retrouvais soudainement au paradis en étant entourée de verdure, de fleurs, et... de toi.
russian: Я как будто оказалась в райском саду. Меня окружают зелень, цветы и... ты.
bulgarian: It is as though I suddenly find myself in paradise, overflowing with lush green and flowers and... you.

english: You show me eternal paradise every day, [Ari].
french: Tu me montres que la vie est un paradis, [Ari].
russian: С тобой каждый день как в раю, [Ari].
bulgarian: You show me eternal paradise every day, [Ari].

english: I have been ruminating on what I thought was my eternal imprisonment.
french: J'ai beaucoup réfléchi au long de ce que je pensais être un emprisonnement éternel.
russian: Недавно я размышляла о своём заточении. Я была в плену много веков и думала, что это продлится вечность.
bulgarian: I have been ruminating on what I thought was my eternal imprisonment.

english: I felt you come near before I saw you. Your presence is like a gentle touch on my spine.
french: J'ai senti que tu approchais avant de te voir. Ta présence est comme une douce caresse le long de ma colonne vertébrale.
russian: Я не успела тебя увидеть, но ощутила твоё приближение, словно нежное касание по спине.
bulgarian: I felt you come near before I saw you. Your presence is like a gentle touch on my spine.

english: Whisper it in my ear, so I might make a memory of it.
french: Murmure-le-moi à l'oreille, que cela reste gravé dans ma mémoire.
russian: Шепни мне на ухо, чтобы я запомнила как следует.
bulgarian: Whisper it in my ear, so I might make a memory of it.

english: And tonight, or another night, I will remind you of what you've told me.
french: Et ce soir, ou un autre soir, je te rappellerai ce que tu m'as dit.
russian: И сегодня или в другую ночь я припомню тебе эти слова.
bulgarian: And tonight, or another night, I will remind you of what you've told me.

english: The aura of your energy does something to me. In all my life, I have never felt anything like it...
french: L'aura de ton énergie me fait quelque chose. Jamais je n'avais ressenti cela...
russian: Твоя энергетика необъяснимо на меня влияет. За всю жизнь я не испытывала ничего подобного...
bulgarian: The aura of your energy does something to me. In all my life, I have never felt anything like it...

english: And I am drawn to it like nothing else.
french: Et cette attirance à ton égard est une sensation nouvelle pour moi.
russian: И это невероятно притягивает.
bulgarian: And I am drawn to it like nothing else.

english: Oh? What do you like about my magic?
french: Oh ? Qu'est-ce qui te plaît, dans ma magie ?
russian: Ого! Чем тебя так привлекает моя магия?
bulgarian: Oh? What do you like about my magic?

english: I'm drawn to you, too, Seridia.
french: Moi aussi, j'ai de l'attirance pour toi, Seridia.
russian: Ты так же притягательна для меня, Серидия.
bulgarian: I'm drawn to you, too, Seridia.

english: Such impertinence.
french: Quelle impertinence !
russian: Как беззастенчиво!
bulgarian: Such impertinence.

english: I want to burn like a moth in your fire, [Ari].
french: Je veux brûler auprès de toi comme un papillon dans la flamme, [Ari].
russian: Я хочу сгореть в твоём пламени, как мотылёк, [Ari].
bulgarian: I want to burn like a moth in your fire, [Ari].

english: To feel your flames singe my wings, before I am swallowed up in a moment of searing ecstasy...
french: Je veux sentir ton feu qui effleure mes ailes, avant qu'une extase ardente ne m'engloutisse totalement...
russian: Ощутить, как огонь опаляет мне крылья и окутывает жгучим блаженством...
bulgarian: To feel your flames singe my wings, before I am swallowed up in a moment of searing ecstasy...

english: That is what I like about your magic, [Ari].
french: Voilà l'effet que me fait ta magie, [Ari].
russian: Вот чем меня привлекает твоя магия, [Ari].
bulgarian: That is what I like about your magic, [Ari].

english: Come closer, then, and tell me how I make you feel.
french: Alors, approche, et dis-moi ce que je te fais ressentir.
russian: Тогда подойди поближе и расскажи мне, что ты чувствуешь.
bulgarian: Come closer, then, and tell me how I make you feel.

english: That feels so far away, now. I am looking forward to a long, private romance with you, [Ari]...
french: Cela me paraît si loin désormais. Il me tarde de vivre une longue histoire d'amour avec toi, [Ari]...
russian: А теперь всё это так далеко. Меня ждёт долгая и личная история любви с тобой, [Ari]...
bulgarian: That feels so far away, now. I am looking forward to a long, private romance with you, [Ari]...

english: A special, secret history that is ours alone, with its own epochs, each making our life fuller than the last.
french: Une relation spéciale et secrète, juste pour nous deux, avec différentes phases plus passionnantes les unes que les autres.
russian: Наша особенная, не видимая миру история со своими эпохами. И каждая её глава будет радостней предыдущей.
bulgarian: A special, secret history that is ours alone, with its own epochs, each making our life fuller than the last.

english: I will savor every moment with you.
french: Je profiterai de chaque instant passé à tes côtés.
russian: Я буду наслаждаться каждым мгновением рядом с тобой.
bulgarian: I will savor every moment with you.

english: I am used to having relationships in the public eye, played out in the court of public opinion.
french: J'étais habituée à ce que mes relations soient rendues publiques et que tout le monde me juge.
russian: Я привыкла показывать отношения на публику, разыгрывать спектакль перед взыскательным обществом.
bulgarian: I am used to having relationships in the public eye, played out in the court of public opinion.

english: In you, I sense an ambition that holds a mirror to my own.
french: Je perçois en toi une ambition qui reflète la mienne.
russian: Я чувствую, что твои устремления отражают и мои.
bulgarian: In you, I sense an ambition that holds a mirror to my own.

english: When I first came to this land, I had nothing but burning ambition to lift my wings.
french: Quand je suis arrivée pour la première fois sur ces terres, je n'avais rien d'autre que l'ambition brûlante de déployer mes ailes.
russian: Когда я впервые прибыла в эти земли, я горела лишь одним желанием — расправить крылья.
bulgarian: When I first came to this land, I had nothing but burning ambition to lift my wings.

english: Where did you come from, originally?
french: D'où viens-tu, à l'origine ?
russian: А откуда ты изначально?
bulgarian: Where did you come from, originally?

english: Why did you come here?
french: Pourquoi es-tu venue ici ?
russian: А зачем ты пришла сюда?
bulgarian: Why did you come here?

english: What an interesting question. The same place we all come from, I suppose.
french: Quelle question intéressante ! De là d'où nous venons tous, j'imagine.
russian: Какой занимательный вопрос. Пожалуй, из того же места, откуда все мы.
bulgarian: What an interesting question. The same place we all come from, I suppose.

english: But I was hatched in the $Magic Realm$ and later emerged from the $Gate Between Worlds$, if that is what you mean to ask.
french: Mais j'ai éclos dans le $royaume de la magie$ et j'ai plus tard franchi la $porte entre les mondes$ pour venir ici, si telle est ta question.
russian: Но вылупилась я в $мире магии$, а затем прошла сквозь $врата между мирами$. Если твой вопрос был об этом.
bulgarian: But I was hatched in the $Magic Realm$ and later emerged from the $Gate Between Worlds$, if that is what you mean to ask.

english: How nostalgic. I have not thought on my first youth in many ages...
french: Que de souvenirs ! Je n'avais pas pensé à ma prime jeunesse depuis des lustres...
russian: Ах, ностальгия. Я много веков не вспоминала свою раннюю юность...
bulgarian: How nostalgic. I have not thought on my first youth in many ages...

english: What an interesting question. Why, indeed?
french: Quelle question intéressante ! Pourquoi, en effet ?
russian: Какой занимательный вопрос. В самом деле, зачем?
bulgarian: What an interesting question. Why, indeed?

english: I emerged from the $Gate Between Worlds$ as a harbinger and architect of $Magic$, if that is what you mean to ask.
french: J'ai franchi la $porte entre les mondes$ en tant que messagère et architecte de la $magie$, si tel est le sens de ta question.
russian: Я прошла сквозь $врата между мирами$ как посланник и творец $магии$. Если твой вопрос был об этом.
bulgarian: I emerged from the $Gate Between Worlds$ as a harbinger and architect of $Magic$, if that is what you mean to ask.

english: How nostalgic. I have not thought on my first youth in many ages...
french: Que de souvenirs ! Je n'avais pas pensé à ma prime jeunesse depuis des lustres...
russian: Ах, ностальгия. Я много веков не вспоминала свою раннюю юность...
bulgarian: How nostalgic. I have not thought on my first youth in many ages...

english: It is my understanding that you first came to Mistria seeking your fortune.
french: J'ai cru comprendre que tu étais arrivé<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they> à Mistria à la recherche de ta bonne fortune...
russian:
Как я понимаю, ты

прибыли

прибылаприбылприбыло в Мистрию в поисках счастья.
bulgarian: It is my understanding that you first came to Mistria seeking your fortune.

english: It is curious. I am older than the very ground they walk upon...
french: C'est curieux. Je suis plus âgée que le sol qu'ils foulent...
russian: Занимательно. Ведь я старше самой земли, что у них под ногами...
bulgarian: It is curious. I am older than the very ground they walk upon...

english: And yet, they approach fearlessly, to speak of the weather and to ask after the simple happenings of my day.
french: Et pourtant, ils m'approchent sans crainte pour me parler du temps qu'il fait et pour s'enquérir des menus événements de ma journée.
russian: Однако они без страха приходят обсудить погоду и мои повседневные свершения.
bulgarian: And yet, they approach fearlessly, to speak of the weather and to ask after the simple happenings of my day.

english: I am... surprised. A commoner's life does not have so bitter a taste.
french: J'en suis... surprise. La vie d'un roturier n'a pas un goût si amer, finalement.
russian: Я... удивлена. Жизнь простолюдина оказалась не такой уже горькой на вкус.
bulgarian: I am... surprised. A commoner's life does not have so bitter a taste.

english: The denizens of Mistria treat me as they would any neighbor.
french: Les citoyens de Mistria me traitent comme n'importe quelle voisine.
russian: Обитатели Мистрии относятся ко мне как к обычному соседу.
bulgarian: The denizens of Mistria treat me as they would any neighbor.

english: But then I thought it might raise questions for your neighbors, nosy as they are.
french: Mais j'ai ensuite réalisé que cela susciterait des questions de tes voisins, indiscrets comme ils sont.
russian: Но потом подумала, что это может вызвать вопросы у твоих любознательных соседей.
bulgarian: But then I thought it might raise questions for your neighbors, nosy as they are.

english: Do you see how the scales yet glisten? Here. Accept my prey, freshly hunted from Mistria's river.
french: Vois-tu comment ses écailles luisent encore ? Tiens. Accepte ma proie, fraîchement chassée dans la rivière de Mistria.
russian: Видишь, как блестят чешуйки? Прими её. Это свежая добыча прямиком из мистрийской реки.
bulgarian: Do you see how the scales yet glisten? Here. Accept my prey, freshly hunted from Mistria's river.

english: Do you see how the scales yet glisten? Here. Accept my prey, freshly hunted from Mistria's river.
french: Vois-tu comment ses écailles luisent encore ? Tiens. Accepte ma proie, fraîchement chassée dans la rivière de Mistria.
russian: Видишь, как блестят чешуйки? Прими её. Это свежая добыча прямиком из мистрийской реки.
bulgarian: Do you see how the scales yet glisten? Here. Accept my prey, freshly hunted from Mistria's river.

english: I have something for you. At first, I thought to leave it on your doorstep...
french: J'ai quelque chose pour toi. J'avais d'abord envisagé le déposer à ta porte...
russian: У меня для тебя кое-что есть, [Ari]. Вначале я хотела оставить у тебя на пороге...
bulgarian: I have something for you. At first, I thought to leave it on your doorstep...

english: I discovered this one as it dined on smaller fish. It clearly did not expect a more fearsome predator to come along!
french: J'ai découvert celui-ci tandis que je mangeais un plus petit poisson. Je ne m'attendais pas à ce qu'un prédateur plus redoutable s'approche !
russian: Этого я застала за поеданием более мелких рыб. Он явно не ожидал, что его настигнет хищник прокрупнее!
bulgarian: I discovered this one as it dined on smaller fish. It clearly did not expect a more fearsome predator to come along!

english: I discovered this one as it dined on smaller fish. It clearly did not expect a more fearsome predator to come along!
french: J'ai découvert celui-ci tandis que je mangeais un plus petit poisson. Je ne m'attendais pas à ce qu'un prédateur plus redoutable s'approche !
russian: Этого я застала за поеданием более мелких рыб. Он явно не ожидал, что его настигнет хищник прокрупнее!
bulgarian: I discovered this one as it dined on smaller fish. It clearly did not expect a more fearsome predator to come along!

english: In the waters of Mistria, there still live behemoths to rival the size of a youngling dragon.
french: Dans les eaux de Mistria vivent encore des animaux géants, qui rivalisent par leur taille avec un jeune dragon.
russian: В водах Мистрии до сих пор живут чудовища, по размерам почти с юного дракона.
bulgarian: In the waters of Mistria, there still live behemoths to rival the size of a youngling dragon.

english: I remain an undefeated victor. Gaze upon the vanquished, [Ari].
french: J'ai une nouvelle fois emporté la victoire. Admire le vaincu, [Ari].
russian: До сих пор никому не удавалось меня победить. Узри моего поверженного врага, [Ari].
bulgarian: I remain an undefeated victor. Gaze upon the vanquished, [Ari].

english: I remain an undefeated victor. Gaze upon the vanquished, [Ari].
french: J'ai une nouvelle fois emporté la victoire. Admire le vaincu, [Ari].
russian: До сих пор никому не удавалось меня победить. Узри моего поверженного врага, [Ari].
bulgarian: I remain an undefeated victor. Gaze upon the vanquished, [Ari].

english: It gladdens me that there are still giants of the sea that will accept my challenge to one-on-one combat.
french: Cela me réjouit qu'il existe encore en mer des géants qui acceptent d'être défiés par moi en combat singulier.
russian: Мне доставляет радость, что в море до сих пор водятся гиганты, способные принять мой вызов один на один.
bulgarian: It gladdens me that there are still giants of the sea that will accept my challenge to one-on-one combat.

english: The fight was a reward in itself. And as my most devoted mortal... I bequeath to you the spoils.
french: Le combat a été une récompense en soi. Et puisque tu es l'être mortel qui m'est le plus dévoué... Je te lègue mon butin.
russian: Эта битва и есть моя награда. А тебе как моему самому верному смертному... Я принесла трофеи.
bulgarian: The fight was a reward in itself. And as my most devoted mortal... I bequeath to you the spoils.

english: The fight was a reward in itself. And as my most cherished mortal... I bequeath to you my spoils.
french: Le combat a été une récompense en soi. Et puisque tu es l'être mortel qui m'est le plus dévoué... Je te lègue mon butin.
russian: Эта битва и есть моя награда. А тебе как моему самому близкому смертному... Я принесла трофеи.
bulgarian: The fight was a reward in itself. And as my most cherished mortal... I bequeath to you my spoils.

english: [Ari], I have returned from a magnificent battle, where I faced off against a creature of ferocious demeanor and many teeth.
french: Je reviens d'un combat magnifique, [Ari]. J'ai affronté une créature au comportement féroce et aux nombreuses dents.
russian: [Ari], я вернулась с грандиозной битвы против твари со множеством зубов и свирепым нравом.
bulgarian: [Ari], I have returned from a magnificent battle, where I faced off against a creature of ferocious demeanor and many teeth.

english: Tell me, [Ari]. Do you recall any past lives?
french: Dis-moi, [Ari]. Te souviens-tu de tes précédentes existences ?
russian: Скажи, [Ari], ты помнишь свои прошые жизни?
bulgarian: Tell me, [Ari]. Do you recall any past lives?

english: I do not...
french: Absolument pas...
russian: Не помню...
bulgarian: I do not...

english: Sometimes I get flashes of something...
french: J'ai parfois des sortes de flashes...
russian: Иногда у меня бывают проблески...
bulgarian: Sometimes I get flashes of something...

english: I see. That is not necessarily a bad thing.
french: Je vois. Ce n'est pas nécessairement une mauvaise chose.
russian: Понятно. Но это не обязательно плохо.
bulgarian: I see. That is not necessarily a bad thing.

english: You are unencumbered by memories and knowledge that have become irrelevant.
french: Les souvenirs ne t'encombrent pas, pas plus que des connaissances devenues inutiles.
russian:
Ты не

обременены

обремененаобременёнобременено знаниями и памятью, которые уже не нужны.
bulgarian: You are unencumbered by memories and knowledge that have become irrelevant.

english: That means you are free to write the story of your life to a blank page.
french: Cela signifie que tu es libre d'écrire l'histoire de ta vie sur une page blanche.
russian: А значит, ты можешь писать историю своей жизни с чистого листа.
bulgarian: That means you are free to write the story of your life to a blank page.

english: I had sensed it.
french: Je l'avais perçu.
russian: Я почуяла это в тебе.
bulgarian: I had sensed it.

english: Living many lives is a complicated thing.
french: Vivre plusieurs existences est une chose compliquée.
russian: Жить множество жизней — сложное занятие.
bulgarian: Living many lives is a complicated thing.

english: It is easy to begin comparing your present to your past. One must be careful.
french: Il est facile de commencer à comparer son présent à son passé. Il faut faire attention.
russian: Легко поддаться соблазну сравнивать настоящее с прошлым. Но это надо делать с осторожностью.
bulgarian: It is easy to begin comparing your present to your past. One must be careful.

english: Glean wisdom, but remember that this life is yours to shape.
french: Glane un peu de sagesse, mais souviens-toi que c'est à toi de façonner ta vie actuelle.
russian: Из прошлого можно почерпнуть мудрость, но помни: эту жизнь ты можешь прожить, как пожелаешь.
bulgarian: Glean wisdom, but remember that this life is yours to shape.

english: Glean wisdom, but remember that this life is yours to shape.
french: Glane un peu de sagesse, mais souviens-toi que c'est à toi de façonner ta vie actuelle.
russian: Из прошлого можно почерпнуть мудрость, но помни: эту жизнь ты можешь прожить, как пожелаешь.
bulgarian: Glean wisdom, but remember that this life is yours to shape.

english: I have been wondering, lately...
french: Je m'interroge, ces derniers temps...
russian: Недавно я задумалась вот о чём...
bulgarian: I have been wondering, lately...
