english: When I look at your farm, with your beasts and your familiar, I see that you both tithe and protect...
french: Quand j'observe ta ferme, avec tes bêtes et tes animaux domestiques, je vois que tu les protèges tout en prélevant une dîme.
russian: Я смотрю на твою ферму, на твой скот и твоего фамильяра и вижу, что ты собираешь дань и даёшь защиту...
bulgarian: When I look at your farm, with your beasts and your familiar, I see that you both tithe and protect...

english: It would be foolish not to recognize your own potential, [Ari].
french: Il serait folie de ne pas admettre ton potentiel, [Ari].
russian: Не признать свой потенциал было бы глупо, [Ari].
bulgarian: It would be foolish not to recognize your own potential, [Ari].

english: It is as though you have your own little fiefdom. Are you certain that you have no desire to rule?
french: C'est un peu comme si tu avais ton propre fief. N'as-tu vraiment aucun désir de régner ?
russian: Как будто это твоя маленькая вотчина. Ты точно не испытываешь тяги к власти?
bulgarian: It is as though you have your own little fiefdom. Are you certain that you have no desire to rule?

english: I don't know that I'd call it a fiefdom...
french: Je ne sais pas si j'appellerais ça un fief...
russian:
Не

уверены

уверенауверенуверено, что это можно назвать вотчиной...
bulgarian: I don't know that I'd call it a fiefdom...

english: Well if you put it like that...
french: Eh bien, présenté comme ça...
russian: Ну, если взглянуть с такой стороны...
bulgarian: Well if you put it like that...

english: Is it not?
french: N'est-ce pas cela ?
russian: А почему нет?
bulgarian: Is it not?

english: Do your animals not obey your decrees as though you are their sovereign?
french: Tes animaux n'obéissent-ils pas à tes décrets comme si tu étais leur souverain<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they> ?
russian: Разве животные не подчиняются твоим приказам, как будто ты ими правишь?
bulgarian: Do your animals not obey your decrees as though you are their sovereign?

english: Do your fields not offer you tribute in abundance?
french: Tes champs ne t'offrent-ils pas de tribut en abondance ?
russian: Разве поля не дают тебе обильных подаяний?
bulgarian: Do your fields not offer you tribute in abundance?

english: Perhaps you are simply not ready to recognize your potential, [Ari].
french: Peut-être n'es-tu tout simplement pas <he>prêt à </he><she>prête à </she><they>encore en mesure d'</they>admettre ton potentiel ?
russian:
Возможно, ты просто не

готовы

готоваготовготово признать свой потенциал, [Ari].
bulgarian: Perhaps you are simply not ready to recognize your potential, [Ari].

english: I knew it.
french: J'en étais sûre.
russian: Я так и знала.
bulgarian: I knew it.

english: For your animals obey your decrees as though you are their sovereign.
french: Car tes animaux obéissent à tes décrets comme si tu étais leur souverain<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they>.
russian: Ведь животные подчиняются твоим приказам, как будто ты ими правишь.
bulgarian: For your animals obey your decrees as though you are their sovereign.

english: And your fields seem to offer you tribute in abundance.
french: Et tes champs semblent t'offrir un tribut en abondance.
russian: И поля дают тебе обильные подаяния.
bulgarian: And your fields seem to offer you tribute in abundance.

english: I find myself curious.
french: J'éprouve une certaine curiosité.
russian: Меня охватывает любопытство.
bulgarian: I find myself curious.

english: In the past, those who sought my favor were motivated by a desire to gain power.
french: Par le passé, ceux qui cherchaient à gagner mes faveurs étaient motivés par la soif de pouvoir.
russian: Раньше теми, кто добивался моей милости, двигала жажда власти.
bulgarian: In the past, those who sought my favor were motivated by a desire to gain power.

english: But your desire is... true friendship.
french: Mais toi, tu aspires à... une amitié véritable.
russian: Но тобой движет... искренняя дружба.
bulgarian: But your desire is... true friendship.

english: But your desire is... true companionship.
french: Mais toi, tu aspires à... un compagnonnage véritable.
russian: Но тобой движет... искренняя привязанность.
bulgarian: But your desire is... true companionship.

english: Across all my lives, in all my memories... you are singular in that trait.
french: Dans toutes mes vies, parmi tous mes souvenirs... Tu es en cela une personne singulière.
russian:
Во всей моей памяти всех моих жизней... в этом своём качестве ты

уникальны

уникальнауникаленуникально.
bulgarian: Across all my lives, in all my memories... you are singular in that trait.

english: You... perplex me, [Ari].
french: Tu me laisses... perplexe, [Ari].
russian: [Ari]... Я от тебя в недоумении.
bulgarian: You... perplex me, [Ari].

english: My scales are your shield; my flame your sword".
french: « Mes écailles sont ton bouclier, ma flamme est ton épée. »
russian: «Моя чешуя будет тебе щитом, моё пламя будет тебе мечом».
bulgarian: My scales are your shield; my flame your sword".

english: I have laid low many enemies with my dragon fire...
french: J'ai décimé bien des ennemis avec mon souffle enflammé de dragon...
russian: Своим пламенем я повергла множество врагов...
bulgarian: I have laid low many enemies with my dragon fire...

english: Know that I will turn it on any enemy you desire, [Ari]. You need only ask.
french: Sache que je le dirigerai sur n'importe lequel de tes ennemis si tu le souhaites, [Ari]. Il te suffit de demander.
russian: Знай, что я готова обратить его против любого, кто тебе неугоден, [Ari]. Лишь только ты попросишь.
bulgarian: Know that I will turn it on any enemy you desire, [Ari]. You need only ask.

english: Among dragon-human relationships, there is an old saying that expresses a close bond. It translates roughly to...
french: Dans les relations entre humains et dragons, il existe un vieil adage pour exprimer un lien fort. On peut le traduire approximativement, par...
russian: Про отношения драконов и людей есть старинное выражение, означающее близкую связь. Перевод примерно такой:
bulgarian: Among dragon-human relationships, there is an old saying that expresses a close bond. It translates roughly to...

english: The repetition of war and conquest, multiplied by eons... it blurs together.
french: La répétition des guerres et des conquêtes, sur des siècles et des siècles... tout cela se mélange.
russian: Войны и завоевания идут одна за другой, повторяясь из века в век... И сливаются в единое полотно.
bulgarian: The repetition of war and conquest, multiplied by eons... it blurs together.

english: By contrast, this life, in all its quietude... has proven noteworthy.
french: À l'inverse, cette vie, dans toute sa quiétude... s'est révélée digne d'intérêt.
russian: На их фоне эта жизнь отличается... Она примечательна своей умиротворённостью.
bulgarian: By contrast, this life, in all its quietude... has proven noteworthy.

english: I find that it suits me. More than I expected.
french: Il s'avère qu'elle me convient. Plus que je ne m'y attendais.
russian: Я нахожу, что мне это по нраву. Более, чем я ожидала.
bulgarian: I find that it suits me. More than I expected.

english: I find that it suits me. Or... perhaps it is you that suits me, [Ari].
french: Il s'avère qu'elle me convient. À moins que ce soit toi qui me conviennes, [Ari].
russian: Я нахожу, что мне это по нраву. Или, возможно... Ты мне по нраву, [Ari].
bulgarian: I find that it suits me. Or... perhaps it is you that suits me, [Ari].

english: I have been thinking. Of the many lives I have lived, this one is unusual.
french: J'ai réfléchi. Des nombreuses vies que j'ai vécues, celle-ci est inhabituelle.
russian: Я размышляла и пришла к выводу: эта жизнь отличается от всех, что я прожила.
bulgarian: I have been thinking. Of the many lives I have lived, this one is unusual.

english: It is strange how mortal authors are convinced an endless existence is one of sadness and tedium. How dull.
french: Il est étrange de voir que les auteurs mortels sont convaincus qu'une existence éternelle serait nécessairement triste et ennuyeuse. C'est insipide.
russian: Мне странно убеждение смертных авторов, что вечная жизнь полна скуки и тоски. Как прозаично.
bulgarian: It is strange how mortal authors are convinced an endless existence is one of sadness and tedium. How dull.

english: Only the most unimaginative mind would find the eternal cycle to be boring.
french: Seuls des esprits dépourvus d'imagination peuvent trouver le cycle éternel ennuyeux.
russian: Лишь очень ограниченные умы могут счесть вечный цикл жизни скучным.
bulgarian: Only the most unimaginative mind would find the eternal cycle to be boring.

english: No... living is simply the most exciting thing there is.
french: Non... Vivre est simplement la chose la plus palpitante qui soit.
russian: Нет уж... Жизнь — это самое увлекательное из всех занятий.
bulgarian: No... living is simply the most exciting thing there is.

english: No... living is simply the most exciting thing there is.
french: Non... Vivre est simplement la chose la plus palpitante qui soit.
russian: Нет уж... Жизнь — это самое увлекательное из всех занятий.
bulgarian: No... living is simply the most exciting thing there is.

english: Lady Elsie has been sharing her collection of novels with me. More specifically, books on the topic of immortal lovers.
french: Dame Elsie a partagé avec moi sa collection de romans. Plus précisément, ses ouvrages consacrés aux amours immortelles.
russian: Леди Элси делится со мной романами из своей коллекции. А точнее, книгами на тему бессмертной любви.
bulgarian: Lady Elsie has been sharing her collection of novels with me. More specifically, books on the topic of immortal lovers.

english: In the past, I had access to many options when I desired entertainment.
french: Par le passé, de nombreuses options s'offraient à moi quand j'avais envie de divertissement.
russian: В прошлом у меня был широкий выбор развлечений.
bulgarian: In the past, I had access to many options when I desired entertainment.

english: It is good to match one's skill and prowess against a variety of foes, and the water is an arena oft neglected.
french: Il est bon de mesurer ses compétences et son habileté contre différents ennemis et l'eau est une arène souvent négligée.
russian: Полезно соотносить свою храбрость и свои таланты с разными противниками. А о такой арене битвы, как вода, нечасто вспоминают.
bulgarian: It is good to match one's skill and prowess against a variety of foes, and the water is an arena oft neglected.

english: That is not a bad idea.
french: Ce n'est pas une mauvaise idée.
russian: Вполне неплохая идея.
bulgarian: That is not a bad idea.

english: Although objects from antiquity hold little interest for me, it seems there are also samples of modern flora and fauna on display...
french: Bien que les objets de l'antiquité n'aient que peu d'intérêt pour moi, il semble y avoir quelques exemplaires de la faune et de la flore moderne d'exposés...
russian: Хотя предметы старины не вызывают у меня интереса, кажется, на витринах есть образцы современной флоры и фауны...
bulgarian: Although objects from antiquity hold little interest for me, it seems there are also samples of modern flora and fauna on display...

english: Familiarizing myself with both may prove to be quite interesting.
french: Me familiariser avec eux pourrait s'avérer intéressant.
russian: Их изучение может быть весьма интересным занятием.
bulgarian: Familiarizing myself with both may prove to be quite interesting.

english: For instance, one could investigate who was on display at the pillory for the day...
french: Par exemple, il était possible d'aller voir qui était mis au pilori ce jour-là...
russian: К примеру, можно было посмотреть, кого сегодня выставляют на позорном столбе...
bulgarian: For instance, one could investigate who was on display at the pillory for the day...

english: Or pay a visit to a gladiatorial arena, as either competitor or spectator.
french: Ou de se rendre à l'arène des gladiateurs, comme participant ou spectateur.
russian: Или наведаться в гладиаторскую арену — и как участник, и как зритель.
bulgarian: Or pay a visit to a gladiatorial arena, as either competitor or spectator.

english: Tell me, what do the townspeople of this age do for entertainment?
french: Dis-moi, que font les habitants d'aujourd'hui pour se distraire ?
russian: Скажи мне, чем развлекают себя местные жители в эту эпоху?
bulgarian: Tell me, what do the townspeople of this age do for entertainment?

english: You could play cards at the Inn...
french: Nous pourrions jouer aux cartes à l'auberge...
russian: Можно поиграть в карты в трактире...
bulgarian: You could play cards at the Inn...

english: How about some fishing?
french: Que dirais-tu d'aller pêcher ?
russian: Как насчёт рыбалки?
bulgarian: How about some fishing?

english: You could visit the Museum!
french: Tu pourrais visiter le musée !
russian: Можно сходить в музей!
bulgarian: You could visit the Museum!

english: Intriguing! Is there betting involved?
french: Cela m'intrigue ! Est-il aussi possible de parier ?
russian: Заманчивое предложение! Там принимаются ставки?
bulgarian: Intriguing! Is there betting involved?

english: Perhaps I will seek it out. Much can be learned by winning the cherished possessions of others.
french: Je vais peut-être découvrir cela. On peut apprendre beaucoup de choses en gagnant les précieuses possessions d'autrui.
russian: Возможно, я попробую. Выигрывая себе чужие любимые вещи, можно узнать много нового.
bulgarian: Perhaps I will seek it out. Much can be learned by winning the cherished possessions of others.

english: You see, the worth of an object is measured by how badly one wishes to keep it. In that sense... my hoard is priceless.
french: Vois-tu, la valeur d'un objet se mesure à l'intensité avec laquelle on souhaite le conserver. En ce sens... mon trésor est inestimable.
russian: Видишь ли, ценность предмета определяется тем, насколько обладатель готов с ним расстаться. И в этом смысле... мои сокровища бесценны.
bulgarian: You see, the worth of an object is measured by how badly one wishes to keep it. In that sense... my hoard is priceless.

english: Ah yes... water hunting.
french: Ah oui... La chasse aquatique
russian: Ах, да... Охота в воде.
bulgarian: Ah yes... water hunting.

english: I approve of such a pastime.
french: J'approuve ce passe-temps.
russian: Такой досуг я одобряю.
bulgarian: I approve of such a pastime.

english: I would enjoy a distraction today, [Ari]. It is good to step away from one's work now and then.
french: J'aimerais me distraire, aujourd'hui, [Ari]. Il est bon de s'éloigner un peu du travail, de temps à autre.
russian: Сегодня я бы хотела отвлечься, [Ari]. Время от времени полезно отходить от работы.
bulgarian: I would enjoy a distraction today, [Ari]. It is good to step away from one's work now and then.

english: The children... They made an intriguing inquiry.
french: Les enfants... Ils m'ont posé une curieuse question.
russian: Дети... Задались весьма интригующим вопросом.
bulgarian: The children... They made an intriguing inquiry.

english: I am his elder, therefore it is only sensible that I would be the larger dragon.
french: Je suis son aînée, il est donc logique que je sois le dragon le plus grand.
russian: Я старше его, так что совершенно логично, что я являюсь и более крупным драконом.
bulgarian: I am his elder, therefore it is only sensible that I would be the larger dragon.

english: Surely you jest.
french: Tu es sûrement en train de plaisanter.
russian: Ты, должно быть, шутишь.
bulgarian: Surely you jest.

english: They wanted to know who is taller: myself, or that fool Caldarus.
french: Ils voulaient savoir qui, de moi ou de cet imbécile de Caldarus, était le plus grand.
russian: Они хотят узнать, кто выше: я или этот остолоп Кальдарус.
bulgarian: They wanted to know who is taller: myself, or that fool Caldarus.

english: You're definitely taller.
french: Tu es la plus grande, c'est certain.
russian: Ты совершенно точно выше.
bulgarian: You're definitely taller.

english: Caldarus might be a hair taller than you...
french: Caldarus est peut-être plus grand que toi d'un cheveu...
russian: Возможно, Кальдарус выше тебя на волосок...
bulgarian: Caldarus might be a hair taller than you...

english: It's hard to say!
french: C'est difficile à dire !
russian: Трудно сказать!
bulgarian: It's hard to say!

english: Yes, of course.
french: Oui, évidemment.
russian: Ну разумеется.
bulgarian: Yes, of course.

english: You would not lie to me, so it must be the truth.
french: Tu ne me mentirais pas, ce doit donc être la vérité.
russian: Ты не станешь мне лгать, так что это определённо правда.
bulgarian: You would not lie to me, so it must be the truth.

english: I am his elder, therefore it is only sensible that I would be the larger dragon.
french: Je suis son aînée, il est donc logique que je sois le dragon le plus grand.
russian: Я старше его, так что совершенно логично, что я являюсь и более крупным драконом.
bulgarian: I am his elder, therefore it is only sensible that I would be the larger dragon.

english: Still, to crush all doubt...
french: Néanmoins, pour qu'il ne subsiste pas le moindre doute...
russian: И всё же, чтобы развеять сомнения...
bulgarian: Still, to crush all doubt...

english: I will speak with Juniper. She will instruct me in the dark arts of...
french: Je vais aller parler à Juniper. Elle m'enseignera les sombres arcanes des...
russian: Я поговорю с Джунипер. Она должна просветить меня в тёмном искусстве...
bulgarian: I will speak with Juniper. She will instruct me in the dark arts of...

english: The platform heel.
french: Chaussures à talon.
russian: Высоких каблуков.
bulgarian: The platform heel.

english: Such a thing is impossible.
french: Une telle chose est impossible.
russian: Такого не может быть.
bulgarian: Such a thing is impossible.

english: One moment, [Ari]. There is a matter that I would like you to settle for me.
french: Un instant, [Ari]. Il y a un sujet que j'aimerais que tu tranches pour moi.
russian: На минутку, [Ari]. Я попрошу тебя разрешить небольшой спор.
bulgarian: One moment, [Ari]. There is a matter that I would like you to settle for me.

english: Do you ever gaze into the endless night?
french: As-tu déjà contemplé l'infinité de la nuit ?
russian: Ты часто всматриваешься в ночное небо?
bulgarian: Do you ever gaze into the endless night?

english: Through every one of my many lives... that vastness has been ever a companion, and my greatest source of power.
french: À travers chacune de mes nombreuses vies... cette immensité a toujours été une compagne, et ma plus grande source de pouvoir.
russian: Через все мои жизни этот бескрайний океан сопровождает меня... в нём главный источник моей силы.
bulgarian: Through every one of my many lives... that vastness has been ever a companion, and my greatest source of power.

english: Mark it upon your soul, [Ari]. If you are ever in true need... the night will guide you to me.
french: Imprime ceci dans ton âme, [Ari]. Si un jour tu en as réellement besoin... la nuit te guidera jusqu'à moi.
russian: В душе своей знай, [Ari]: если придёт нужда... ночь приведёт тебя ко мне.
bulgarian: Mark it upon your soul, [Ari]. If you are ever in true need... the night will guide you to me.

english: Mark it upon your soul, [Ari]. If you are ever in true need... the night will guide you to me.
french: Imprime ceci dans ton âme, [Ari]. Si un jour tu en as réellement besoin... la nuit te guidera jusqu'à moi.
russian: В душе своей знай, [Ari]: если придёт нужда... ночь приведёт тебя ко мне.
bulgarian: Mark it upon your soul, [Ari]. If you are ever in true need... the night will guide you to me.

english: [Ari], come closer and look up.
french: Approche et regarde-moi, [Ari].
russian: [Ari], подойди поближе и посмотри вверх.
bulgarian: [Ari], come closer and look up.

english: It seems to me that you are not intimidated by my presence, [Ari].
french: Ma présence ne semble pas t'intimider, [Ari].
russian: Я замечаю, что тебя не пугает мой облик, [Ari].
bulgarian: It seems to me that you are not intimidated by my presence, [Ari].

english: My tail... is "cool"?
french: Ma queue est... « sympa » ?
russian: Мой хвост... выглядит «круто»?
bulgarian: My tail... is "cool"?

english: I... see. You may touch it, if you like. However-
french: Je... Je vois. Tu peux la toucher, si tu le souhaites. Néanmoins...
russian: Ясно... Можешь потрогать, если хочешь. Только...
bulgarian: I... see. You may touch it, if you like. However-

english: Mind your fingers near the barb... it is sharp.
french: Attention à tes doigts près du piquant... Il est très acéré.
russian: Осторожнее возле шипа... Он у меня острый.
bulgarian: Mind your fingers near the barb... it is sharp.

english: Worry not. I shall not poison you.
french: Ne t'inquiète pas. Je ne t'empoisonnerai pas.
russian: Не переживай. Я не стану тебя травить...
bulgarian: Worry not. I shall not poison you.

english: Unless you are curious...
french: Sauf pour satisfaire ta curiosité...
russian: Если только ты не захочешь это испытать...
bulgarian: Unless you are curious...

english: Horns, sinew, tail, claws... I have honed all facets of my appearance to put fear in the heart of those who behold me.
french: Cornes, tendons, queue, griffes... J'ai affûté toutes les facettes de mon apparence pour insuffler la peur dans le cœur de ceux qui me regardent.
russian: Рога, мышцы, хвост и когти... Я подбирала все аспекты своей внешности, чтобы вселять страх в тех, кто решится обратить на меня взгляд.
bulgarian: Horns, sinew, tail, claws... I have honed all facets of my appearance to put fear in the heart of those who behold me.

english: Yet... these aspects do not seem to prevent you from drawing close.
french: Et pourtant... rien de cela ne semble te dissuader de t'approcher de moi.
russian: И тем не менее... Эти черты не мешают тебе со мной сближаться.
bulgarian: Yet... these aspects do not seem to prevent you from drawing close.

english: I think your claws are striking.
french: Je trouve tes griffes impressionnantes.
russian: По-моему, у тебя поразительные когти.
bulgarian: I think your claws are striking.

english: I'm into it. Your tail is cool.
french: Ça me plaît. Ta queue est sympa.
russian: Мне нравится. Хвост выглядит круто.
bulgarian: I'm into it. Your tail is cool.

english: Do you wish to see them more closely?
french: Veux-tu les observer de plus près ?
russian: Хочешь посмотреть на них поближе?
bulgarian: Do you wish to see them more closely?

english: The red of my nails is a natural color...
french: Le rouge de mes ongles est une couleur naturelle...
russian: Красный — это их естественный цвет...
bulgarian: The red of my nails is a natural color...

english: Once, my court sought to replicate the hue, but they found no material vibrant enough to match their natural luster.
french: Jadis, ma cour a cherché à en reproduire la teinte, mais nul n'a trouvé de matière assez vive pour égaler leur brillance naturelle.
russian: Однажды мои придворные захотели повторить этот оттенок. Но не смогли найти материал с таким ярким блеском.
bulgarian: Once, my court sought to replicate the hue, but they found no material vibrant enough to match their natural luster.

english: You... have been looking a long time.
french: Tu... regardes depuis un bon moment.
russian: Ты... уже долго на них смотришь.
bulgarian: You... have been looking a long time.

english: Tell me, [Ari]. Was this a cunning excuse to hold my hand?
french: Dis-moi, [Ari]. Était-ce là une ruse pour me tenir la main ?
russian: Признайся, [Ari], это был хитроумный план, чтобы подержать меня за руку?
bulgarian: Tell me, [Ari]. Was this a cunning excuse to hold my hand?

english: Curious...
french: Voilà qui est curieux...
russian: Любопытно...
bulgarian: Curious...

english: It is bold of you. And not unwelcome.
french: C'est audacieux de ta part. Et bien accueilli.
russian: Это звучит очень смело. Мне такое по нраву.
bulgarian: It is bold of you. And not unwelcome.

english: The way in which you greet me... without title or formality...
french: La façon dont tu t'adresses à moi... sans titre ni formalisme...
russian: Твоя манера обращения со мной... Без формальностей и без титулов...
bulgarian: The way in which you greet me... without title or formality...

english: Yet I have found that pursuing you soothes much of my thirst.
french: J'ai pourtant découvert que ma quête de ta présence apaisait l'essentiel de ma soif.
russian: Однако я выяснила, что стремление к тебе утоляет часть моей жажды.
bulgarian: Yet I have found that pursuing you soothes much of my thirst.

english: It was difficult at first, refraining from certain pursuits in this life...
french: Il a été difficile, au départ, de réfréner certaines quêtes dans cette vie...
russian: Вначале мне было трудно отказаться от некоторых стремлений в этой жизни...
bulgarian: It was difficult at first, refraining from certain pursuits in this life...

english: We are bonded by fate.
french: C'est la destinée qui nous lie.
russian: Мы связаны самой судьбой.
bulgarian: We are bonded by fate.

english: You are free to embrace me as the whim takes you.
french: Tu es libre de m'étreindre quand l'envie t'en prend.
russian: Ты можешь обнять меня, когда тебе заблагорассудится.
bulgarian: You are free to embrace me as the whim takes you.

english: Do not be concerned with propriety, [Ari].
french: Ne t'inquiète pas de la propriété, [Ari].
russian: Пусть приличия тебя не смущают, [Ari].
bulgarian: Do not be concerned with propriety, [Ari].

english: I do not think I could demonstrate every one of them for you, even across the full span of a lifetime.
french: N'imagine pas que je pourrais te faire la démonstration de chacune, une vie entière n'y suffirait pas.
russian: Не думаю, что смогу продемонстрировать каждый, даже за целую жизнь.
bulgarian: I do not think I could demonstrate every one of them for you, even across the full span of a lifetime.

english: However... it would please me to make the attempt.
french: Néanmoins... je serais ravie de le tenter.
russian: И всё же... Мы было бы приятно попробовать.
bulgarian: However... it would please me to make the attempt.

english: After countless reincarnations I have accrued many skills, well beyond the capacity of your average mortal.
french: Après d'innombrables réincarnations, j'ai acquis de nombreuses compétences qui vont bien au-delà des capacités du commun des mortels.
russian: После несчётных воплощений я обрела множество навыков, превосходящих возможности обычного смертного.
bulgarian: After countless reincarnations I have accrued many skills, well beyond the capacity of your average mortal.

english: It is refreshing to share in romance with you, [Ari].
french: Partager une idylle avec toi est rafraîchissant, [Ari].
russian: Разделять с тобой чувства для меня — приятное разнообразие, [Ari].
bulgarian: It is refreshing to share in romance with you, [Ari].

english: Being with you is much more pleasant. You desire to know me, and to share in mutual companionship.
french: Être avec toi est bien plus plaisant. Tu souhaites me connaître et profiter d'une compagnie mutuelle.
russian: С тобой мне гораздо приятнее. Ты желаешь узнать меня ближе и разделить переживания со мной.
bulgarian: Being with you is much more pleasant. You desire to know me, and to share in mutual companionship.

english: As a queen, it was expected I would make a match to strengthen political ties. And as a dragon, well...
french: En tant que reine, on attendait de moi des alliances destinées à renforcer des liens politiques. En tant que dragon, eh bien...
russian: Поскольку я была королевой, ожидалось, что я найду пассию для укрепления политических связей. И будучи драконом, конечно же...
bulgarian: As a queen, it was expected I would make a match to strengthen political ties. And as a dragon, well...

english: What were your political matches like?
french: À quoi ressemblaient tes unions politiques ?
russian: И какие были твои политические пассии?
bulgarian: What were your political matches like?

english: What is romance between dragons like?
french: À quoi ressemble une idylle entre dragons ?
russian: А как устроена романтика у драконов?
bulgarian: What is romance between dragons like?

english: They were acceptable, but largely without passion.
french: Elles étaient acceptables, mais pour l'essentiel dépourvues de passion.
russian: Приемлемы, но по большей части лишены страсти.
bulgarian: They were acceptable, but largely without passion.

english: Nothing more than pomp, ritual, and statecraft.
french: Rien de plus que l'apparat, le rituel et l'habileté politique.
russian: Пышные официальные церемонии — и только.
bulgarian: Nothing more than pomp, ritual, and statecraft.

english: A political union is a transaction of power, not a vow of affection.
french: Une union politique est une transaction autour du pouvoir, pas un serment d'affection.
russian: Политическая уния — это передача власти, а не признание в чувствах.
bulgarian: A political union is a transaction of power, not a vow of affection.

english: Being with you is... something new. You do not desire anything of me, other than myself.
french: Être avec toi est... quelque chose de nouveau. Tu ne désires rien de moi, hormis moi-même.
russian: С тобой всё по-другому... Ты не желаешь от меня ничего, кроме меня самой.
bulgarian: Being with you is... something new. You do not desire anything of me, other than myself.

english: Such a thing is... very attractive.
french: C'est là une chose... très attirante.
russian: Такое отношение... очень меня привлекает.
bulgarian: Such a thing is... very attractive.

english: I would describe it as fraught, as we are territorial creatures.
french: Je décrirais cela comme un risque, car nous sommes des créatures territoriales.
russian: Я бы сказала, что тяжко. Ведь мы территориальные существа.
bulgarian: I would describe it as fraught, as we are territorial creatures.

english: We are not communal by nature. Dragons do not wish to stay overlong with their own kind once they reach adulthood.
french: Nous ne sommes pas naturellement communautaires. Une fois adultes, les dragons ne souhaitent pas rester très longtemps avec ceux de leur espèce.
russian: По своей природе мы не социальны. Когда драконы достигают зрелости, они не любят задерживаться с роднёй подолгу.
bulgarian: We are not communal by nature. Dragons do not wish to stay overlong with their own kind once they reach adulthood.

english: I have been thinking of you, and of the past.
french: J'ai pensé à toi, et au passé.
russian: Я размышляла о тебе и о прошлом.
bulgarian: I have been thinking of you, and of the past.

english: We restored that balance together, [Ari].
french: Nous avons rétabli l'équilibre ensemble, [Ari].
russian: Мы восстановили равновесие вместе с тобой, [Ari].
bulgarian: We restored that balance together, [Ari].

english: Finishing each others' invocations...
french: En terminant mutuellement nos invocations...
russian: Продолжать друг за другом мегические формулы...
bulgarian: Finishing each others' invocations...

english: Twining our fingers as the spell reaches its peak...
french: En faisant de nos doigts des gestes jumeaux quand le sort atteint son apogée...
russian: Сплестись пальцами, когда заклинание достигает предела...
bulgarian: Twining our fingers as the spell reaches its peak...

english: Yes. I would enjoy doing that with you.
french: Oui. Cela me plairait de faire ça avec toi.
russian: Да. Такое занятие вместе с тобой принесёт мне удовольствие.
bulgarian: Yes. I would enjoy doing that with you.

english: As a progenitor of sorcery, I recognize how adept you have become at wielding spells.
french: En tant que mère de la sorcellerie, je reconnais que tu sais désormais très bien manier les sorts.
russian: Как прародительница чародейского искусства я отмечаю, насколько выросли твои навыки обращения с заклинаниями.
bulgarian: As a progenitor of sorcery, I recognize how adept you have become at wielding spells.

english: The way your power resonates with my own...
french: La façon dont ton pouvoir fait écho au mien...
russian: Твоя сила резонирует с моей...
bulgarian: The way your power resonates with my own...

english: I find it... thrilling.
french: Je trouve cela... palpitant.
russian: И это... воодушевляет.
bulgarian: I find it... thrilling.

english: Will you cast a spell for me some time?
french: Pourras-tu lancer un sort pour moi, à l'occasion ?
russian: Покажешь мне какое-нибудь заклинание когда-нибудь
bulgarian: Will you cast a spell for me some time?

english: What if we... joined our spells together?
french: Et si nous... unissions nos sorts ?
russian: А может, нам... объединить заклинания?
bulgarian: What if we... joined our spells together?

english: You wish to watch me... cast a spell?
french: Tu souhaites me voir... lancer un sort ?
russian: Ты хочешь посмотреть... как я колдую?
bulgarian: You wish to watch me... cast a spell?

english: I see.
french: Je vois.
russian: Понимаю.
bulgarian: I see.

english: If it would please you, you need only ask...
french: Si tel est ton plaisir, il te suffit de le demander...
russian: Если тебе это принесёт удовольствие, можешь просить, когда захочешь...
bulgarian: If it would please you, you need only ask...

english: Together...?
french: Ensemble...?
russian: Объединить?..
bulgarian: Together...?

english: Uniting our mana...
french: En unissant notre mana...
russian: Соединить нашу ману...
bulgarian: Uniting our mana...

english: After a long slumber, the magic of this land has reawakened...
french: Après un long sommeil, la magie de cette terre s'est réveillée...
russian: После долгого сна магия этой земли пробудилась...
bulgarian: After a long slumber, the magic of this land has reawakened...

english: You see, I am a firm believer that every being, mortal or otherwise, should have a hoard.
french: Vois-tu, je crois fermement que chaque être, qu'il soit mortel ou non, devrait posséder un trésor.
russian: Видишь ли, я твёрдо верю, что каждое создание — не важно, смертное или нет — заслуживает своей груды сокровищ.
bulgarian: You see, I am a firm believer that every being, mortal or otherwise, should have a hoard.

english: Perhaps it was presumptuous of me to believe you needed guidance in this sphere.
french: Il était peut-être présomptueux de ma part de penser que tu avais besoin d'un guide en cette matière.
russian: Возможно, я тебя недооценила, посчитав, что тебе нужен мой совет.
bulgarian: Perhaps it was presumptuous of me to believe you needed guidance in this sphere.

english: I appreciate that type of long-term planning. After all...
french: J'apprécie ce genre de vision à long terme. Après tout...
russian: Мне нравится такое долгосрочное планирование. В конце концов...
bulgarian: I appreciate that type of long-term planning. After all...

english: There is a chance we may one day join our hoards together.
french: Il existe une chance que nous puissions un jour réunir nos trésors respectifs.
russian: Возможно, наступит день, когда мы объединим наши сокровища.
bulgarian: There is a chance we may one day join our hoards together.

english: Therefore, I would like to help you begin a starter hoard.
french: Par conséquent, j'aimerais t'aider à commencer le tien.
russian: А потому я хочу помочь тебе начать.
bulgarian: Therefore, I would like to help you begin a starter hoard.

english: Tell me... where do your hoarding interests lie?
french: Dis-moi... Où se porte ton intérêt si tu devais accumuler quelque chose ?
russian: Поведай... Что тебе хочется собирать?
bulgarian: Tell me... where do your hoarding interests lie?

english: I like things that are ancient and valuable.
french: J'aime les choses anciennes et précieuses.
russian: Мне нравятся старинные и ценные предметы.
bulgarian: I like things that are ancient and valuable.

english: Maybe... money?
french: Vers... l'argent, peut-être ?
russian: Наверное... деньги?
bulgarian: Maybe... money?

english: How shrewd of you. Such items have great value and power, and they accrue further value over time.
french: Que c'est rusé de ta part ! De tels objets ont une grande valeur, beaucoup de pouvoir et leur préciosité s'accroît avec le temps.
russian: Как прозорливо с твоей стороны. Такие вещи хранят большую силу и со временем приобретают всё большую ценность.
bulgarian: How shrewd of you. Such items have great value and power, and they accrue further value over time.

english: If you leave an item in your hoard long enough, it may become priceless.
french: Si tu conserves un objet assez longtemps dans ton trésor, il peut devenir inestimable.
russian: Если достаточно долго держать предмет в своей сокровищнице, он может стать бесценным.
bulgarian: If you leave an item in your hoard long enough, it may become priceless.

english: Yes, I appreciate this type of forward-thinking. After all...
french: Oui, j'apprécie cette approche visionnaire. Après tout...
russian: Да, я ценю твою дальновидность. В конце концов...
bulgarian: Yes, I appreciate this type of forward-thinking. After all...

english: There is a chance we may one day join our hoards together.
french: Il existe une chance que nous puissions un jour réunir nos trésors respectifs.
russian: Возможно, наступит день, когда мы объединим наши сокровища.
bulgarian: There is a chance we may one day join our hoards together.

english: Your pragmatism pleases me.
french: Ton pragmatisme me plaît.
russian: Мне нравится твой прагматизм.
bulgarian: Your pragmatism pleases me.

english: Indeed, you would not have made it this far without knowing how to accumulate tesserae.
french: En effet, tu n'aurais pas réussi à aller aussi loin sans savoir comment accumuler des tesserae.
russian:
Воистину, без понимания, как копить тессеры, ты бы не

зашли

зашлазашёлзашло так далеко.
bulgarian: Indeed, you would not have made it this far without knowing how to accumulate tesserae.

english: There you are, [Ari]. Do you have a moment to speak? There is something I would like to discuss.
french: Te voici, [Ari]. Aurais-tu un moment pour moi ? J'aimerais parler de quelque chose avec toi.
russian: Вот ты где, [Ari]. Уделишь мне немного своего времени? Я хочу кое-что обсудить.
bulgarian: There you are, [Ari]. Do you have a moment to speak? There is something I would like to discuss.

english: Is this "$Dating$" a common practice among modern-day mortals, or simply a local curiosity?
french: Les « $rendez-vous$ » sont-ils une pratique courante, chez les mortels de l'époque actuelle, ou est-ce une curiosité locale ?
russian: Так называемые «$свидания$» — это повсеместная практика у нынешних смертных? Или это такой местный обычай?
bulgarian: Is this "$Dating$" a common practice among modern-day mortals, or simply a local curiosity?

english: In all my previous lives, I cannot recall any custom wherein a couple does pleasant, unstructured activities for... "fun."
french: Dans toutes mes vies précédentes, je ne me rappelle aucune coutume dans laquelle un couple fait des activités agréables, libres, pour... « s'amuser ».
russian: Ни в одной из прошлых жизней я не могу вспомнить традицию, чтобы пары без строгих правил занимались чем-то приятным... ради «развлечения».
bulgarian: In all my previous lives, I cannot recall any custom wherein a couple does pleasant, unstructured activities for... "fun."

english: You've never dated before?
french: Tu n'avais encore jamais été à un rendez-vous ?
russian: У тебя никогда не было свиданий?
bulgarian: You've never dated before?

english: I'd say it's pretty common.
french: Je dirais que c'est assez ordinaire.
russian:
Я бы

сказали

сказаласказалсказало, это весьма распространённая практика.
bulgarian: I'd say it's pretty common.

english: You need not phrase it that way! It is not as though I am an innocent youth.
french: Tu n'as pas besoin de formuler les choses de cette façon ! Ce n'est pas comme si j'étais une jeunette innocente.
russian: Не надо так формулировать! Будто твои слова обращены к невинному юнцу.
bulgarian: You need not phrase it that way! It is not as though I am an innocent youth.

english: I have courted, of course. With the intent to create alliances and to consolidate power.
french: J'ai eu des fréquentations, bien sûr. Dans l'intention de créer des alliances et de consolider un pouvoir.
russian: Разумеется, мне знакомы ухаживания. С целью создать союз или укрепить свою власть.
bulgarian: I have courted, of course. With the intent to create alliances and to consolidate power.

english: The pleasurable time I spend with you is very different, however.
french: Cependant, les moments agréables que je passe avec toi sont très différents.
russian: Однако времяпрепровождение с тобой — приятное. И это сильное отличие.
bulgarian: The pleasurable time I spend with you is very different, however.

english: I expect you to show me more of this... "$Dating$".
french: J'attends de toi que tu me montres d'autres de ces... « $rendez-vous$ ».
russian: Я рассчитываю, что ты дашь мне больше практики... «$свиданий$».
bulgarian: I expect you to show me more of this... "$Dating$".

english: I see. How interesting.
french: Je vois. C'est très intéressant.
russian: Понятно. Как интересно.
bulgarian: I see. How interesting.

english: When I was queen, the purpose of courtship was to create alliances and to consolidate power.
french: Quand j'étais reine, le but d'une cour était de créer des alliances et de consolider un pouvoir.
russian: Когда я была королевой, целью ухаживаний всегда были новые союзы и укрепление власти.
bulgarian: When I was queen, the purpose of courtship was to create alliances and to consolidate power.

english: The pleasurable time I spend with you is very different.
french: Les moments agréables que je passe avec toi sont très différents.
russian: А времяпрепровождение с тобой — приятное. И это сильное отличие.
bulgarian: The pleasurable time I spend with you is very different.

english: [Ari]. I have a question I would like you to answer for me.
french: J'ai une question, [Ari], à laquelle j'aimerais que tu répondes pour moi.
russian: [Ari]. У меня есть вопрос, на который я хочу получить ответ.
bulgarian: [Ari]. I have a question I would like you to answer for me.

english: And of my time trapped in the depths of the Ruins.
french: Et au temps que j'ai passé, piégée dans les profondeurs des ruines.
russian: И о том времени, что я провела в заточении в руинах.
bulgarian: And of my time trapped in the depths of the Ruins.

english: My crystalline prison was suffocating.
french: Ma prison de cristal était étouffante.
russian: В удушающе тесной кристальной тюрьме.
bulgarian: My crystalline prison was suffocating.

english: Every day, I longed to assume physical form... to take a breath under the night sky.
french: Chaque jour, j'aspirais ardemment à avoir une forme physique... afin de respirer sous le ciel nocturne.
russian: Каждый день я мечтала обрести физическое воплощение... Вдохнуть воздух под ночным небом.
bulgarian: Every day, I longed to assume physical form... to take a breath under the night sky.

english: After you freed me, I did just that.
french: Après que tu m'as libérée, c'est précisément ce que j'ai fait.
russian:
Это первое, что я сделала, когда ты меня

освободили

освободилаосвободилосвободило.
bulgarian: After you freed me, I did just that.

english: Cold and sharp, almost painful in my chest...
french: Froid et vif, presque douloureux dans ma poitrine...
russian: Морозный ночной воздух, почти обжигающий грудь...
bulgarian: Cold and sharp, almost painful in my chest...

english: That night air is what I think of when I see you, [Ari].
french: C'est à cet air nocturne que je pense quand je te vois, [Ari].
russian: Я вспоминаю его каждый раз, когда смотрю на тебя, [Ari].
bulgarian: That night air is what I think of when I see you, [Ari].

english: I was thinking of you...
french: J'étais en train de penser à toi...
russian: Я размышляла о тебе...
bulgarian: I was thinking of you...

english: Oh, I revel in it.
french: Oh, je m'en délecte.
russian: О, я упиваюсь этим взглядом.
bulgarian: Oh, I revel in it.

english: When you look at me, with those eyes of adoration...
french: Quand tu me regardes avec ces yeux pleins d'adoration...
russian: Когда ты смотришь на меня с таким обожанием...
bulgarian: When you look at me, with those eyes of adoration...

english: Here. A token.
french: Tiens. Un témoignage symbolique.
russian: Вот, возьми.
bulgarian: Here. A token.

english: I hunted this beast with my own claws... thinking of you as I struck every blow.
french: J'ai chassé cette bête de mes propres griffes... en pensant à toi à chaque instant.
russian: Я растерзала этого зверя своими когтями... И с каждым ударом я думала о тебе.
bulgarian: I hunted this beast with my own claws... thinking of you as I struck every blow.

english: As your mate, it is my duty to provide for you.
french: En tant que compagne, il est de mon devoir de subvenir à tes besoins.
russian: Как твой партнёр я обязана обеспечивать тебе пропитание.
bulgarian: As your mate, it is my duty to provide for you.

english: I wonder if hearing yours in return does the same for you...
french: Je me demande si entendre le tien en retour te provoque le même effet...
russian: Интересно, почувствуешь ли ты это, если я назову твоё в ответ...
bulgarian: I wonder if hearing yours in return does the same for you...

english: [Ari].
french: [Ari].
russian: [Ari].
bulgarian: [Ari].

english: It does thrill me to hear you speak my name.
french: Cela me donne le frisson de t'entendre prononcer mon nom.
russian: Меня пронимает дрожь, когда ты произносишь моё имя.
bulgarian: It does thrill me to hear you speak my name.

english: I began my existence as an immortal dragon, but chose to live a mortal life.
french: J'ai commencé mon existence sous la forme d'un dragon immortel, mais j'ai choisi de vivre une vie mortelle.
russian: Я начала своё существование как бессмертный дракон, но предпочла жить в мире смертных.
bulgarian: I began my existence as an immortal dragon, but chose to live a mortal life.

english: While you are mortal... yet imbued with the power of immortal dragons.
french: Alors que tu es un être mortel... pourtant imprégné de la puissance des dragons immortels.
russian:
Ты же

рождены смертными

рождена смертнойрождён смертнымрождено смертным... Но

получили

получилаполучилполучило силу вечных драконов.
bulgarian: While you are mortal... yet imbued with the power of immortal dragons.

english: You walk a line between the shapes of my soul.
french: Tu marches sur un fil qui sépare les différents aspects de mon âme.
russian: Ты живёшь на грани двух частей моей души.
bulgarian: You walk a line between the shapes of my soul.

english: Which makes you perfectly attuned to myself... And my tastes.
french: Ce qui fait que tu es en parfait unisson avec moi... et avec mes goûts.
russian: И потому ты идеально подходишь для меня... И для моих вкусов.
bulgarian: Which makes you perfectly attuned to myself... And my tastes.

english: I have noticed that there are some interesting parallels between us.
french: J'ai remarqué qu'il existe entre nous des parallèles intéressants.
russian: Я заметила между нами интересные параллели.
bulgarian: I have noticed that there are some interesting parallels between us.

english: The most prized treasure of my hoard.
french: Le trésor le plus précieux parmi toutes mes richesses.
russian: Ты — моё самое драгоценное сокровище.
bulgarian: The most prized treasure of my hoard.

english: There you are. You seem to be shining brightly today.
french: Te voilà. Tu sembles briller de mille feux, aujourd'hui.
russian: Вот ты где. Сегодня ты будто сияешь ярче.
bulgarian: There you are. You seem to be shining brightly today.

english: For I am not a demanding paramour.
french: Car je ne suis pas exigeante, en amour.
russian: Ведь я нетребовательная любовница...
bulgarian: For I am not a demanding paramour.

english: Though my taste in gifts may be lavish...
french: Quoique mes goûts soient parfois dispendieux en matière de présents...
russian: Хотя я и предпочитаю роскошные подарки...
bulgarian: Though my taste in gifts may be lavish...

english: And I should like to spend time with you often...
french: Et que j'aimerais passer souvent du temps avec toi...
russian: И я бы хотела проводить с тобой время чаще...
bulgarian: And I should like to spend time with you often...

english: That is my right.
french: J'en ai le droit.
russian: Таково моё право.
bulgarian: That is my right.

english: You need not fear, [Ari]...
french: N'aie crainte, [Ari]...
russian: Тебе нечего бояться, [Ari]...
bulgarian: You need not fear, [Ari]...
